column2: (Her expression softens slightly, and she instinctively strokes the sweater) ...Hmph. At least you've got a good eye. My grandson will wear this to school, so of course it has to look nice.

column1: 我们没别的意思。就是看您好像没休息好，黑眼圈挺重的，织毛衣时手也有点抖。是遇到什么麻烦了吗？也许我们能帮上忙。
column2: We don't mean anything by it. You just look like you haven't been sleeping well. You have dark circles under your eyes, and your hands are shaking while you knit. Is something wrong? Maybe we can help.

column1: 帮？你们能帮什么？我家阁楼里来了伙强盗，吵得我几天没合眼了。
column2: Help? What could you possibly do? A gang of bandits moved into my attic, and they haven't let me sleep for days.

column1: （没好气地）叫什么叫！是一群摇滚蝗虫！不知道抽什么风，半夜在我家阁楼开演唱会，叮叮当当的，房顶都快被它们掀了！
column2: (Irritably) Don't bother! It's a bunch of Vocals! For some crazy reason, they've been holding concerts in my attic at midnight. All that clanging and banging is about to bring down the roof!

column1: 这个好办，我们帮您解决！
column2: That's easy enough. We'll take care of it!

column1: 杰克说他认识个驱虫大师能赶走蝗虫，你们能做什么？
column2: Jack says he knows a pest-control expert who can drive away the Rockers. What can you do?

column1: 杰克就是雇您的人吧？放心吧，我已经想到办法了！蝗虫喜欢呢喃花，我们用呢喃花把蝗虫引到野外吧！
column2: Jack's the one who hired you, isn't he? Don't worry, I already have a plan! Rockers love Whispering Flowers. We can use them to lure the Rockers out into the wild!

column1: 小伙脑子倒是转得挺快，那就相信你们一回。
column2: You're a quick thinker, young man. All right, I'll trust you this once.

column1: 您放心吧，包的！我们这就去采花！
column2: Don't worry, we've got this! We'll go pick the flowers right now!

column1: 那么快就好了？年轻人腿脚就是利索。走吧，带你们去我家。
column2: Finished already? Young folks sure are quick on their feet. Come on, I'll take you to my house.

column1: 这里就是我家。你们试试能不能把它们引到南边树林里。
column2: This is my house. See if you can lure them into the woods to the south.

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，你来放呢喃花吧，我去目的地给它们搭个小舞台，把它们引出来以后，还要让他们有个安身的地方。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, You place the Whispering Flower. I'll build them a little stage at the destination. Once we lure them out, they'll need somewhere to settle down.

column1: 布置得差不多了，现在看看蝗虫们会不会上钩。
column2: Everything's just about ready. Now let's see if the Rockers take the bait.

column1: 哎呦喂……这群小祖宗还真过来了！瞧它们在那蹦跶得多开心！
column2: Well, I'll be... Those little rascals really came! Look how happily they're bouncing around!

column1: 这下我这把老骨头总算能睡个囫囵觉了！好孩子，你们比那个只会吹牛的杰克强一百倍！
column2: Now these old bones can finally get a good night's sleep! You're good kids. You're a hundred times more capable than that braggart Jack!

column1: 我也去跟老伙计们说道说道，不要再帮杰克欺负好人了！
column2: I'll talk to my old friends too and tell them to stop helping Jack bully decent folks!

column1: 你和莱蒙一靠近，老鲍勃立刻挺直腰板，假装认真占位。
column2: As soon as you and Lemon approach, old Bob straightens his back and pretends to be diligently holding the spot.

column1: （无奈地）爷爷，您这又是何苦呢？
column2: (Helplessly) Grandpa, why put yourself through this?

column1: （眼睛盯着地面，心虚但嘴硬）少废话！老夫我……我就爱站这儿呼吸新鲜空气！这地方是你家的？
column2: (Stares at the ground, guilty but defiant) Enough! This old man... I just like standing here and breathing the fresh air! What, do you own this place?

column1: （突然发现了什么）爷爷，您裤脚怎么破破烂烂的，看着像被什么咬了。
column2: (Suddenly notices something) Grandpa, why are your pant legs all torn up? It looks like something's been biting them.

column1: 可不是嘛！是一群天杀的白鼠！毛雪白，眼通红，看着挺贵气，干的全是强盗活儿！
column2: You bet! It's a pack of those blasted white rats! Snow-white fur, bright red eyes—they look downright fancy, but act like a bunch of bandits!

column1: 不知道为什么，在我家院子里生了根，天天搞破坏。别说裤子了，连墙根都被咬了个窟窿！
column2: I don't know why, but they've made themselves at home in my yard and wreak havoc every day. Forget the pants—they've even gnawed a hole through the base of the wall!

column1: 那小子，噢，就是杰克，说他能弄到城里最好的捕鼠夹……只要我帮他再坐几天……
column2: That kid—oh, Jack—said he could get the best mousetraps in town... as long as I keep sitting here for him for a few more days...

column1: 捕鼠夹？太老土了！您带我们去田里，我们立马就帮您解决！
column2: Mousetraps? Those are so old-fashioned! Take us to the fields, and we'll take care of it right away!

column1: 你们……你们要真有办法，我老鲍勃立马拍屁股走人！这破地方，坐得我腰疼！
column2: If you... if you really have a plan, old Bob here will get up and go right now! Sitting in this dump is killing my back!
You got it, you got it! Let's go!

column1: 就是这了。你瞧，这会都还探头呢，真是无法无天了！
column2: This is the place. Look, they're still poking their heads out! They've got some nerve!

column1: （老泪纵横）太神了，太神了！那个杰克，一张嘴啪啪的，就知道糊弄我！你们才是实干家！
column2: (Tears streaming down his face) Incredible! Simply incredible! That Jack is all talk—he's been pulling the wool over my eyes! You two are the ones who actually get things done!

column1: 放心吧，我不会再跟着杰克瞎搅和了，回头也会跟老兄弟姐妹们说一声别去了。
column2: Don't worry. I won't let Jack rope me into any more of his nonsense. I'll tell my old friends not to go, either.

column1: 哈哈哈，别看我一把老骨头，我是这的长老，说话还是有几分分量的。
column2: Hahaha! I may be getting on in years, but I'm an elder here. My word still carries some weight.

column1: 太好了！^{1}PlayerName^{2}，看来我们的各个击破策略生效了，回去告诉大家这个好消息吧！
column2: Great! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, it looks like our plan to Win them over one by one is Active. Let's go tell everyone the good news!

column1: 你，你给我等着！你根本不知道自己惹了谁！我是有人罩的！
column2: J-Just you wait! You have no idea who you're messing with! I've got powerful friends!

column1: 哦？你说的是鲍勃长老吗？他已经被我们“收买”了！
column2: Oh? You mean Elder Bob? We've already "bought him off"!

column1: 什么？！算你们狠！但这事儿没完，这片地盘我不要了，我去找别的地方！
column2: What?! You got me! But this isn't over! You can have this turf—I'll find somewhere else!

column1: （超大声）大家都听见了吧？最近要加强巡逻，不要让这家伙有机可乘！
column2: (Shouting) Everyone heard that, right? Step up patrols for the time being. Don't give this guy a chance to cause trouble!

column1: 听见了，我会派人巡逻的，把一些破坏村落安宁的坏家伙赶出去。
column2: Understood. I'll send out patrols to drive off any troublemakers who threaten the village's peace.

column1: 您来得正好，杰克刚被^{1}PlayerName^{2}痛扁一顿！
column2: Your timing is perfect. Jack just got a sound thrashing from ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

column1: （脸涨成猪肝色）你、你们……给我记住！
column2: (His face turns purple) Y-you... Remember this!

column1: 您来得刚好，我这儿正好有一批刚出炉的宝贝，还冒着热气儿呢！
column2: You came at just the right time! I've got a fresh batch of treasures, still hot off the forge!

column1: （用手指一弹，剑身发出清脆的嗡鸣）采用南方精钢，由矮人大师……的远房表亲的学徒亲自淬火！一剑下去，波利变刺身，木桩变牙签！
column2: (Flicks the blade with a finger, making it ring with a crisp hum) Forged from fine southern steel and personally quenched by the apprentice of a distant cousin of a dwarven Moonlit Challenger! One swing turns a Poring into sashimi and a Dummy into a toothpick!

column1: 我跟您投缘，给您个实在价！这剑，别人我卖@{1}铜币，您要诚心要，@{2}拿走！
column2: I like you, so I'll give you an honest price! I'd charge anyone else @{1} Copper Coins for this sword, but if you're serious, it's yours for @{2}!

column1: 怎么样？冒险者，机会难得，来一把吗！
column2: What do you say, Adventurer? This is a rare opportunity—how about buying one?

column1: 咳咳……这个……名师出高徒嘛！手艺那是得了真传的！您看这做工，这细节，绝对是大师水准！
column2: Ahem... well... great teachers produce great students! This craftsmanship was passed down by a true master! Just look at the workmanship, the attention to detail—it's absolutely Moonlit Challenger caliber!

column1: （捂住心脏）您这刀砍得比我这剑还狠呐！这连成本都不够啊！
column2: (Clutches chest) You drive a harder bargain than this sword's edge! That wouldn't even cover the cost!

column1: 啊！这位勇者！请留步！我注意到了您审视市场的锐利目光，感受到了您体内蕴藏的巨大潜力！这绝非池中之物该有的眼神！
column2: Ah, brave adventurer! A moment, please! I couldn't help but notice your keen eye as you surveyed the market—and the tremendous potential within you! Those are not the eyes of someone destined for mediocrity!

column1: 看看这庸庸碌碌的人群！他们满足于一把平凡的钢剑，一瓶廉价的药水！但您不一样！我从您的步伐中看到了超越平凡的渴望！
column2: Look at these plodding masses! They're content with an ordinary steel sword and a cheap potion! But not you! I can tell by your stride that you yearn to rise above the ordinary!

column1: 告诉我，您是否也曾仰望星空，思考如何才能不再辜负这身天赋，真正地……活一次？
column2: Tell me, have you ever gazed up at the stars and wondered how you could finally live up to your gifts and truly... live?

column1: （微微俯身，压低声音）我们奋斗者公会，寻找的正是您这样的瑰宝！我们提供的不是一份工作，而是一个改写命运、实现阶层飞跃的终极平台！
column2: (Leans in slightly and lowers their voice) The Adventurers' Guild is looking for exceptional people just like you! We're not offering you a mere job, but the ultimate opportunity to rewrite your destiny and rise to the top!

column1: 给我一个晚上，我将向您证明，您之前所有的奋斗，都只是在为加入我们做准备！如何？愿不愿意给自己一个触摸未来的机会？
column2: Give me one evening, and I'll prove that everything you've worked for has merely been preparing you to join us! What do you say? Will you give yourself a chance to reach out and touch the future?

column1: 有性格！我就欣赏您这份直率！但请相信，我贾克斯的承诺，比精金还要沉重！亲眼去看看，您就会知道，我所言非虚！
column2: Now that's character! I admire your candor! But believe me, a promise from Jax carries more weight than adamantine! Come see for yourself, and you'll know I speak the truth!

column1: （大喜过望）明智！无与伦比的明智！请随我来，我们的未来，就从这顿晚餐开始！
column2: (Overjoyed) Wise! Incomparably wise! Come with me—our future begins with this dinner!

column1: （抹着眼泪）我老公自从加入了他的公会，就经常不回家，上一次见到他还是三个月前……
column2: (Wiping away tears) Ever since my husband joined his guild, he hardly ever comes home. The last time I saw him was three months ago...

column1: 我儿子上次回家拿衣服，眼睛里全是血丝，站着都快睡着了！说什么“自愿加练”，我看是被洗脑了！
column2: The last time my son came home to get some clothes, his eyes were bloodshot, and he could barely stay awake on his feet! He called it “voluntary extra training,” but I say he’s been brainwashed!

column1: 诸位家属！请理解！这一切都是为了更幸福的未来！他们都是自愿为梦想拼搏的！短暂的分别，是为了幸福的团聚！
column2: Dear families! Please understand! This is all for a happier future! They're all willingly striving for their dreams! This brief separation will lead to a joyous reunion!

column1: 大家一起随我来吧，看看他们的努力工作的状态，你们就懂他们是多么地快乐！
column2: Come with me, everyone! Once you see them hard at work, you'll understand just how happy they are!

column1: 约翰，你上次回家是三个月前，回来吃了顿饭，说碗筷放着等你洗，然后就去“紧急集结”了。我等你洗完那套碗，等到现在。
column2: John, the last time you came home was three months ago. You ate, said you'd wash the dishes later, then rushed off for an “emergency assembly.” I've been waiting for you to wash them ever since.

column1: 啊！我想起来了！亲爱的你放心，等我们成功讨伐巨鲲，就能用国王陛下的赏金换一套纯金餐具了！
column2: Ah! Now I remember! Don't worry, honey. Once we defeat the Giant Kun, we can use His Majesty's reward to buy a set of solid-gold dinnerware!

column1: 哦？那我是不是还得先学会“点石成金”的魔法，免得你那纯金盘子还没影，我们娘俩先饿成雕像了？
column2: Oh? Should I learn a “turn stone into gold” spell first, so the two of us don't starve into statues before those solid-gold plates ever show up?

column1: （眼神空洞）昨晚我梦到我在打怪……效率比白天还高……这要是真的就好了。
column2: (Staring blankly) Last night, I dreamed I was fighting monsters... I was even more efficient than during the day... If only it were real.

column1: 孩子，我们回家吧，该好好睡一觉了。
column2: Come on, child. Let's go home. You need a good night's sleep.

column1: 我好像看到了母亲，她应该在妙勒尼山才对，我又在做梦了……
column2: I thought I saw my mother. She should be in the Mjolnir Mountains. I must be dreaming again...

column1: （叉腰）透支生命？我好吃好喝的供着你，你在这透支生命？
column2: (Hands on hips) Burning through your Life? I keep you well-fed and comfortable, and you're here burning through your Life?

column1: 老，老婆，这只是个说辞而已，为了赚钱，为了赚钱……
column2: H-Honey, it's just a figure of speech! It's all to make money, to make money...

column1: 怎么样？成员们是不是很有干劲？现在做出你的选择吧！是加入我们，共同开创未来？还是……甘于平凡，与那些无法理解我们崇高理想的人为伍？
column2: Well? Aren't our Members fired up? Now make your choice! Will you join us and build the future together? Or... settle for mediocrity among those who cannot comprehend our lofty ideals?

column1: 呵呵，人各有志，真是遗憾。这点小礼物，算是对你刚才出手相助的感谢。祝你……永远这么“轻松”。
column2: Heh, to each their own. What a shame. Please accept this small gift as a Thank You for your help earlier. May life always be so... “easy” for you.

column1: 太好了，明智的选择！欢迎加入奋斗者公会，这是你的签约奖金！
column2: Excellent—a wise choice! Welcome to the Fighters' Guild. Here's your signing bonus!
Hello! What can I get for you?

column1: 好嘞，给您打包好了，谢谢惠顾。
column2: All set—I've packed it up for you. Thanks for your business!

column1: 啊，是三明治，太感谢了！这地方点不到外卖，我已经快被饿晕了。
column2: Ah, a sandwich! Thank you so much! I can't get delivery out here, and I'm practically starving.

column1: 哟，看来有人已经忘了上次被蚂蚁当“外卖”点走的经历了？？
column2: Well, well. Looks like someone's already forgotten the time the ants carried you off like a takeout order??

column1: 团、团长！那是一次宝贵的实地数据，而这次是完美的科学产物。感情用事才会坏事，科学可不会。
column2: C-Captain! That was valuable field data, and this time, I have a flawless product of science. Emotions lead to mistakes, but science never does.

column1: 好吧，大科学家。需要我派一队冒险者跟着你吗？免得你又被抬走。
column2: All right, great scientist. Should I send a team of Adventurers with you so you don't get carried off again?

column1: 不……不用劳烦。有面前这位可靠的勇士陪同测试就足够了……
column2: N-No need to trouble yourself. This reliable warrior here is all I need to assist with the test...

column1: 行，那你俩注意安全。不过教授，要是再出事，你的人身自由……可就要暂时被骑士团接管了哦。
column2: Fine. You two stay safe. But Professor, if anything goes wrong again, the Order may have to... temporarily take charge of your personal freedom.

column1: 绝、绝对不会，我有把握，这次绝对不会出任何岔子。
column2: It a-absolutely won't! I'm confident there won't be any problems this time.

column1: 那就好。喂，^{1}PlayerName^{2}，这位了不起的教授就交给你看着啦，千万别让他玩过头。
column2: That's good. Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm leaving this remarkable Professor in your care. Don't let him get too carried away.

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，来，拿好我珍贵的【伪后信息素】，千万别摔了，把它洒在身上就可以了。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, here—take my precious [Pseudo-Queen Pheromone]. Don't drop it! Just sprinkle it on You.

column1: 太成功了！它对你竟然如此温顺，这远远超出了我的预期。这说明信息素建立的联结是稳定且具有情感基础的，估计连骑乘也会很顺利吧……
column2: It's a resounding success! It's so docile around you—far beyond my expectations. This proves the bond created by the pheromone is stable and emotionally grounded. I imagine riding it will go smoothly too...

column1: 艾昆妮团长，你看到了吗？这温顺的性格，这强健的体魄，这将是颠覆性的创新，巨蚁完全可以成为一种比大嘴鸟更优秀、更强大的坐骑，而且根据我的研究，它们对复杂地形的适应力也是极其优秀的。
column2: Captain Aikuni, do you see this? Such a gentle temperament! Such a powerful physique! This will be a revolutionary innovation! Giant ants could become stronger, more Excellent mounts than Peco Pecos. And according to my research, their adaptability to difficult terrain is also Excellent.

column1: 教授，一个合格的坐骑，首要标准是“可靠”。我的大嘴鸟可不会突然把骑手甩下去，或者……嗯，产生一些不必要的【爱慕之情”。安全第一，对吧？
column2: Professor, the most important quality in a proper mount is reliability. My Peco Peco won't suddenly throw its rider off or... ahem, develop any unnecessary [Romantic Feelings]. Safety first, right?

column1: ……你这是偏见，是对未知科技的保守态度！我的巨蚁经过信息素调和，稳定性是经过计算的，你说的大嘴鸟，才是真的……呆头呆脑！
column2: ...That's prejudice! A conservative attitude toward unknown technology! My giant ant's pheromones have been calibrated, and its stability has been calculated. Your Peco Peco is the one that's... a featherbrain!

column1: 哦？呆头呆脑，但至少不会让你的研究再次变成“救援行动”。所以，你觉得你的‘计算’能胜过陆行鸟千百年来被验证的可靠性？
column2: Oh? A featherbrain, maybe, but at least it won't turn your research into another rescue mission. So you think your "calculations" can beat the reliability Peco Pecos have proven over thousands of years?

column1: 当、当然！科学就是在不断挑战和超越传统。
column2: O-Of course! Science is about constantly challenging and surpassing tradition.

column1: 光说没用。正好，我知道一条大嘴鸟竞速赛的废弃赛道。让你的巨蚁和我的大嘴鸟比一场怎么样？让事实说话。你该不会……不敢吧？
column2: Talk is cheap. As it happens, I know an abandoned Peco Peco racetrack. How about a race between your giant ant and my Peco Peco? Let the results speak for themselves. Unless... you're afraid?

column1: 比就比，我的研究成果绝不会输给一只鸟！（玩家名字），我们走，去赛道。
column2: You're on! My research will never lose to some bird! PlayerName, let's head to the racetrack.

column1: 哈哈哈，好，你们准备好了就跟我说一声。
column2: Hahaha! All right. Let me know when you're ready.

column1: 怎么样？准备好和我的大嘴鸟一决胜负了吗？
column2: Well? Ready to face my Peco Peco?

column1: 唉……样本没了，宝贵的实战数据也没来得及记录完整。但是！这次意外恰恰证明了我的理论有一个关键的优化方向——
column2: Sigh... The specimen is gone, and I didn't even finish recording the valuable field data. But! This incident proves there's one crucial area where my theory can be improved—

column1: 信息素的稳定性与宿主的生理状态呈正相关，一定是赛跑时产生的肾上腺素或某种代谢产物，干扰了信息素受体的正常结合。这不是失败，这是排除了一个重要的错误选项！
column2: Pheromone stability is positively correlated with the host's physiological state. The adrenaline or some other metabolic byproduct produced during the race must have interfered with normal pheromone receptor binding. This wasn't a failure—it eliminated one major false lead!

column1: 教授，听你的意思是，还准备继续研究？刚才它可差点把我们三个都给吃了。
column2: Professor, are you saying you plan to continue your research? That thing nearly ate all three of us!

column1: 任何伟大的革新都伴随着风险，朱诺的第一艘飞空艇第一次也没飞多远，我需要调整的是配方浓度和施用方式，而不是放弃整个研究方向。
column2: Every great innovation comes with risks. Juno's first airship didn't get far on its maiden flight either. I need to adjust the formula's concentration and application method—not abandon the entire field of research.

column1: 好吧，我算是看出来了，不让你研究比让蚂蚁听话还难。不过教授，我们要约法三章——下次实验前，你得先给我提交一份《超详细安全预案》。
column2: All right, I get it. Stopping you from doing research is harder than making an ant obey. But Professor, we're setting some ground rules. Before your next experiment, you must submit an "Extremely Detailed Safety Plan" to me.

column1: 商队又被袭击了？又是巴风特？那片区域最近确实不太平。教授，你又寄了什么重要器材过来吗？
column2: The caravan was attacked again? By Baphomet? Peace has been hard to come by in that area lately. Professor, did you have more important equipment shipped here?

column1: 什……什么？！你、你说哪里？黑森林？！巴风特？！完了完了！这下全完了！
column2: Wh-What?! W-Where did you say? The Black Forest?! Baphomet?! No, no, no! This is a disaster!

column1: 这么重要吗？实在不行，我们可以想办法给你再搞一份的，我在朱诺也有一些人脉——
column2: Is it that important? If necessary, we can find a way to get you another one. I have some connections in Juno—

column1: 不是器材！是活的！那箱子里是活的啊！
column2: It's not equipment! It's alive! There's something alive in that crate!

column1: 教授，说清楚，什么“活的”？你到底托运了什么生物？你该不会又违反王国安全条例了吧！
column2: Professor, be clear. What do you mean by "alive"? What kind of creature did you ship? Don't tell me you've violated the kingdom's safety regulations again!

column1: 是【小豆丁】！我在朱诺的老同学，它因为没办法再照顾小猫了，就把【小豆丁】托付给了我。这、这要是让格伦知道我把小豆丁给弄丢了，他一定会跟我绝交的……
column2: It's [Little Bean]! An old classmate of mine in Juno could no longer care for the kitten, so they entrusted [Little Bean] to me. I-If Glenn finds out I lost Little Bean, he'll never speak to me again...

column1: 原来是宠物猫。教授你糊涂啊，为什么不用飞空艇运呢？
column2: So it's a pet cat. Professor, what were you thinking? Why didn't you transport it by airship?

column1: 我听说飞空艇的货舱有时候会出现把动物憋死的情况，所以特意委托了一家能够陆运动物的公司……怎么办，怎么办啊！
column2: I heard animals sometimes suffocate in airship cargo holds, so I specifically hired a company that transports animals overland... What do I do? What am I going to do?!

column1: 好了！现在不是慌乱的时候。当务之急是立刻去现场，必须在巴风特或者别的什么东西伤害到那只猫之前找到它。
column2: Enough! This is no time to panic. We need to head to the scene immediately and find that cat before Baphomet—or anything else—can hurt it.

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，情况有变，这不再是简单的货物搜寻了。我们得行动了，立刻出发。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, the situation has changed. This is no longer a simple search for cargo. We have to act. Let's leave immediately.

column1: 您好！您就是艾昆妮团长提到的那位可靠的冒险者吗？很高兴见到您，您是为了那张悬赏令来的吧。
column2: Hello! Are you the reliable Adventurer Captain Aikuni mentioned? It's a pleasure to meet you. You're here about the bounty notice, correct?

column1: 实不相瞒，这个案子让我们很头疼。城里近期接连发生了三起失窃案，失主和丢失的东西都截然不同，我们几乎找不到共同点。
column2: To be honest, this case has us stumped. There have been three thefts in the city recently, but the victims and stolen items are completely different. We can barely find anything they have in common.

column1: 第一位受害者是铁匠忽克连师傅，他丢失了一把宝剑；第二位是住在城西的姑娘妮塔，她丢失了一件首饰；第三位是从吉芬来的一位魔法师，据说他有一本很重要的魔法书被偷了。
column2: The first victim was Blacksmith Hollgrehenn. He lost a fine sword. The second was Nita, a young woman who lives on the west side of the city. She lost a piece of jewelry. The third was a Mage from Geffen who reportedly had a very important spellbook stolen.

column1: 我们询问时没得到太多线索……您可以去亲自拜访一下他们，能从他们的经历里发现一些我们忽略的细节。
column2: We didn't uncover much in the way of a Clue during our interviews... You should visit them yourself. You may Discover some detail in their accounts that we overlooked.

column1: 嘿！生面孔啊！是来精炼装备的冒险者吗？找我忽克连就对了！只要你有好材料，我就有胆子给你往上敲！
column2: Hey! A new face! Are you an Adventurer looking to refine your gear? Then Hollgrehenn's your man! Bring me good materials, and I'll hammer your gear as high as you dare!

column1: 哦，那件事啊。对，我丢了把好武器，是一位老主顾寄放在我这，让我帮忙附魔的。唉，真是对不起人家的信任。
column2: Oh, that. Yeah, I lost a fine weapon. A longtime customer left it with me to Enchant. Sigh... I really let them down after they placed their trust in me.

column1: 说实话，我真不记得是怎么没的了。那天客人不少，我忙得团团转。那把武器我就放在那边的架子上，一转身的功夫就不见了。谁干的？长啥样？我真的一点印象都没有。
column2: Honestly, I don't remember how it vanished. The shop was packed that day, and I was running all over the place. I left the weapon on that rack, turned away for a moment, and it was gone. Who did it? What did they look like? I don't remember a thing.

column1: 不寻常的事？你这么一说……嘿嘿，倒还真有一件。那天快打烊的时候，店里来了位特别……呃……特别热情的女士。穿着打扮，那可真是……啧啧，像团火一样！
column2: Something unusual? Now that you mention it... Heh, there was one thing. Just before closing, a particularly... uh... passionate lady came into the shop. And the way she was dressed... Whew! She was like a blazing flame!

column1: 她也没干啥，就在那儿看我打铁，看了好一会儿。然后她走过来，凑得挺近，说我打铁的样子充满了力量，特别有男人味……
column2: She didn't really do anything. She just watched me smithing for quite a while. Then she came over, leaned in real close, and said I looked so strong and manly while working the forge...

column1: 我哪听过这个啊！当时我这心砰砰跳，脑子都有点迷糊了。她就那么夸了我几句，然后啥也没买，笑着就走了。现在想想，还挺让人开心的，哈哈！
column2: I'd never heard anything like that before! My heart was pounding, and my head got all fuzzy. She complimented me a few times, then left with a smile without buying anything. It still makes me happy just thinking about it! Haha!

column1: 可开心归开心，武器还是丢了。唉，要是能帮上忙就好了。你说，总不能是那位漂亮女士拿的吧？她看着可不像坏人。
column2: But happy as it made me, the weapon is still missing. Sigh... I wish I could be more help. You don't think that beautiful lady took it, do you? She didn't look like a bad person.

column1: 欢迎光临！需要买束花送给重要的人吗？今天的天堂鸟特别精神哦！
column2: Welcome! Would you like a bouquet for someone special? The birds of paradise look especially vibrant today!

column1: 啊，你是说我的金戒指呀……那是我妈妈留给我的最重要的东西了。我一直很小心地保管着的，真的不知道怎么会不见的。
column2: Oh, you mean my gold ring... It was the most precious thing my mother left me. I always took such good care of it. I truly don't understand how it could have disappeared.

column1: 那天……就和平时一样在店里照顾花草，接待客人。戒指我一直戴在手上的，但什么时候不见的，我完全没有察觉。好像就是……不知不觉就消失了。
column2: That day... I was tending the flowers and helping customers, just like always. I kept the ring on my finger, but I never noticed when it disappeared. It was as if it just... vanished without me realizing.

column1: 特别的的事？你这么一问……还真有！我好像……遇到了命运般的邂逅！
column2: Something unusual? Now that you ask... Yes, there was! I think I had... a fateful encounter!

column1: 那天傍晚，我正要关店，一位先生路过门口。他虽然衣服有些旧，看起来也很疲惫，但是……但是他长得真的很好看！有一种忧郁的气质，就像故事里落难的贵族骑士！
column2: That evening, just as I was about to close the shop, a gentleman passed by. His clothes were a little worn, and he looked exhausted, but... he was so handsome! He had this melancholy air, like a noble knight fallen on hard times in a story!

column1: 他有点不好意思地问我，有没有什么吃的，他饿得快走不动路了。天哪，你能想象吗？这简直和小说里的情节一模一样！
column2: He shyly asked if I had anything to eat because he was so hungry he could barely walk. Oh my, can you imagine? It was exactly like something out of a novel!
What do I do after that?

column1: 我正好带着给自己当晚餐的火腿三明治，就给了他。他吃的时候非常优雅，还特别郑重地感谢了我，说我的善良照亮了他灰暗的一天。想起来都觉得好开心啊！
column2: I happened to have a ham sandwich for my dinner, so I gave it to him. He ate it so elegantly, then gave me a solemn Thank You and said my kindness had brightened his dreary day. Just thinking about it makes me so happy!

column1: 可是……戒指也是在那之后不见的。难道是不小心掉在哪里了？总不可能是那位像王子一样的先生拿走的吧？不可能不可能！
column2: But... my ring disappeared after that. Maybe I dropped it somewhere by accident? That prince-like gentleman couldn't possibly have taken it, could he? No, of course not!

column1: ……不合理，完全不合理！防护结界没有触发，箱子的封印也完好无损，书是如何不翼而飞的？这违背了《基础防护魔法十二定律》的第三、第五和第七条！
column2: ...It makes no sense! Absolutely none! The protective barrier wasn't triggered, and the seal on the chest is completely intact. How could the book simply vanish? This violates the third, fifth, and seventh of the Twelve Fundamental Laws of Protective Magic!

column1: 你就是调查员？太好了！请务必帮我找回丢失的书籍。那不是普通的魔法书，里面记载的知识极其危险，如果被滥用，后果不堪设想！我必须将它带回吉芬塔封存。
column2: Are you the investigator? Thank goodness! Please, you must help me recover the missing book. It's no ordinary spellbook—the knowledge it contains is extremely dangerous. If misused, the consequences could be catastrophic! I must take it back to Geffen Tower and seal it away.
How did the book go missing?

column1: 我……我不知道。我检查了无数遍。它就放在我的加密箱里，我抵达普隆德拉后还确认过一次。但在我准备启程回吉芬前，它就消失了。整个过程没有任何暴力破解的痕迹。
column2: I... I don't know. I checked countless times. It was in my lockbox, and I even confirmed it was there after arriving in Prontera. But before I was ready to leave for Geffen, it vanished. There were no signs of forced entry whatsoever.

column1: 异常？一切流程都符合规定。硬要说有什么打断了我原本严谨的行程……嗯……是有一件微不足道的小事。
column2: Anything unusual? Everything went according to protocol. If I had to name something that disrupted my carefully planned itinerary... Hmm... there was one insignificant little incident.

column1: 在去公会的路上，一条小巷里……我遇见了一只生物。一只……呃……暹罗猫，这种猫严格来说只会出现在遥远的东方，非常罕见啊！它的体态十分……咳咳！总之，它当时在晒太阳，看起来很温顺。
column2: On my way to the Guild, I spotted a creature in an alley. It was a... uh... Siamese cat. Strictly speaking, these cats are only found in the faraway East. They're extremely rare! Its figure was quite... Ahem! Anyway, it was sunning itself and looked very docile.

column1: 我……我观察了四周，确认没有违反《吉芬公共行为守则》……然后，我出于对生命体的基本关爱，蹲下身……摸了摸它的头。
column2: I... I looked around and made sure I wasn't violating the Geffen Code of Public Conduct... Then, out of basic concern for a living creature, I crouched down... and patted it on the head.

column1: 它的呼噜声……据现有研究表明，具有安抚神经的功效……但这与失窃案绝对无关！那只是一个短暂的、合乎情理的交互行为。
column2: Its purring... According to current research, it has a soothing effect on the nerves... But that has absolutely nothing to do with the theft! It was merely a brief, perfectly reasonable Interaction.

column1: 对，不可能有关！难道你要指控一只无辜的、在阳光下打呼噜的小猫是窃贼吗？荒谬！这一定是某种我们尚未知的高明空间魔法所为！
column2: Right, there couldn't possibly be a connection! Are you accusing an innocent little kitten purring in the sun of being a thief? Absurd! This must be the work of some sophisticated spatial magic yet unknown to us!

column1: 救……救我……水……只要一口水……沙漠……不会放过任何大意的人……
column2: Help... Help me... Water... Just one sip... The desert... shows no mercy to the careless...

column1: 嘿！朋友，你回来了！看你的表情，是不是有好消息告诉我？
column2: Hey, my friend! You're back! Judging by the look on your face, do you have good news for me?

column1: 太好了，真的是它！太感谢你了，你可真是帮了我和老主顾一个大忙！
column2: Wonderful, that's really it! Thank You so much—you've done both me and one of my longtime customers a huge favor!

column1: 快跟我说说，到底是哪个家伙，手法这么高明？我到现在都琢磨不透他是怎么得手的。
column2: Come on, tell me—who was it? How did they pull off something so skillful? I still can't figure out how they did it.

column1: 什……什么？是……是她？怎么会……她夸我打铁的样子……那么真诚……难道……难道那些话也是为了偷东西吗？唉，我这心里，比精炼失败+@{1}还难受啊……
column2: Wh... what? It was... her? But how...? She sounded so sincere when she praised my smithing... Could it be... was all that just so she could steal from me? Ugh, this hurts worse than failing a +@{1} refinement...

column1: 哦——！明白了明白了！是那种“不能透露太多”的情况对吧？就像某些高级委托一样。
column2: Oh! I get it now! It's one of those "can't say too much" situations, right? Like with certain high-level commissions.

column1: 不管怎么说，武器能找回来就是天大的好事，这份人情我忽克连记下了，以后来精炼装备，我给你算便宜点！
column2: Anyway, getting the weapon back is wonderful news! I, Hollgrehenn, won't forget what you've done. Next time you need equipment refined, I'll give you a discount!

column1: 啊，是你呀！今天需要什么花呢？……嗯？你的表情看起来有很重要的事？
column2: Oh, it's you! What kind of flowers do you need today? ...Hmm? Judging by your expression, is something important going on?

column1: 天啊！是我的戒指！妈妈留下的戒指！太好了！真的、真的不知道该怎么感谢你才好！
column2: Oh my gosh! It's my ring! The ring my mother left me! Thank goodness! I really, truly can't thank you enough!

column1: 那个……如果可以的话，能告诉我吗？到底是谁拿走了它吗？我真的很好奇。
column2: Um... if you don't mind, could you tell me who took it? I'm really curious.

column1: ……诶？那位……像王子一样的先生？这……这怎么可能……
column2: …Huh? That… prince-like gentleman? Th-That can't be…

column1: 所以……他说饿坏了……那些感谢的话……都只是为了……为了偷走妈妈的戒指吗？原来……根本没有什么命运的邂逅啊……
column2: So... when he said he was starving... and all those words of gratitude... was it all just... just so he could steal Mom's ring? So... there was never any fateful encounter at all...

column1: 我明白了！这一定是为了保护某些人，对吧？就像骑士小说里写的那样~
column2: I understand! You must be trying to protect someone, right? Just like in the knightly tales~

column1: 没关系，戒指能回来就是最棒的结局了，谢谢你帮我完成了这个“任务”。以后你来买花，我永远给你打八折哦~
column2: It's okay. Getting the ring back is the best ending I could have hoped for. Thank you for helping me complete this "mission." From now on, whenever you buy flowers from me, I'll always give you twenty percent off~

column1: 调查员！你回来了！你的表情……难道说……？
column2: Investigator! You're back! That look on your face... Could it be...?

column1: 奥丁保佑，封印完好无损……太感谢你了，你阻止了一场可能发生的学术灾难！
column2: Odin be praised, the seal is completely intact... Thank You! You prevented what could have been an academic catastrophe!

column1: 按照流程，我必须询问：你是否确定了窃贼的身份？这对我完善后续的安保方案至关重要。
column2: Protocol requires me to ask: Have you identified the thief? This is crucial to improving our security measures going forward.

column1: 什……什么？你指控那只……那只瞳孔如琥珀般清澈的暹罗猫？！
column2: Wh... what? You're accusing that... that Siamese cat with pupils as clear as amber?!

column1: 不，这不可能！这完全违背了《非智慧生物行为学》的基本原理！它当时是那么温顺，呼噜声的频谱分析也显示它处于完全放松的状态！难道……难道这一切都是高维度的拟态伪装吗？！
column2: No, that's impossible! It completely contradicts the fundamental principles of Non-Sapient Creature Behavior! It was so docile, and spectral analysis of its purring showed that it was completely relaxed! Could... could all of this have been some kind of higher-dimensional mimicry disguise?!

column1: 我明白了。涉及这种层次的窃贼，其身份信息本身就属于需要封存的机密情报，我理解你的保密行为。
column2: I see. When dealing with a thief of this caliber, their very identity is classified information that must remain sealed. I understand why you need to keep it confidential.

column1: 无论如何，你追回了禁书，为学术界的稳定做出了巨大贡献。请务必收下我的谢意，今后在魔法道具的研究方面，我可以为你提供优先级的学术支持。
column2: In any case, you've recovered the forbidden tome and made an invaluable contribution to the stability of the academic community. Please accept my gratitude. From now on, I'll give your research into magical items priority support.

column1: 哎，你等一下！最近普隆德拉要办庆典，物资调配弄得我头都大了。我这儿有一份帮忙清单，你能不能替我跑一趟？
column2: Hey, wait! Prontera is holding a festival soon, and coordinating all the supplies is driving me crazy. I've got a list of errands here. Could you take care of them for me?

column1: 先去帮我找一下安东尼奥，那家伙答应帮我把庆典横幅从梦罗克带回来，到现在都没影。顺便——
column2: First, find Antonio for me. He promised to bring the festival banner back from Morroc, but there's still no sign of him. And while you're at it—

column1: 苏克拉特沙漠的魔物们泛滥，先去帮我除掉一部分
column2: Monsters are overrunning Sograt Desert. Help me take some of them out first.

column1: 横幅？按规定来说，我三天前就交给商会托运了。但那个商队领队说路上遇到了魔物，被困在半道上。我正准备自己跑一趟。
column2: The banner? According to regulations, I handed it over to the Merchants' Guild for delivery 3 days ago. But the caravan leader said they ran into monsters and got stranded along the way. I was just about to head there Myself.

column1: 既然你来了，要不然帮我去搞定他们吧！
column2: Since you're here, how about taking care of them for me?

column1: 哦……那个啊……烟花嘛，做是做完了。不过昨天我忽然觉得，普通的金色太没意思了，连夜改成了七色渐变带闪光尾迹的。
column2: Oh...that. The Fireworks are finished. But Yesterday, I suddenly decided the Normal gold was too boring, so I stayed up all night changing them to a 7-color gradient with sparkling trails.

column1: 效果绝对震撼！唯一的小问题是——
column2: The Effect will be spectacular! There's just one tiny problem—

column1: 引信有点短，点了就得跑。你到时候提醒点烟花的人，腿脚要利索。要不你先去帮我找点可以拉长引线的方法？
column2: The fuse is a little short, so you have to run the moment it's lit. Remind whoever lights the Fireworks to be quick on their feet. Or maybe You could first help me find a way to lengthen the fuse?

column1: 信号塔？哦！那个！理论上来说，我上周就调完了。
column2: The signal tower? Oh! That! Theoretically, I finished calibrating it last week.

column1: 而且我顺便加装了远程传讯功能，信号可以覆盖到伊斯鲁德岛！不过有一个小bug——传出去的消息会被翻译成猫语。
column2: I also added a Ranged communication Function while I was at it. The signal can reach all the way to Izlude Island! There's just one little bug—the messages it sends get translated into cat language.

column1: 根据记载，《庆典流程手册》第七版修订稿……确实需要更新。去年出了意外临时改流程，没人通知我。所以我自己编了一版正确的，但被说太长。
column2: According to the records, the 7th revised edition of the Festival Procedure Manual...does need an update. An accident forced a last-minute change to the schedule last year, but no one told me. So I wrote a correct version Myself, only to be told it was too long.

column1: 我这里准备了【完整版】存档和【简略版】给主持人。记住，别再弄丢了。
column2: I've prepared a [Complete Version] archive and a [Condensed Version] for the host. Remember, don't lose them again.

column1: 根据记载，庆典前后魔物的数量会异常增多。我推测是狂欢气氛让它们兴奋了。你走之前帮忙清理十只，我会把这条写入明年手册。
column2: According to the records, monster populations rise abnormally before and after the festival. I suspect the festive atmosphere excites them. Take out 10 before You leave, and I'll add that to next year's manual.

column1: 定啦！剑士队一个月的队列不是白练的，法师队用冰雾做特效，服事队沿路送祝福——弓箭手队本来要表演射苹果，被我拦下了。
column2: It's settled! The Swordsman team's month of Lineup practice won't go to waste. The Mage team will use Ice Fog for special Effects, and the Acolyte team will offer Blessings along the route—the Archer team wanted to shoot apples with their Bows, but I put a stop to that.

column1: 一共四十八人，名单给你。能不能让孩子们走队伍前面？他们太兴奋，走后面会踩到前面人的披风。
column2: There are 48 people in all. Here's the list. Could the Kids walk at the front of the procession? They're so excited that if they walk in the back, they'll step on everyone else's Cloaks.

column1: 说实话，普隆德拉每次庆典都手忙脚乱，但看到大家——包括你这样的冒险者——这么帮忙，就觉得这座城市特别好。
column2: Honestly, every festival in Prontera is chaotic, but seeing everyone—including an Adventurer like You—pitch in makes me realize what a wonderful city this is.

column1: 这是给你的报酬。庆典记得来，善司的烟花虽然引信短，但肯定好看！
column2: Here's your reward. Don't forget to come to the festival. Seth's Fireworks may have short fuses, but they'll definitely be beautiful!

column1: 咦？连你也感觉到了？最近吉芬的元素流动确实不太对。
column2: Huh? You felt it too? The flow of Elements in Geffen has definitely seemed strange Recent.

column1: 帮我去找道具商人问问情况，他常年跟采集材料打交道，应该比我更清楚魔物的动向。
column2: Ask the Item Merchant what's going on. He works with gathered Materials year-round, so he should know more about the monsters' movements than I do.

column1: 你来得正好！毒蘑菇的孢子浓度高了不止一倍，我收上来的药材大半都废了。
column2: You're just in time! The concentration of Poison Mushroom spores has more than doubled, and over half the medicinal herbs I've collected are ruined.

column1: 微笑小姐前几天也抱怨过，说做面具用的杰勒比结晶老被魔物半路截走。你顺路去问问？
column2: Miss Smile was also complaining a few days ago. She said monsters keep intercepting the Jellopy she uses to make masks. Could You ask her about it while you're there?

column1: 哎呀冒险者，你脸上的表情比平时还紧张呢。我这儿材料不缺，但对街的异国商人前阵子路过时说，他手里有块能安抚魔物的古石。
column2: Oh my, Adventurer, your expression looks even more tense than usual. I'm not short on Materials, but the Foreign Merchant across the street said a while back that he had an ancient Stone that could calm monsters.

column1: 不过他早回梦罗克遗迹去了。跑一趟吧，那里的风沙虽然大，但线索应该还在。
column2: But he already returned to the Morroc Ruins. Head there. The sandstorms are fierce, but the Clue should still be there.

column1: 哦，你说那块石头？我确实收过，但已经转手给巴伊斯里特了。他说那东西跟吉芬塔的某个古封印有关。
column2: Oh, that Stone? I did acquire it, but I already passed it on to Baisulist. He said it was connected to an ancient seal in Geffen Tower.

column1: 不过你得抓紧，这几个月我见过的暴躁魔物，比过去三年加起来还多。这不是好兆头。
column2: But You need to hurry. I've seen more aggressive monsters over the past few months than I did in the previous 3 years combined. That's No good sign.

column1: 原来微笑小姐说的冒险者就是你。这块古石确实是封印碎片，封印松动引发了魔物异动。
column2: So You're the Adventurer Miss Smile mentioned. This ancient Stone is indeed a fragment of the seal. The weakening seal is what caused the monsters to become agitated.

column1: 阿欧鲁风在塔顶守阵。把碎片带去，他知道该怎么嵌回基座。
column2: Aorufeng is guarding the formation at the top of the tower. Take the fragment to him. He knows how to fit it back into the base.

column1: 终于到了。这块碎片归位，塔下的魔力场就能重新稳定。
column2: You're finally here. Once this fragment is back in place, the magical field beneath the tower will become stable again.

column1: 这一路从吉芬跑到梦罗克再折回来，辛苦你了。不过吉芬欠你这一笔，冒险者。
column2: You've worked hard traveling from Geffen to Morroc and all the way back. Geffen owes You one, Adventurer.

column1: 你是来帮吉芬那个青年的？他前几天来我店里挑了好久，最后说预算不够，蔫蔫地走了。
column2: Are You here to help that Young Man from Geffen? He spent ages browsing my shop a few days ago, but eventually said he couldn't afford anything and left looking dejected.

column1: 这样吧，我先帮你备一份手信。不过送货路上最近有魔物出没，去清一清，别让礼盒在路上被拱了。
column2: Tell You what—I'll prepare a gift for You first. But monsters have been appearing along the delivery route Recent, so clear them out before they trample the gift box.

column1: 稀客啊。你手里那个礼盒，缺个像样的装饰盒对吧？我可以做一个，但需要那种只在老树根部才有的香料木。
column2: Well, this is a surprise. That gift box You're holding needs a proper decorative case, right? I can make one, but I'll need the fragrant wood that only grows around the roots of ancient trees.

column1: 去问问宠物商人，他养的小波利们成天在林子里乱窜，应该知道哪棵树底下有好料。
column2: Ask the Pet Merchant. His little Porings run around the forest all day, so he should know which trees have good wood beneath them.

column1: 木料的事包在我身上！不过你得先帮我把附近那几只野狼赶走，我的波利们吓得两天没敢出笼了。
column2: I'll take care of the lumber! But first, you'll have to drive away those wolves Nearby. Me Porings have been too scared to leave their cages for two days.

column1: 这些小家伙胆子本来就小，你再不帮忙，香料木的位置我可就问不出来了。
column2: These little ones are timid enough already. If you don't help, I'll never get them to tell me where the spicewood is.

column1: 听说你在帮人备礼？来来，把这块风干火腿也带上。外出冒险的人，口袋里有块肉比什么都踏实。
column2: I hear you're helping someone prepare a gift. Here, take this dry-cured ham too. When you're out adventuring, nothing's more reassuring than having some meat in your pocket.

column1: 话说回来，你不觉得这阵子的魔物普遍躁得不太正常？魔物学者一直在攒样本，去聊两句，他在塔边那间小屋。
column2: Come to think of it, haven't the monsters seemed unusually restless lately? The Monsterologist has been collecting samples. Go have a word with him—he's in the little cabin by the tower.

column1: 你身上的战斗痕迹我一看就懂了。最近魔物的攻击频率和范围都在扩大，和塔的魔力波动完全同步。
column2: I can tell from your Battle scars. Recent monster attacks have increased in both frequency and range, perfectly in sync with the tower's magical fluctuations.

column1: 不过先不谈这个。那个青年托我转告你：东西如果备齐了，他在喷泉旁边等你。别让他等太久。
column2: But enough about that. The Young Man asked me to tell you that if everything's Ready, he'll be waiting by the fountain. Don't keep him waiting too long.

column1: 一样都没少。从普隆德拉到吉芬，从礼物到香料木到火腿……你真的一件一件帮我凑齐了。
column2: Not a single thing is missing. From Prontera to Geffen, from the gift to the spicewood and ham... You really helped me gather every last thing.

column1: 她会喜欢的。以后你想要什么，来喷泉这里找我就行。我叫雷亚，记住这个名字。
column2: She'll love it. If you ever need anything, just come find me here by the fountain. My name is Reia. Remember it.

column1: 天空裂隙的出现，预示着新世界的降临。那片未知之地蕴藏着强大的能量，而魔能晶石的魔法之力，或许是我们抵御未知的关键。只要全员齐心协力收集魔能晶石，也许就能迎击即将降临的力量。
column2: The appearance of the Sky Rift heralds the arrival of a new world. That unknown land holds immense energy, and the magical power of Arcane Crystals may be the key to defending ourselves against the unknown. If we all work together to gather Arcane Crystals, we may be able to withstand the power that is about to descend upon us.

column1: 是否将^{1}${1}^{2}个魔法晶石全部捐赠？你将获得^{3}${2}^{4}捐赠者徽章。
column2: Donate all ^{1}${1}^{2} Magic Crystals? You will receive ^{3}${2}^{4} Donor Badges.

column1: 哎呀，晶石捐赠需要公会支持呢…快去结识志同道合的战友吧！
column2: Oh, Crystal donations require the support of a guild... Go find some like-minded adventurers!

column1: 你还没有任何魔能晶石，攒攒再来吧。
column2: You don't have any Magic Crystals yet. Come back when you've collected some.

column2: This is test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the second line of the fourth quest. Ahahahaha!

column1: 德古拉逃跑的传送通道……
欢迎光临！卡普拉公司永远为你提供最优质的服务。\n请问需要什么服务呢？
column2: Welcome! The Kafra Corporation is always here to provide you with the finest service.\nHow may we assist you?

column1: 确认要传送到地图${1}吗，您需要花费${2}哦！
column2: Are you sure you want to teleport to ${1}? It will cost ${2}!
Do you want to leave the Realm Law Sandbox?

column1: 上交物资可以获得公会的奖励哦！
column2: Turn in supplies to earn guild rewards!
I want to turn in supplies.

column1: 今天的任务有完成吗，能领奖励哦！
column2: Did you finish today's task? You can claim your reward!

column1: 恭喜完成任务，这是给你的奖励！
column2: Congratulations on completing the task! Here's your reward!

column1: 欢迎光临，我是从卡普拉总公司被派遣到普隆德拉的投票宣传人员，请问能帮您什么吗？
column2: Welcome! I'm a voting campaign representative sent to Prontera by Kafra Headquarters. How may I help you?

column1: 这里是卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都普隆德拉，欢迎大家的到来，需要为您介绍吗？
column2: This is Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Welcome! Would you like an introduction?

column1: 您好，我是从准它企划社被派遣到这里的投票宣传人员，请问我能帮您什么吗？
column2: Hello! I'm a voting campaign representative sent here by the Zonda Planning Agency. How may I help you?

column1: 这里有普隆德拉开得最好的鲜花，冒险者，买一束鲜花吧！
column2: We have the finest flowers in Prontera! Adventurer, why not buy a bouquet?

column1: 给爱的人带一份礼物吧！
column2: Bring a gift to someone you love!

column1: 您想要什么道具？我这里应有尽有！
column2: What item are you looking for? I've got everything!

column1: 在这片土地的某个地方，有巨大的力量正在以微弱的面貌展露……
column2: Somewhere in this land, a tremendous power is beginning to reveal itself in subtle ways...

column1: 感觉到了吗？无法预知的惊人事件正在发生……
column2: Can you feel it? Something incredible and unpredictable is happening...

column1: 哎哟，真是的！他们都躲到哪里去了啊？
column2: Oh, come on! Where could they all be hiding?

column1: 扰乱王国安定的恶徒们，都会被我们勇猛的骑士团一扫而空！
column2: Our valiant knights will sweep away every villain who threatens the kingdom's peace!

column1: 听说城门附近有个不会唱歌的吟游诗人，你看到他了吗？
column2: I heard there's a bard near the city gate who can't sing. Have you seen him?

column1: 他们都说公会能交到很多好朋友，世界上真的有那么好的地方吗？
column2: They say you can make lots of friends in a guild. Could such a wonderful place really exist?

column1: 在喷泉底下真是凉快啊，你说是吗？
column2: It's so cool beneath the fountain, don't you think?

column1: 好无聊啊，呵嗯……这时候要唱歌，呵嗯……
column2: I'm so bored. Hmm... Times like these call for a song. Hmm...

column1: 休假那几天天气很好，我和家人去森林郊游，结果遇到了数量惊人的蜂群。
column2: The weather was lovely during my vacation, so my family and I went on a picnic in the forest. Then we ran into an enormous swarm of bees.

column1: 您知道吗？克瑞米的幼虫叫做绿棉虫，绿棉虫结成蛹后就叫做虫蛹。虽然它们以不同的形态出现，但其实属于同种昆虫，听说它们在沙漠中也能生存。
column2: Did you know? Creamy larvae are called Fabres, and when a Fabre forms a cocoon, it becomes a Pupa. Although their forms differ, they're actually the same species of Insect. They can even survive in the desert, or so I've heard.

column1: 普隆德拉骑士团会定期去讨伐魔物，既可修炼，又可保护城市治安，可谓一举两得。
column2: The Prontera Chivalry regularly hunts monsters. It keeps their skills sharp and the city safe—two birds with one stone.

column1: 努力做吧！我们的肩膀上肩负着普隆德拉的未来！
column2: Keep at it! The future of Prontera rests on our shoulders!

column1: 每天都很有成就感……参加骑士团果然是正确的决定，哈哈哈！
column2: Every day feels so rewarding... Joining the Chivalry was definitely the right choice! Hahaha!

column1: 风之阿斯泰尔，不会为任何人唱歌。
column2: Aster of the Wind sings for no one.

column1: 是只为自己唱歌的吟游诗人啊。
column2: A bard who sings only for himself.

column1: 我不会为你唱歌的，你走吧。
column2: I won't sing for you. Go away.

column1: 奥丁是我们所侍奉的神，他被称为战争之神，也叫子息之神。为了子女，他甚至可以牺牲屌自己的一只眼睛。
column2: Odin is the god we serve. He is known as both the God of War and the God of Children. He would even sacrifice one of his own eyes for his children.

column1: 听说那边喷水池里的铜像就是仿照他的模样雕塑出来的。
column2: I hear the bronze statue in that fountain was sculpted in his likeness.

column1: 欢迎光临橡木旅馆，我能为您服务什么？
column2: Welcome to the Oak Inn. How may I help you?

column1: 哦……你也散步啊？到这地方来散步也蛮奇怪的……
column2: Oh... Are you out for a walk too? This is a rather strange place for a stroll...
Hee-hee~ More and more people are showing up!

column1: 我们图书馆将卢恩王国各处的魔物分门别类整理得清清楚楚，馆藏着冒险家们必读的书籍，欢迎来阅览。
column2: Our library carefully classifies monsters from every corner of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. We house essential reading for every Adventurer, so please feel free to browse.
Would you like to trade headbands with me?

column1: 这地方的冒险家也太多了吧，不愧是一个王国的首都！
column2: There are so many Adventurers here! I guess that's to be expected in a kingdom's capital!

column1: 你好，是来交换微笑面具的吗？
column2: Hello! Are you here to trade for a Smiling Mask?

column1: 这里的武器都通过了各职业评定部门的认证，请放心购买。
column2: Every weapon here is certified by the assessment board for its respective class. Shop with confidence!

column1: 咱家的肉又便宜又新鲜，买不了吃亏买不了上当。
column2: Our meat is fresh and affordable. You can't go wrong!

column1: 自家果园种的水果，不好吃不要钱，快来尝尝吧！
column2: This fruit comes straight from our orchard. If it isn't delicious, it's free! Come try some!

column1: 我们正在征集充满好奇心与勇气的冒险家，勇士们快来挑战吧！
column2: We're looking for curious and courageous Adventurers. Brave souls, come take on the challenge!

column1: 我在找寻可以跟我同生共死的勇士！智力和体力兼备的勇士们啊，别再犹豫了，快加入我的行列吧！
column2: I'm looking for warriors who will stand with me through life and death! If you have both brains and brawn, hesitate no longer—join me!

column1: 只要拥有指引命运的华丽金属，神是绝对不会抛弃我们的！
column2: As long as we possess the brilliant Metal that guides our destiny, the gods will never abandon us!

column1: 喝！喝！哈！\n呼……现在有点自信了。普隆德拉骑士团万岁！
column2: Hah! Hah! Hyah!\nWhew... I'm feeling a little more confident now. Long live the Prontera Chivalry!

column1: 这里是魔法之都吉芬，欢迎大家的到来，需要为您介绍吗？
column2: This is Geffen, the City of Magic. Welcome! Would you like an introduction?

column1: 大家在衣橱可以搭配不同的装扮哦~
column2: You can mix and match different outfits in the Wardrobe~

column1: 您好，我是专门制作有趣游戏，并且带给人们欢乐的魔王老师门下第五号弟子，我叫妮雅。
column2: Hello! I'm Nia, the fifth disciple of the Demon Lord, who creates fun games and brings joy to everyone.

column1: 嘿~！人类你好呀~我是猫绵绵，哇哈哈~
column2: Hey~! Hello, human! I'm Meow-Mew! Wahaha~

column1: 听说从吉芬一直向南走会看到一大片森林，那里住着一种叫兽人的魔物。
column2: I hear that if you travel south from Geffen, you'll reach a vast forest inhabited by monsters called Orcs.

column1: 有人说他们也和人类一样，有着属于自己的语言和文化。
column2: Some say they have their own language and culture, just like humans.

column1: 什么是喝酒的好时机呢~？\n大地与太阳及月亮的日子~？
column2: When's a good time for a drink~?\nOn the days of earth, sun, and moon~?

column1: 哪一天最适合喝酒啊，\n为什么我只有一天可以喝呢？
column2: Which day is best for drinking?\nWhy do I only get to drink one day?

column1: 告诉我你喝酒的日子~？\n那我也会告诉你我喝酒的日子~？
column2: Tell me which day you drink~\nAnd I'll tell you which day I drink~.

column1: 听说这世上有一种魔幻手杖能将使用者的精力转换为物质的力量，藉以提高破坏力。
column2: I've heard of a Magic Staff that converts its wielder's mental energy into physical force, increasing its destructive power.

column1: 只要有了魔幻手杖，即使原本力量不大的人也能够利用精力的转换产生很大的力量。
column2: With a Magic Staff, even someone who isn't naturally strong can convert mental energy into tremendous physical power.

column1: 像今天这么好的天气，真想背着包去深山里采集稀奇又有趣的物品。
column2: On a beautiful day like this, I'd love to pack my bag and head deep into the mountains to gather rare and interesting items.

column1: 你相信哈茶教的奇迹吗？若相信就跟着我念咒语吧！哈茶布拉、哈茶布拉、哈茶布拉~~！！
column2: Do you believe in the miracles of Hacha? If you do, repeat this spell after me! Hachabra, Hachabra, Hachabra~~!!

column1: 天气好好啊，真是精炼的好日子！
column2: What beautiful weather! It's a perfect day for refining!

column1: 冒险之路漫漫，先填饱肚子吧！
column2: The road of adventure is long, so fill your belly before you set out!

column1: 已经过去的事件不会再回来，即使是再伟大的魔法力量，我们在对话的此刻时间也正在流走。
column2: Past events will never return. Even the greatest magic cannot change that—as we speak, time continues to flow.

column1: 在艾尔帕兰有一位实力不错的武器制作匠人，和他的四个儿子生活在一起。
column2: In Al De Baran, there is a skilled weaponsmith who lives with his four sons.

column1: 可在一次研发武器的过程中，他的四个儿子全都不幸丧生，只有他一个人活下来了。
column2: But while developing a new weapon, all four of his sons tragically lost their lives. He alone survived.

column1: 孵蛋器可以用来孵化可爱的宠物哦，要试试吗？
column2: You can use an incubator to hatch an adorable pet. Want to try?
Hmm... I need to put the song...

column1: 有一本研究魔法的古书曾经提到过，传说形成这世界的天地树叶子、种子和果实，与天地万物的生命息息相关……
column2: An ancient tome on magic once mentioned that Legend says the Yggdrasil Leaf, seeds, and fruit that shaped this world are closely connected to all Life in creation...

column1: 为什么你所见到的我，不是贤者中最优秀的贤者呢？
column2: Why am I not the most Excellent Sage you've ever seen?

column1: 如果没事的话，请赶快从我面前闪开吧！
column2: If you have no business with me, please get out of my sight!

column1: 因为我要思考，我不想被一位没有事情做的人打扰。
column2: Because I need to think, and I don't want to be disturbed by someone with nothing better to do.

column1: 您好，我是周游世界研究魔物生态的学者。你愿意帮我搜集一些生态研究的必要物品吗？
column2: Greetings. I'm a scholar who travels the world studying monster ecology. Would you help me collect some items essential to my research?

column1: 我的名字叫善司，我喜欢折纸。
column2: My name is Zenji, and I like origami.

column1: 我昨天折了一个巨大的船送给妈妈，妈妈说了谢谢，还摸了我的头！
column2: Yesterday, I folded a huge boat for Mom. She said, "Thank You," and patted me on the head!

column1: 听说在草原上生活的蜂兵一生都遵循着蜂后的命令采集蜂蜜。
column2: I hear the Hornets living on the plains spend their entire lives gathering Honey under the Mistress's orders.

column1: 据说那些蜂蜜不但味道甘甜鲜美，营养价值也很高，能卖很高的价位。
column2: They say that Honey isn't just sweet and delicious—it's also highly nutritious and sells for a hefty price.

column1: 真是的，这里离艾尔贝塔太远了，订购的物品拿不到真麻烦啊……
column2: Honestly, Alberta is so far away. It's such a pain that I can't pick up the items I ordered...

column1: 呼呼呼，我终于发现！在头上长出香菇的魔法是一个非常可怕的魔法!
column2: Heh heh heh! At last, I Discover the truth! Magic that makes mushrooms grow on your head is truly terrifying!

column1: 在头上长出香菇的话会对日常生活很不方便的，所以要重新拔起来，制作成发圈！
column2: Having mushrooms growing on your head makes everyday life terribly inconvenient, so you have to pull them out and turn them into hair ties!

column1: 请问你有事吗？如果没事，我就告辞了……
column2: Did you need something? If not, I'll be on my way...

column1: 剑士不需要别的技能，只要一拳！狂击！狂击！狂击！就好了！
column2: Swordsmen don't need any other skills—just one punch! Bash! Bash! Bash! That's all it takes!

column1: 是剑士的话就善用怒爆吧！狂击只是修炼怒爆的中间过程而已！
column2: If you're a Swordsman, make good use of Magnum Break! Bash is merely a stepping stone on the path to mastering Magnum Break!

column1: 离开吧~两个人将一切抛诸脑后~在爪哇蓝天星空下~
column2: Let's run away~ Just the two of us, leaving everything behind~ Beneath Java's blue skies and starry nights~

column1: 为了纪念我们结婚@{1}周年，我们决定到新婚旅行时曾去过的爪哇！
column2: To celebrate our @{1}th wedding anniversary, we've decided to return to Java, where we spent our honeymoon!

column1: 想念另一半的时候，就要像这样呐喊！
column2: When you miss your beloved, you have to shout like this!

column1: 那么，亲爱的就会抛下手边的工作，立刻向我飞奔而来，对吧？
column2: Then my darling will drop everything and come running straight to me, right?

column1: 我叫他，他当然就要来呀~亲爱的，爱你哦！
column2: When I call him, of course he has to come~ Darling, I love you!

column1: 你好，我是炼金术师，是从商人转职过来的职业。
column2: Hello! I'm an Alchemist, a class that Merchants can reach through Job Advance.

column1: 我正在制作药水，果然制作药水要在安静的地方，感觉成功的几率会比较高。
column2: I'm making potions. A quiet place really does feel like it improves the chances of success.

column1: 既然来到了伊斯鲁德，我有一股好预感，呵，出现吧！
column2: Now that I'm in Izlude, I've got a good feeling about this. Heh... Appear!

column1: 长期以来一直生不出孩子，就在十年前突然老来得子。
column2: We couldn't have a child for many years, but ten years ago, we were unexpectedly blessed with a son in our old age.

column1: 虽然我很想要好好疼惜我那宝贝儿子，但是老婆却说要以严厉的方式管教。
column2: I want to cherish my precious son, but my wife says we need to discipline him strictly.

column1: 我很担心这样下去，我唯一的儿子行为会变得偏差。
column2: I'm worried that if this continues, my only son will go astray.

column1: 这应该是所有当父母亲的烦恼吧？
column2: I suppose every parent worries about this, don't they?

column1: 你有没有看见我们家那蹦蹦跳跳玩耍的金寿限无呢？
column2: Have you seen our little Jugem bouncing around and playing?

column1: 那小子又跑去哪鬼混了？连待在家里一个小时都办不到！
column2: Where has that boy run off to now? He can't even stay home for a single hour!

column1: 嗯？怎么回事，这是什么地方？
column2: Huh? What's going on? Where am I?

column1: 你正与某个人相爱着吗？
column2: Are you in love with someone?

column1: 祝你一路顺风，凯旋而归！

column2: Drink plenty of Milk if you want to grow tall!

column1: 喵呜，虾子真好吃！瞅什么瞅，我吃那么多才证明虾子新鲜嘛！
column2: Meow, these shrimp are delicious! What are you staring at? The fact that I can eat so many just proves how fresh they are!

column1: 坐在那边的青年……已经连续好几个小时盯着精炼机器了。他好像失去所有武器，只剩下一把小刀了？
column2: That young man sitting over there... He's been staring at the refining machine for hours. It looks like he's lost all his weapons and only has a small knife left?

column1: 嘘！安静一点！我现在正专注于精炼道具。
column2: Shh! Keep it down! I'm concentrating on refining an item.

column1: 可以通过精炼强化道具，特别是武器攻击力会上升，精炼成功的话会有相当大的帮助的。
column2: Refining can Enhance items. Weapons in particular gain ATK, so a successful refinement can be a tremendous help.
Appear! Please, hurry up and appear!

column1: 这里是卫星城市伊斯鲁德岛，欢迎大家的到来，需要为您介绍吗？
column2: Welcome to Izlude Island, a satellite city. Would you like an introduction?
I gave it everything I had.
Shilude will return safely, won't they?

column1: 呃……你好，冒险家，我累得已经动不了了……
column2: Uh... Hello, adventurer. I'm so exhausted I can't even move...
I'm exhausted after working for a while...

column1: 但为了席鲁德都是值得的……
column2: But it's all worth it for Shilude...

column1: 我很喜欢这里。你走吧，这里不是你可以待的地方。
column2: I like it here. Now leave—this is no place for you.

column1: 感谢使用我们巴基力航空。需要乘坐飞空艇吗？
column2: Thank You for flying with Valkyrie Air. Would you like to board an airship?

column1: 在斐扬东南方入口处，有一个连接沙漠和森林的桥梁，在那可以看到所有种类的波利，是一个非常可爱的地方。
column2: At the entrance to Southeast Payon, there's a bridge connecting the desert and the forest. You can see every kind of Poring there—it's an absolutely adorable place.

column1: 真心欢迎您来到伊斯鲁德岛，我们伊斯鲁德岛是首都普隆德拉的卫星城市，不仅训练剑士，也负责海洋巡逻，是非常重要的城市。
column2: Welcome to Izlude Island! Izlude is a satellite city of the capital, Prontera. We not only train Swordsmen, but also patrol the seas, making this a very important city.

column1: 很久以前会用死刑处置要犯，用来执行这项任务的魔剑就叫死神之剑。
column2: Long ago, serious criminals were sentenced to death. The enchanted sword used for their executions was called the Executioner.

column1: 这里的竞技场是让全国年轻人试验自己的能力的地方，会依据你的等级召唤出不同魔物和你决斗。怎么样啊，你要不要挑战一下呢?
column2: This arena gives young people from across the kingdom a chance to test their skills. It summons different monsters to duel you based on your level. So, would you like to take on the challenge?

column1: 嘿嘿嘿~嗯？什么事让我这么高兴？告诉你吗？
column2: Heh heh heh~ Hm? Want to know why I'm so happy?

column1: 啊啊……最近很难找工作，我想你也知道吧？
column2: Ahh... It's hard to find work these days. I'm sure you know that, right?

column1: 抓到魔物从他们身上取得战利品后卖给商人的话，是个可观的收入呢！
column2: You can make a tidy profit by hunting monsters and selling their loot to merchants!

column1: 人类长得可真稀奇。没有毛的巨大猫咪……？
column2: Humans look so strange. Are they... giant hairless cats?

column1: 咳嗽~!我们伊斯鲁德岛，不只负责路地上的安全，还负责那宽广的海洋的安全！架设大望远镜可以看到远海，可提前做准备来应对危机。
column2: Ahem! Izlude Island is responsible for protecting not only the land, but the vast seas as well! Our large telescope lets us watch the distant waters so we can be Ready for any crisis.

column1: 所有的事情提早做准备，是一定要的啦！
column2: You've always got to be prepared!

column1: 王立克里图拉学院是为了帮助第一次踏\n进这个世界的许多年轻人而创立的。
column2: The Royal Criatura Academy was founded to help the many young people taking their first steps\ninto this world.

column1: 虽然我是做杂务的小员工，每次看到毕业后坦荡荡地踏进这个世界的朋友，真的会让我感到高兴。
column2: I'm just a low-ranking employee who does odd jobs, but seeing our graduates stride confidently into the world always makes me happy.

column1: 这里是沙漠之都梦罗克，欢迎大家的到来，需要为您介绍吗？
column2: Welcome to Morroc, the Desert City! Would you like me to tell you about it?

column1: 看什么看，气死我了，你别来烦我哦！
column2: What are you looking at? I'm furious, so leave me alone!

column1: 嘻嘻……打嗝!你是外地来的吧？相见自是有缘，我来告诉你一件事，这是我刚在酒店里喝一杯时偶然间听到的呢~
column2: Hee hee... Hic! You're from out of town, aren't you? Since fate brought us together, I'll let you in on something I happened to overhear while having a drink at the tavern~

column1: 魔王梦罗克复活了，好像是穿越时空的裂缝出来的吧……打嗝……
column2: Demon King Morroc has apparently returned through a Revive, emerging from a rift in time and space... Hic...

column1: 看起来乱七八糟的破烂堆。
column2: It looks like a jumbled pile of junk.

column1: 你看什么？嗯？我的名字很好笑吗？
column2: What are you looking at? Huh? Is my name funny?

column1: 哈哈，你这个人什么都不知道！这个可是艺名啊，艺名！是指在沙子上不留痕迹的盗贼的意思。多么帅气的艺名啊!
column2: Ha! You don't know anything! It's a stage name—a stage name! It means a Thief who leaves no tracks in the sand. What a cool stage name!

column1: 噗呼，人生啊，钱啊，真是……这肮脏的世界！
column2: Pfft. Life, money... What a filthy world!
Sheesh... Ptooey... What are you looking at?!

column1: 你有听说过被诅咒的@{1}种宝石的相关故事吗?
column2: Have you heard the Story of the Curse on the @{1} types of gems?

column1: 听说最近那四种宝石之一的破灭之钻石，突然出现了……
column2: I heard that the Diamond of Ruin, one of those four gems, suddenly appeared recently...

column1: 呼~今天也好热，怎么会这么热？
column2: Phew~ It's so hot again today. Why does it have to be this hot?

column1: ……订购的物品到底什么时候才到呢？我要生气啦！
column2: ...When are the items I ordered finally going to arrive? I'm starting to get angry!

column1: 村落已经半毁了，竟然还有人跑来这里……这对秘密基地影响不大吧？
column2: The village is half destroyed, yet people are still coming here... That shouldn't affect the secret base much, right?

column1: 嗯……我是为了……重建梦罗克事业……而被派这里……工作的人。
column2: Um... I was sent here... to work on... the reconstruction of Morroc.

column1: 跟死去的人见面基本上是不可能的事情。假设真的可以见面的话，死亡者的灵魂跟活着的时候相比，是完全没有任何记忆的存在吧。
column2: Meeting someone who has died is essentially impossible. Even if it were possible, their soul would probably have none of the memories they had while alive.

column1: 如果可以让他感受到生前常接触的事情，会有让他重新恢复记忆的可能性吗？
column2: If they experienced things that were familiar to them in life, could that possibly restore their memories?

column1: 听说有把用比钢铁还要坚硬的兽人犬齿做成的魔剑，它的名称叫做魔短剑，只有住\n在普隆德拉的某个铁匠知道制作的方法。
column2: I've heard of an enchanted sword called Mysteltainn, made from an Orc's canine tooth harder than steel. Only a certain Blacksmith living\nin Prontera knows how to make it.

column1: 可惜的是，那个铁匠已经离开普隆德拉，不知去向了。
column2: Unfortunately, that Blacksmith has left Prontera, and no one knows where they went.

column1: 你好，天气不错啊？嗯……若没关系的话，我可以讲一些我的事情吗?
column2: Hello. Lovely weather, isn't it? Um... If you don't mind, may I tell you a little about myself?

column1: 这沙漠之都梦罗克有它的奇妙的魅力所在。白天是大太阳，有热风，夕阳的时候丘陵会染成红色的，还有能被冻僵的凌晨……这些东西都是梦罗克的骄傲。
column2: Morroc, the Desert City, has a charm all its own. The blazing sun and hot winds by day, the hills dyed red at sunset, and the freezing hours before dawn... These are all sources of pride for Morroc.

column1: 不过还是一样，人类的贪心是没有底线的。\n所以除了这些沙漠的东西，其它物品，也想放在自己的身边呢。
column2: But human greed knows no bounds.\nSo, besides these treasures of the desert, I also want to surround myself with things from elsewhere.

column1: 我是个喜欢周游列国的旅行家，这里的天气真热啊。
column2: I'm a traveler who loves journeying from country to country. It certainly is hot here.

column1: 我们家远早在以马车为主要交通工具时代就开始制作交通号志牌，至今已经有两百五十年的历史了。
column2: Our family began making traffic signs long before horse-drawn carriages became the main form of transportation. We have been in business for two hundred and fifty years.

column1: 这叔叔好可怕！妈妈！帮我找妈妈！呜啊啊啊啊！
column2: That man is scary! Mommy! Help me find my mommy! Waaaaah!

column1: 就算沙子灰尘飘来飘去，我也会认得你，就像夜空里那唯一闪烁的星星一样。
column2: Even with sand and dust swirling through the air, I'd recognize you like the one shining star in the night sky.

column1: 所以请放心吧，那闪耀的太阳以及，沙漠上恐怖的沙子风也是~
column2: So don't worry. Not even the blazing sun or the terrifying desert sandstorms could stop me~

column1: 一定会认出你……走……快走啊！没看到我在忙吗？
column2: I'd definitely recognize you... Go... Get out of here! Can't you see I'm busy?

column1: 我正在寻找宝藏，听说知道内幕的人就住在梦罗克村落的北方。
column2: I'm searching for treasure. I heard someone with inside information lives north of Morroc Village.

column1: 如果已被挖走就没办法了，但可以再问问看，或许还能挖得到其它情报。
column2: If it's already been dug up, there's nothing we can do. Still, we could ask around. Maybe we can dig up some other information.

column1: 因为有夕阳，才会有日出。因为有在阴暗角落里一直努力不懈的梦罗克游牧民族的存在，才会有不会干涸的水资源供给着梦罗克。
column2: Just as every sunset brings a sunrise, Morroc's tireless nomads labor in the shadows to maintain the inexhaustible water supply that sustains Morroc.

column1: 呵，最近不管是冒险家或旅行家，进出村落里的人变多了，都分辨不出谁是村民谁是旅行家。
column2: Heh. So many adventurers and travelers have been coming and going lately that I can't tell the villagers from the visitors anymore.

column1: 买一个戒指吧，送给你的心上人。
column2: Buy a ring for your sweetheart.

column1: 你没有心上人？那还可以买一个送给我呀！
column2: You don't have a sweetheart? Then you can buy one for me!

column1: （小声）这里出售一些秘密装备，要看看吗？
column2: (Whispering) I sell some secret equipment here. Want to take a look?

column1: 魔镜魔镜，快告诉我谁是世界上最美丽的人？
column2: Magic mirror, tell me true: Who's the fairest of them all?

column1: 你知道吗？永恒玫瑰是沙漠里才有的花。
column2: Did you know? The Witherless Rose only grows in the desert.
Bananas... Heh heh... Bananas for sale... Heh heh...

column1: 走过路过不要错过，你会需要这些道具的！
column2: Come one, come all! You'll need these items!

column1: 钻石恒久远，一颗永流传。

column2: Buying monster drops at top prices!

column1: 我是专业的宝石鉴赏家，这里卖的可都是尖货！
column2: I'm a professional gem appraiser, and I only sell the finest gems!

column1: 这里是山岳之都斐扬，欢迎大家的到来，需要为您介绍吗？
column2: Welcome to Payon, the Mountain City! Would you like me to tell you about it?

column1: 这里有许多树木和花草，它们就像是能够给予我力量一样。
column2: There are so many trees and flowers here. They seem to fill me with strength.

column1: 我是技术员雷亚布连，负责强化武器和防具。虽然这是相当辛苦的工作，但有许多乐趣。
column2: I'm Leavren, the technician in charge of Enhance services for weapons and armor. It's hard work, but also a lot of fun.

column1: 每晚都喝得酩酊大醉，让我的头好痛~好想喝一瓶淡黄色的药水哦~嗝~
column2: Getting completely drunk every night is making my head hurt~ I could really use a bottle of pale yellow Potion~ Hic~

column1: 你好，穿越树林来这里吃了不少苦头吧？近来斐扬魔物肆虐，来的游客少了许多，真是遗憾。
column2: Hello! Traveling through the forest to get here must've been rough. Monsters have been running rampant around Payon lately, so we don't get nearly as many visitors. It's such a shame.

column1: 害得我跟姐妹们的话题也减少了许多，真是的~
column2: And now my friends and I have so much less to talk about. Honestly~

column1: 哎唷，怎么那么多嘴，对一个陌生人也可以滔滔不绝地说一大堆话。
column2: Oh my, what a chatterbox! She'll talk a stranger's ear off without a second thought.

column1: 你可别误会了，斐扬的人并不是全都像她一样话多的。
column2: Don't get the wrong idea. Not everyone in Payon is as talkative as she is.

column1: 不过，我们好像没见过面哦？
column2: But I don't think we've met before, have we?

column1: 过去这个地方曾经有连吃饭、生活都很艰难的时期。
column2: There was once a time when people here struggled just to eat and survive.

column1: 人死去甚至没有埋葬的钱，有些人的尸体就被悄悄放在洞窟里。
column2: People couldn't even afford burials for the dead, so some bodies were secretly left in the caves.

column1: 听说附近洞窟的尸体因为无法去往九泉至今徘徊在尘世间。啊啊，好可怕呀……
column2: They say the bodies in the nearby caves couldn't pass on to the afterlife, so they still wander this world. Ahh, how terrifying...

column1: 密码就是艺术品！抽丝剥茧揭晓秘密时的快感你懂吗？
column2: Ciphers are works of art! Do you know the thrill of unraveling every layer until the secret is finally revealed?

column1: 就是为了享受那种感觉，我今天也在卖力地研究密码……好骄傲啊……
column2: I’m working hard studying ciphers today just to experience that feeling... I’m so proud...

column1:
唱歌~唱歌~
德布哈摩尼的歌~
生命树啊~
那是常绿树之天地树，
column2:
Sing~ Sing~
The song of Debuha Moni~
O Tree of Life~
The World Tree, evergreen,

column1:
那是覆盖天空的梣树，
白色的露水渗湿了伟大的树木，
白色的露水滴下来成了洪水，
是涵盖乌尔德泉的常绿树。
column2:
The ash tree that blankets the sky,
White dew soaks the mighty tree,
White dew falls and becomes a flood,
The evergreen tree that embraces Urd's Well.

column1: 天啊~~斐扬的大帅哥回来了！想不到小时候调皮捣蛋的小鬼，现在居然变得这么帅气啰……
column2: My goodness~~ Payon's most handsome man has returned! Who would've thought that mischievous little rascal would grow up to be so handsome...

column1: 和我这老太婆曾经是青梅竹马呢，哼哼哼~用我的美貌来诱惑一下他吧？
column2: He and this old lady were childhood sweethearts, you know. Hehehe~ Perhaps I'll tempt him with my beauty?

column1: 来了就别废话，拿出要精炼的装备吧！
column2: If you're here, stop wasting time and show me the equipment you want refined!

column1: 我是负责强化武器和防具的技术员。虽然也有人说这只是小事情，但这都是外行人的偏颇说辞罢了。
column2: I'm the technician responsible for Enhancing weapons and armor. Some people say it's trivial work, but that's merely the biased opinion of amateurs.

column1: 我名为凤凰，在被恶势力污染的这世界，努力净化自己，做一个专注的修炼者。
column2: My name is Phoenix. In this world tainted by evil, I strive to purify myself and remain devoted to my training.

column1: ……你呀，没事那样子盯着人看，很没礼貌呀。
column2: ...You know, it's rude to stare at someone like that for no reason.

column1: 大家好，我是微笑小姐。有什么我可以帮上忙的地方吗？
column2: Hello, everyone! I'm Miss Smile. Is there anything I can help you with?
Broken watches and hair for sale~

column1: 依稀记得小时候和父亲跟着商队的事——好像是路过此地时被巨蛇攻击而脱离商队了。那时跟家人失散，现在连父亲长什么样子都不记得了。
column2: I vaguely remember traveling with my father and a caravan as a child. I think a giant snake attacked us as we passed through here, separating us from the caravan. I was separated from my family, and now I can't even remember what my father looked like.

column1: 如今我也有自己的商队，生活富裕，但那时的阴影仍挥之不去。
column2: Now I have my own caravan and live comfortably, but the shadow of that day still haunts me.

column1: 我以为来这里可以找到家人的踪迹，可惜年代久远毫无线索。
column2: I thought I might find a Clue to my family's whereabouts here, but unfortunately, so much time has passed that there are no clues left.

column1: 大概十四五岁的时候，我有个暗恋的男生。为了引起他的注意，我去欺负他的大嘴鸟，后来大吵一架。
column2: When I was about fourteen or fifteen, I had a crush on a boy. To get his attention, I picked on his Peco Peco, and we ended up having a huge fight.

column1: 结果我和他情投意合交往了，哎唷！我自己都有点害羞！
column2: It turned out we both felt the same way, and we started dating. Oh my! I'm getting a little Shy just talking about it!

column1: 我们最后结婚了，只是他因为没有送我结婚戒指一直很内疚。
column2: We eventually got married, but he always felt guilty for not giving me a wedding ring.

column1: 结婚四十周年时他出门给我买戒指，从此杳无音讯。
column2: On our fortieth anniversary, he went out to buy me a ring and never returned.

column1: 我服侍的小姐身子不好，老是咳嗽，所以一直服用止咳药。
column2: The young lady I served was in poor health and always coughing, so she regularly took cough medicine.

column1: 那天每月按时送到的药材一直没到，听说是商队被巨蛇攻击了。
column2: One day, the medicinal herbs delivered every month failed to arrive. I heard the caravan had been attacked by a giant snake.

column1: 小姐最后不幸去世了。我在这附近找那条蛇好多年了。
column2: Sadly, the young lady eventually passed away. I've spent years searching this area for that snake.

column1: 奇屯，很久前死去，没什么遗憾，奇屯不是坏人。
column2: Gitan died long ago. Gitan has no regrets. Gitan isn't bad.

column1: 奇屯……需要手镯，奇屯的手镯很珍贵。
column2: Gitan... needs bracelet. Gitan's bracelet is precious.

column1: 奇屯找到手镯之后要去找那条蛇，是那条坏蛇杀了奇屯。
column2: After Gitan finds bracelet, Gitan will find that snake. Bad snake killed Gitan.

column1: 对我这么孤独的人生来说，还有什么事情来找我呢？
column2: What could possibly bring anyone to someone living such a lonely Life?

column1: 斐扬的扫把是最好用的了！
啊！啊啊啊啊啊~！啊啊！！咳咳！
我知道你为什么试着对我说话。因为我头上戴的黑猫耳朵太可爱了，对吧？嘿嘿。
column2: I know why you tried talking to me. It's because the Black Cat Ears I'm wearing are so cute, right? Hehe.
This is the Payon Palace Annex.

column1: 我是渴望幸运的男子！请带给我好运吧吧吧吧吧！
column2: I am a man who yearns for luck! Bring me good luuuuuuck!

column1: 我需要的只有一个！四叶幸运草啦啦啦啦！
column2: There's only one thing I need! A four-leaf Lucky Cloverrrrr!

column1: 有人能帮我找到四叶幸运草吗！！！
column2: Can anyone help me find a four-leaf Lucky Clover?!

column1: 魔物研究会是为了解决魔物所衍生出来的问题，在特里斯坦陛下的支持下所成立的研究组织。
column2: With the support of His Majesty Tristan, the Monster Research Society was founded to resolve problems caused by monsters.

column1: 目前正聚集大陆各方面的人才，通过研究和探险挖掘魔物们的根源。
column2: We're currently gathering talented people from across the continent to uncover the origins of monsters through research and exploration.

column1: 可以跟我换不同颜色的魔力矿石哦。
column2: You can exchange different-colored magic ores with me.

column1: 以后的事情还是要交给年轻人啊，都没有我们老一辈的立足之地了。
column2: The future belongs to the young. There's no place left for us old-timers anymore.

column1: 嗯？是后山洞穴里的事，那里发生的事情让大家很担心。
column2: Hm? You mean the cave in the mountain behind us? What's happening there has everyone worried.

column1: 欢迎光临制作人巢穴！卡普拉公司在这里也能为您提供最优质的服务
column2: Welcome to the Producer's Lair! The Kafra Corporation is here to provide you with the finest service.

column1: 关于商店有任何疑问都可以询问我哟~
column2: If you have any questions about the shop, just ask me~

column1: 这就是米德加兹大陆吗？跟我的故乡有点像呢。
column2: So this is the Midgard Continent? It looks a little like my homeland.

column1: 我一定会通过初心者考核的！
column2: I'll definitely pass the Novice exam!

column1: 别，别过来……我有点晕船，呕……
column2: D-don't come any closer... I'm a little seasick. Ugh...

column1: 我很享受这份志愿者的工作，帮助别人能让我感受到生命的意义。
column2: I really enjoy volunteering. Helping others gives my Life meaning.

column1: 我看过许多风景，但还没找到想留下的地方。
column2: I've seen countless sights, but I still haven't found a place where I want to stay.

column1: 沙漠里经常有一些中暑的人，你要注意补充水分啊！
column2: People often suffer from heatstroke in the desert, so make sure you stay hydrated!

column1: 我会一直为芙蕾雅大人而祈祷。
column2: I will always pray to Lady Freyja.

column1: 嗨，冒险者，又见面了！最近怎么样？
column2: Hey, Adventurer! Good to see you again! How have you been?

column1: 欢迎光临～今天刚煮了新鲜的咖啡，从门口就能闻到香味吧？
column2: Welcome! We just brewed a fresh pot of coffee today. You could smell it from the door, couldn't you?

column1: 唉，老房子就这样，修一个地方，旁边又裂了。
column2: Ah, that's how it is with old houses. Fix one spot, and another crack appears right next to it.

column1: 这条街下午还要再逛一次，刚才走太快了，没看仔细。
column2: We'll have to walk this street again this afternoon. We went too fast earlier, so I didn't get a good look.

column1: 走了一上午，终于肯坐下来歇会儿了。
column2: After walking all morning, she's finally willing to Sit down and take a break.

column1: 其实我早就想休息了，就是她说还有一条街没逛……
column2: I've wanted to rest for ages, but she said there was still one more street to explore...

column1: 老国王失踪已经好几年了，该选出新的继承人了吧？
column2: The old king has been missing for years. Isn't it time to choose a new successor?

column1: 哦哟哟老兄弟，这可不兴在街上说。
column2: Whoa there, old friend. You can't go saying things like that in the street.

column1: （小声）我最看好巴特家的王子，这个年轻人很有野心呢。
column2: (whispering) My money's on the prince of House Bart. That Young Man is quite ambitious.

column1: 还是凯渥宝乐格家最有胜算吧，毕竟现在执政的是……
column2: House Kavo Barlög still has the best chance, doesn't it? After all, the current ruler is...

column1: 现在年轻人天天往城外跑，也不知道图什么。
column2: Young people run Outside the City every day now. No idea what they're after.

column1: 你那时候比他们跑得还快。
column2: You ran even faster than they do.
Let's go, let's go! We'll set out at dawn~

column1: 背包里装着干粮和一张旧地图~
column2: There's some travel food and an old map in the Backpack~
The map was left behind by the last traveler~

column1: 有几条路已经不存在了~
column2: Some of the roads don't exist anymore~
That's all right. You make your own path~

column1: 鞋底破了可以换，方向错了可以转~
column2: Worn-out soles can be replaced, and a wrong turn can be corrected~

column1: 就是那壶水，记得出门前装满~
column2: And that water flask—remember to fill it before you leave~

column1: 他今天状态特别好，你们听那个高音——
column2: He's in amazing form today. Just listen to that high note—

column1: 再听一首，就一首，我就真的走了。
column2: One more song. Just one, and then I'm really leaving.

column1: （打呵欠）说好在这里碰面，她怎么还没来？
column2: (yawning) We agreed to meet here. Why isn't she here yet?

column1: 今天到此为止，材料不多了，理智一点。
column2: That's enough for today. We're low on Material, so be sensible.

column1: 这一段，有点触动到我了。
我这个人不轻易动感情的，但艺术嘛……
column2: I'm not easily moved, but art is...
Those who get it, get it.

column1: 第二次没过……但我知道哪里出了问题。
column2: I failed the second time... but I know what went wrong.

column1: 下次申请考核是一个月后，一个月，能练很多东西的。
column2: I can submit another evaluation Request in a month. A month is plenty of time to practice.

column1: 真不知道乐园团招的是哪种人……
column2: I really have No idea what kind of people the Eden Group is looking for...

column1: 来看看来看看，普隆德拉一等一的表演，不收门票只收缘分！
column2: Come one, come all! See the finest show in Prontera! No admission fee—just a fateful encounter!

column1: 缘分到了，投个币；缘分没到，站着看也行。
column2: If you feel a connection, toss me a coin. If not, you're welcome to stand and watch.

column1: 好大的钉子，是谁把它钉在那儿的？
column2: That's a huge nail. Who hammered it in there?

column1: 感受到了吗？这里的能量场很奇特……
column2: Can you feel it? The energy field here is quite unusual...
...Wait. This contradicts what was written in the previous volume.

column1: （翻回去）果然矛盾……作者自己都没发现吗?
column2: (flipping back) It does contradict it... Did the author not even notice?

column1: 就那种……吃了会肚子不舒服的，不会有事吧？
column2: You know... the kind that gives you an upset stomach. It won't cause any real harm, right?

column1: 放心，我卖出去几十单了，都是拉完就好的那种。
column2: Don't worry. I've sold dozens of orders, and everyone was fine once they'd emptied their bowels.
It's exam season. Business is good.

column1: 这个价格包含两包，通常一包就够，两包保险。
column2: This price includes two packets. One is usually enough, but the second is insurance.

column1: 那万一他喝了没反应呢？
column2: But what if he drinks it and nothing happens?

column1: 没有没反应这种情况，我做生意讲信用的。
column2: There's no chance it won't work. I run an honest business.

column1: 你要树立一个目标，好好努力，以后来这里学习。
column2: Set yourself a goal, work hard, and come Learn here someday.

column1: 不要老是看地板，抬头看看，把这里记住。
column2: Stop staring at the floor. Look up and remember this place.

column1: 以后我的画像也挂在这里就好了……
column2: Someday, I hope they'll hang a portrait of Me here too...

column1: 这位活了多少岁……八十七。
column2: How long did this one live... 87 years.

column1: 没事，就是补考，很正常的，很多人都补考的。
column2: No worries. It's just a make-up exam. It's perfectly normal—lots of people take them.

column1: 年轻的时候没机会读，现在有时间了。
column2: I never had the chance to study when I was young, but now I have the time.

column1: 我做了一个表，列了每个职业的优缺点。
column2: I made a chart listing the pros and cons of each class.

column1: 可是看完表之后更不知道选哪个了。
column2: But after looking it over, I have even less of an idea which one to choose.

column1: 我已经决定转职成魔法师了！
column2: I've decided to Job Advance into a Magic Mage!

column1: 我数@{1}秒，他要是再不跟我道歉，我们就分手！
column2: I'm counting to @{1}. If he still hasn't apologized by then, we're breaking up!

column1: 我只是问了一句“还要逛多久”，她就生气了……
column2: All I did was ask, “How much longer are we going to shop?” and she got Angry...

column1: 我的语气也没有不耐烦吧？
column2: I didn't Sound impatient, did I?

column1: 新鲜的水果蔬菜！快来挑，快来买！
column2: Fresh fruits and vegetables! Come take a look and buy some!

column1: 海水拍打的声音让我感觉很平静。
column2: The Sound of the waves makes me feel Calm.

column1: 你是来玩的吗，第一次来伊斯鲁德？
column2: Are you here on vacation? Is this your first time in Izlude?
All right, all right. Izlude is great.

column1: 有人在这里贴通缉令——白色四脚生物，叼走一条鱼，身手敏捷……
column2: Someone posted a wanted notice here—a white four-legged creature carried off a fish in its mouth and is very agile...

column1: 前几天看到一张委托传单，报酬还挺高的。
column2: I saw a commission flyer a few days ago. The reward was pretty good.
...It's gone. Did someone take it down?

column1: 就坐一分钟，坐一分钟就好，实在打不动了……
column2: I'll just sit for one minute. Just one minute. I really can't keep fighting...

column1: 师父说，打蚁卵是这阶段最好的练功方式。
column2: My master says fighting Ant Eggs is the best way to train at this stage.

column1: 我会努力打满九千九百九十九只，不让师父失望。
column2: I'll work hard and defeat all 9,999 of them. I won't let my master down.

column1: 哎，我怎么找了这么个搭档，还不如自己来。
column2: Ugh, why did I choose a partner like this? I'd be better off doing it myself.

column1: 里面好黑啊，我，我不想进去……
column2: It's so dark in there. I-I don't want to go inside...

column1: 要往好处想，要往好处想……
好处是剩的货少了，卖光的压力就小了。
column2: The upside is that there's less stock left, so there'll be less pressure to sell it all.

column1: 上次就是因为药水不够，在最后关头被蚁后击倒了，这次准备得很充分，一定可以的。
column2: Last time, I didn't have enough Potions, and Maya took me down at the last moment. This time, I'm well prepared. I can do it!

column1: 蚁后有什么好怕的，冲就完了。
column2: What's so scary about Maya? Just charge in!

column1: 斐扬的布这季涨了，普隆德拉那边应该还没跟上来，去了能卖个好价。
column2: The price of Payon cloth went up this season. Prontera probably hasn't caught up yet, so I should get a good price there.

column1: 那棵树上有鸟窝，你们走路能不能小声点？
column2: There's a bird's nest in that tree. Could you walk a little more quietly?

column1: 今早有雾，雾散的时候这里漂亮得很，可惜你们没来得及看到。
column2: It was foggy this morning. This place was beautiful when the fog lifted. Too bad you didn't get here in time to see it.

column1: 别看这里安静，安静不代表没事，安静有时候是最危险的。
column2: Don't let the quiet fool you. Calm doesn't mean everything's fine. Sometimes, Calm is the most dangerous sign of all.

column1: 当兵之前觉得森林驻扎应该挺好，树荫凉快，空气好。
column2: Before I joined the army, I thought being stationed in a forest would be nice—cool shade and fresh air.

column1: 没想到哥布灵这么吵，从早叽叽喳喳到晚上，比城里还吵。
column2: I never expected Goblins to be this noisy. They chatter from morning till night. It's louder than the city!

column1: 这口井是谁修的？真是个大好人。
column2: Who built this well? What a wonderful person.

column1: 我年轻那会儿，这片野外的怪见到我都绕路走。
column2: When I was young, every monster in this Field would take a detour when it saw me.

column1: 不是我吹，是真的，你去问老一辈的冒险者。
column2: I'm not bragging. It's true! Go ask one of the veteran Adventurers.

column1: 今天巡逻还是休息——（抛硬币）休息。
column2: Patrol or rest today—(Flips coin) Rest.

column1: 我们年轻那会儿这个门还没这么大，后来扩建了。
column2: When we were young, this gate wasn't nearly this big. They expanded it later.

column1: 说过了还是要说，扩得好，现在进出方便多了。
column2: It's still worth saying. They did a great job expanding it. It's much easier to come and go now.

column1: 那个小姑娘背的包跟咱们孙女一样。
column2: That little girl's bag looks just like our granddaughter's.
She's too far away now. I can't see her.

column1: 也不知道她最近怎么样了。
column2: No idea how she's been doing Recent.
Her last letter said she was doing well.
As long as she's doing well.

column1: 这个在我们村@{1}个Zeny，这里要@{2}？
column2: This costs @{1} Zeny in our village, but it's @{2} here?

column1: 我出门前邻居说，普隆德拉什么都有，什么都贵，什么都好玩。
column2: Before I left home, my neighbor said Prontera has everything, everything's expensive, and everything's fun.
He was right about all three.

column1: 一个一个来，不急，货够的，都有份。
column2: One at a time! No need to rush. There's plenty for everyone.

column1: 那位先生！不要捏，捏坏了要买的。
column2: Sir! Don't squeeze that. If you damage it, you'll have to buy it!

column1: 哎，最近手头紧吧，我看你愁眉苦脸的。
column2: Hey, money's been tight Recent, hasn't it? I can see the worry on your face.

column1: 有什么难处，可以来找我，我认识的人多。
column2: If you're ever in trouble, come see me. I know a lot of people.
No need to thank me. We're neighbors, after all.

column1: 这车跟了我七年了，轮子换过两次，把手换过一次，就剩这个架子是原来的。
column2: I've had this cart for 7 years. I've replaced the wheels twice and the handle once. This frame is the only original part left.

column1: 天气好的时候在野外待着比城里舒服。
column2: When the weather's nice, it's more comfortable to stay out in the Field than in the city.

column1: 波利那么可爱，为什么要打波利？
column2: Porings are so Cute! Why would anyone attack them?

column1: 面包、烤肉、果子、汤包，热的冷的都有，你要什么我给你拿。
column2: Bread, grilled meat, fruit, soup dumplings—hot or cold, we've got it all. Just tell me what you'd like.

column1: 吃饱了才有力气冒险啊！
column2: You need a full stomach to have the energy for adventure!

column1: 是刚来的冒险者吧？来来来，指给你看，你现在在这里，要去普隆德拉走这边，去伊斯鲁德走那边。
column2: You're a new Adventurer, aren't you? Come here, I'll show you. You're right here. Go this way to Prontera or that way to Izlude.

column1: 怎么样，记住了吗？要是怕迷路，就买一张地图吧。
