column2: Well? Got it memorized? If you're worried about getting lost, buy a map.

column1: 我每天早上六点来排，风雨不误，你们年轻人睡懒觉，所以排在我后面。
column2: I line up here at 6 every morning, rain or shine. You youngsters sleep in, so you end up behind me.

column1: 这家面包每天限量的，这会排队已经晚了，不如待会从我这买，就加@{1}块钱！
column2: This bakery only makes a limited number each day. It's too late to line up now, so buy one from me later for just an extra @{1}!

column1: 不知道这家店还能火多久，差不多得找找其他路子了……
column2: No idea how long this place will stay popular. I should start looking for Other opportunities...

column1: 我已经收集了巴雷蒙德的全套笔记！
column2: I've collected Varmundt's complete set of notes!

column1: 嘿嘿，我专门去了一趟朱诺大学，在图书馆找了很久呢。
column2: Hehe, I made a special trip to Juno University and spent ages searching the Library.

column1: 你说，以后还会出现像巴雷蒙德一样的人吗？
column2: Do you think someone like Varmundt will ever appear again?

column1: 很不容易吧，他可是天才中的天才。
column2: That won't be easy. He was a genius among geniuses.

column1: 卖完收摊，卖不完也收摊，差不多就行了。
column2: Sold out or not, I'll Close Stall when it's time. No need to overdo it.

column1: 昨天研究了新的摆货方式，客人拿起来更顺手，成交率高了两成。
column2: Yesterday, I devised a new way to arrange my wares. They're easier for customers to pick up, and my sales rate rose by 20%.

column1: 快了快了，再卖一会，今天就收摊了。
column2: Almost there. I'll sell a little longer, then Close Stall for the day.

column1: 待会还要做饭，希望家里那个醉鬼别把屋子弄得乱七八糟。
column2: I still have to cook later. I hope that drunk at home hasn't made a complete mess of the place.

column1: 每一个冒险者，都会找到最适合自己的道路。
column2: Every Adventurer will find the path that's right for them.
Hey, rookie! Here to take a request?

column1: 冒险者，你来啦，跟我一起进入学院吧！
column2: Adventurer, you're here! Come with me—To the Academy!

column1: 二转是选择职业路径的关键阶段，你可以咨询学院里的前辈，向他们了解不同职业分支的特点。
column2: Your second Job Advance is a crucial stage in Choosing a Job path. Ask the veterans at the Academy about the unique features of each job branch.

column1: 等你做好决定，就去触摸转职之书吧。
column2: Once you've made your decision, touch the Book of Job Advance.
Hello! Would you like to join us?

column1: 我是精炼防具与武器的铁匠，可以为你精炼穿戴中的装备，你想精炼哪个装备？
column2: I'm a Blacksmith who refines armor and weapons. I can refine the equipment you're wearing—which piece would you like to refine?

column1: 来来来，快加入生活职业吧！俗话说技术改变命运，说不定你就能变成像我一样的万人迷了哦吼吼！
column2: Come, come! Hurry and take up a Life Skill! They say skills can change your destiny. You might even become as popular as me! Ohohoho!

column1: 所谓结婚是指期待着幸福，请问你是否有想要结婚的对象呢？
column2: Marriage is about looking forward to a happy future. Is there someone you'd like to marry?

column1: 遇到志同道合的冒险家同伴，就来组建冒险团吧！
column2: If you meet like-minded Adventurers, form an Adventurer Guild together!
I want to create an Adventurer Guild
Would you like to leave the Academy?

column1: 前方危险，无关人员请勿靠近。
column2: Danger ahead. Unauthorized personnel, keep away.
I want to enter the Culvert

column1: 卡普拉公司提醒您：道路千万条，安全第一条，行车不规范，亲人两行泪，押运镖车时也要注意车速哦，全程限速@{1}米/秒。
column2: Kafra Corporation reminds you: There are many roads, but safety comes first. Reckless driving brings tears to your loved ones. Mind your speed while escorting the wagon—the speed limit is @{1} meters per second.

column1: 每一位冒险家，都是米德加兹大陆得以存续的原因。
column2: Every Adventurer is part of the reason the continent of Midgard endures.

column1: 感谢你送来的军需物资！
column2: Thank You for delivering the Military Supplies!

column1: 在此处可对车辆进行修理。
进入王宫需要注意礼仪。
column2: Please observe proper etiquette when entering the palace.
I want to enter the palace
Would you like to leave the palace?
Would you like to leave the Court of Time?

column1: 您身上携带了${1}份物资，可为公会增加${2}战备物资，要全部上交吗？
column2: You are carrying ${1} supplies, which will add ${2} Military Supplies to the Guild. Submit them all?

column1: 只有勇敢的人才能成为冒险者。
column2: Only the brave can become Adventurers.

column1: 哎，孩子都长那么大了，还是不让人省心！
column2: *Sigh* The child's all grown up and still such a handful!
Hello! Would you like to board the airship?

column1: 你是来帮忙的冒险者吗？
column2: Are you the Adventurer who came to help?

column1: 我们调查学者，就是要去往任何能够到达的地方。
column2: We field researchers go anywhere we can reach.

column1: 帮助有困难的居民是我们的义务。
column2: It's our duty to help residents in need.

column1: 什么时候我才能变成一个合格的剑士呢？
column2: When will I finally become a proper Swordsman?

column1: 命运会指引你到该去的地方。
column2: Destiny will guide you where you need to go.
(All you hear is the clash of blades.)

column1: 要我帮你测试一下你适合哪个职业吗？
column2: Would you like me to test which job suits you best?
Getting enough rest is very important.

column1: 看起来是个普通的箱子。
column2: It looks like an ordinary chest.

column1: 哼哼，波波是世界上最可爱的波利！
column2: Hehe! Bobo is the cutest Poring in the whole world!
We make our living buying and selling goods.

column1: 要实现我的愿望，还要赚很大一笔钱呢。
column2: I still need to earn a fortune to make my wish come true.

column1: 希望商队平平安安，顺顺利利。
column2: I hope the caravan has a safe and smooth journey.
These woods are perfect for hunting.

column1: 这次任务一定会顺利的！
column2: This mission is sure to go smoothly!

column1: 嚯呀，终于有新任务了，我都迫不及待了！
column2: Whoa, finally, a new mission! I can't wait!

column1: 骑士公会搞什么舞会嘛，打打架多好。
column2: Why is the Knight Guild holding a ball? Fighting would be way more fun.

column1: 还是动物头饰卖得最好，看来福瑞控很多嘛。
column2: Animal headwear still sells best. Guess there are a lot of furry fans out there.

column1: 谢谢你邀请我一起共舞，其实我喜欢你很久了。
column2: Thank you for asking me to dance. The truth is, I've liked you for a long time.

column1: 嚯嚯，骑士团好久没参与这种活动了，真是热闹啊！
column2: Hoho! It's been ages since the Knights joined an event like this. What a lively celebration!

column1: 这是我第一次参加舞会，有点紧张呢……
column2: This is my first ball. I'm a little nervous...

column1: 哈哈，伙计，你也没找到舞伴吗？
column2: Haha, buddy! Couldn't find a dance partner either?

column1: 咳咳，重在参与，重在参与。
column2: Ahem. It's the taking part that counts. The taking part.
I want to get stronger faster.

column1: 哎唷，啥时候能睡个安稳觉呢……
column2: Ugh, when will I finally get a good night's sleep...?

column1: 没想到一把年纪了，还会被白鼠戏弄，哎。
column2: At my age, I never thought I'd be made a fool of by a White Mouse. Sigh.

column1: 没有什么事比赚钱更重要。什么，你说良心？哈哈，能换钱吗？
column2: Nothing matters more than making money. What, a conscience? Hah! Can I sell it?

column1: 瞧一瞧，看一看嘞，新鲜出炉的武器！
column2: Step right up! Get your freshly forged weapons here!

column1: 别问公会能为你做什么，先问问你能为公会的仓库贡献什么。
column2: Ask not what your guild can do for you. Ask what you can contribute to the guild storage.

column1: 会长今天又带队击败了一个超强魔物，太厉害了！
column2: The Guild Leader led another team to defeat an incredibly powerful monster today! Amazing!
I'm exhausted. I want to sleep...

column1: 嘘……我正在计算这个礼拜的收益，嗯，卖出了@{1}瓶药水……
column2: Shh... I'm calculating this week's profits. Let's see, we sold @{1} potions...

column1: 什么事能比家重要呢？真是搞不懂霍克。
column2: What could possibly matter more than family? I just don't understand Hawk.

column1: 我可怜的孩子，快回家吧。
column2: My poor child, please come home.

column1: 是时候叫他试试我新买的搓衣板了！
column2: It's time he tried out my new washboard!

column1: 哦，我的魔法书，你到底去了哪里！
column2: Oh, my spellbook! Where in the world have you gone?

column1: 别磨蹭了！这次一定要干一票大的！
column2: Quit dawdling! We're going to pull off a big score this time!

column1: 哼，今天的计划天衣无缝！……大概吧。
column2: Hmph. Today's plan is flawless!... Probably.

column1: 这两个笨蛋总把简单事情复杂化，干大事还是要靠我。
column2: Those two idiots always make Easy things complicated. If we want to pull off something big, it's up to me.
Welcome! Would you like to buy a bouquet?

column1: 伊尔玛塔大人是最崇高的存在。
column2: Lady Irmata is the most exalted of all.

column1: （轻轻鼓掌）这次跳得还不错嘛~关于保亚的喜好...她小时候好像特别喜欢毛茸茸的东西，尤其是...长耳朵的？啊！教堂的钟声响了，轮到我去巡逻了。（狡黠一笑）^{1}PlayerName^{2}，祝你好运！
column2: (Claps softly) That dance wasn't bad~ As for what Boya likes... When she was little, I think she especially loved fluffy things, particularly... ones with long ears? Ah! The church bells are ringing. It's my turn to patrol. (Smirks slyly) ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, good luck!

column1: 你这舞步...是跟喝醉的兽人学的吗？（整理了下裙摆，重新伸出手）不过嘛...看在你这么努力的份上。（眨眨眼）再给你一次机会？这次可要专心跟着我的节奏来哦。
column2: Those dance moves... Did you learn them from a drunken Orc? (Smooths her skirt and offers her hand again) Still... since you're trying so hard. (Winks) How about one more chance? This time, focus and follow my rhythm, okay?

column1: 伸手（点击再次开始跳舞）
column2: Take her hand (Click to dance again)

column1: 你准备好开始比赛了吗？
column2: Are you ready to begin the competition?

column1: 要跟我做交易，可是有门槛的。
column2: You'll have to meet my requirements before you can Trade with me.
I hope this journey goes smoothly.

column1: 你看着我干什么，快把这只狗赶走啊！
column2: What are you staring at me for? Hurry up and get this dog away from me!

column1: 最近偷鸡摸狗的人还真多，世风日下啊。
column2: There sure have been a lot of petty thieves around lately. What is the world coming to?
My luck has been terrible lately...

column1: 照这样下去，我们商队会不会破产呀?
column2: If this keeps up, is our caravan going to go bankrupt?

column1: 等我抓到偷东西的贼，一定饶不了他！
column2: Once I catch that thief, they'll be sorry!

column1: 其实我觉得自己早该来了，我可是同辈里资质最好的！
column2: Honestly, I think I should've come sooner. I'm the most talented of my generation!

column1: 我是当地考核第一名来的，我没有理由紧张。
column2: I earned First Place in my local assessment. I have no reason to be nervous.

column1: 家里人送我出来的时候，我爹说：去了好好干，别给我们村丢脸。
column2: When my family saw me off, my dad said, "Work hard out there, and don't embarrass our village."

column1: 从被选上那天我就在想，我要转哪个职业。想了三个月，每天都换一个答案，今天终于要见真章了。
column2: Ever since I was chosen, I've been wondering which class to choose. For 3 months, I've changed my answer every day. Today, the moment of truth is finally here.

column1: 裂隙里传来了^{1}${1}^{2}的气息，或许裂隙之石会将我们传送到一个全新的地点里。请做好准备
column2: An aura of ^{1}${1}^{2} is emanating from the rift. The Rift Stone may warp us to an entirely new location. Please be prepared.
I need a little more time to prepare.

column1: 你好，我是传送站的看守。
column2: Hello. I'm the Teleport Station Attendant.

column1: 你终于找到了这个，距离那一天的到来，我们又近了一步……
column2: You finally found it. We're one step closer to that day...

column1: 嗯……还有谜团没被解开，多与其他冒险者交流，或许能得到你想要的答案。
column2: Hmm... There are still mysteries left unsolved. Talk to other Adventurers, and you may find the answers you seek.

column1: 残缺的乐章过于深奥，伊尔玛塔的神示于梦中降临，在^{1}${1}^{2}城各处仔细寻找，或许能有所收获。若您苦寻无果，不妨询问其他冒险家的意见。
column2: The incomplete movement is too difficult to decipher. Irmata's divine revelation came to you in a dream. Search every corner of ^{1}${1}^{2} City, and you may discover something. If your search proves fruitless, try asking other Adventurers for advice.

column1: 感受到了吗？那些隐匿于世间的回响，仍散发着灵魂的共鸣……你已经解开了其中一个谜题，待你获得全部答案，就能奏响已被遗忘的篇章。
column2: Can you feel it? The echoes hidden throughout the world still resonate with the soul... You have solved one of the riddles. Once you have all the answers, you will be able to play the forgotten movement.

column1: 冒险家啊，还有更多音符需要解答，若您苦寻无果，不妨询问其他伙伴，也许能获得一些启示。
column2: Adventurer, there are still more notes to decipher. If your search leads nowhere, try asking your companions. They may be able to offer some insight.

column1: 你好，现在还没有开启押镖哦。
column2: Hello. The escort mission isn't available yet.

column1: 一个新的音符！伊尔玛塔在上，我不追求真理，只追求迷雾中的……没什么，冒险家，请继续寻找吧。
column2: A new note! By Irmata, I seek not truth, but that which lies within the mist... Never mind. Please continue your search, Adventurer.

column1: 多么美妙的音符！奏响乐章吧，从一个时刻到另一个时刻。
column2: What a beautiful note! Let the melody ring out, from one moment to the next.

column1: 恭喜通过阶段，准备好就向前进入下个阶段吧。
column2: Congratulations on clearing this stage! When you're ready, head forward to the next stage.

column1: 喂，主人！你可得抓紧我！要是波波掉下去，可就没人叫你起床了哦。
column2: Hey, Master! Hold on to me tight! If Bobo falls, there'll be no one left to wake you up!

column1: ……不过，这里的云看起来好像真的棉花糖，好想咬一口…
column2: ...But the clouds here really do look like cotton candy. I wish I could take a bite...

column1: 这艘‘白鸽号’是我的老伙计了，别看现在这么稳，当年可是在风暴里救过我一命。
column2: The White Dove has been my trusty companion for years. She may fly steady now, but she once saved my life in a storm.

column1: 固定绳要检查三遍，武器放在触手可及的地方。这是规矩
column2: Check the securing ropes three times, and keep your weapon within reach. Those are the rules.

column1: 终于结束了。如果没有你们的帮助，我估计今天只能跟这群苍蝇同归于尽了。
column2: It's finally over. Without your help, I probably would've gone down with this swarm of Chonchons today.

column1: 我的伤不碍事，就是操作船舵比较吃力，接下来的路程，如果遇到突发状况，需要你来操作。
column2: My injury isn't serious, but it's making the helm difficult to operate. If anything unexpected happens during the rest of the journey, I'll need you to take over.

column1: 放心。飞空艇有自动巡航功能，只有特殊情况时需要人的干预，你听我的指令即可。
column2: Don't worry. The airship has an automatic cruise Function. Human intervention is only needed in special circumstances, so just follow my instructions.

column1: 欢迎来到篝火晚会！活动共分为@{1}个阶段：第@{2}阶段是晚会筹备阶段：冒险者们可以采集领地内散落的火种，投入篝火后获得奖励；第@{3}-@{4}阶段为晚会正式进行阶段，冒险者们可以击败捣蛋怪物获得奖励，同时可以参与抽奖。
column2: Welcome to the Bonfire Party! The event consists of @{1} stages. Stage @{2} is the preparation stage, during which Adventurers can collect Live Coals scattered throughout the territory and add them to the Bonfire to earn rewards. Stages @{3}-@{4} are the main party stages, during which Adventurers can defeat mischievous monsters to earn rewards and enter the prize drawing.

column1: 你们就是各个村镇推荐的转职候选人吧，欢迎大家的到来~大家继续往前走，参加初心者试炼后，就可以进入普隆德拉进行转职了。各位加油哦！
column2: You must be the Job Advance candidates recommended by the villages and towns. Welcome, everyone! Keep going and complete the Novice Trial, then you'll be able to enter Prontera for your Job Advance. Good luck!

column1: 初心者试炼很简单，完成^{1}两个基础任务^{2}，证明你有成为正式职业的潜质，之后你就能拿到证明去普隆德拉转职了。
column2: The Novice Trial is Easy. Complete ^{1}two Basic Quests^{2} to prove you have the potential for a Regular job. Then you'll receive certification and can head to Prontera for your Job Advance.

column1: 第一个任务，击败附近的^{1}@{1}只波利^{2}。这种生物的攻击力不高，不过作为新手也要小心应对。
column2: Your First Quests is to Defeat ^{1}@{1} Nearby Porings^{2}. They don't have much ATK, but Beginners should still approach them with caution.

column1: 当然完成了！可是^{1}PlayerName^{2}受伤了，怎么办？快帮帮我们！
column2: Of course we finished it! But ^{1}PlayerName^{2} is hurt! What do we do? Please help us!

column1: 别紧张，这瓶红药水给你。记住，在野外要及时补充体力，不要让自己陷入虚弱状态。
column2: Don't worry. Take this Red Potion. Remember to restore your HP promptly in the Field, and don't let You become Weak.

column1: 对啊，你可得照顾好自己，不然谁来保护我……
column2: Exactly! You need to take care of yourself, or who'll protect me...

column1: 不错，恢复的很好。看来你已经掌握了治疗自己的方法。
column2: Not bad. You've recovered nicely. It looks like you've mastered how to use Healing on You.

column1: 接下来，为了应对更高阶的试炼挑战，我会告诉你该如何学习新的技能。
column2: Next, I'll teach you how to Learn New Skills so you'll be prepared for more advanced Challenges.

column1: 嗯，你很有悟性。等到你成功转职后，就会开放更多技能了，记得要经常学习新技能，保持进步。
column2: Mmm, you're a quick learner. More skills will become available after you successfully Job Advance, so remember to Learn new skills often and keep improving.

column1: 好了，接下来是第二个试炼任务——击败^{1}@{1}只绿棉虫^{2}。这次的魔物更具危险性，注意安全。
column2: All right, your second Trial Quests is to Defeat ^{1}@{1} Fabres^{2}. These monsters are more dangerous, so stay safe.

column1: 就是那些绿色长着毛的虫子吗？好恶心哦……^{1}PlayerName^{2}，你打的时候轻一点，要是把虫汁溅在我身上我是不会原谅你的。
column2: You mean those Green, hairy bugs? Gross... ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, don't hit them too hard. If you splatter bug juice on me, I'll never forgive you.

column1: 嘻嘻~走吧，去转职！没想到你居然这么厉害，我可真是太有眼光了~
column2: Hehe~ Let's go complete your Job Advance! I can't believe you're this strong. I sure know how to spot talent~

column1: 数千年前，米德加兹大陆遭遇了前所未有的灾难。魔王梦罗克入侵了这里，巨大的尘世巨蟒耶梦加得也意图吞噬这个世界。
column2: Thousands of years ago, the continent of Midgard suffered an unprecedented catastrophe. The Demon King Morroc invaded, while the colossal World Serpent Jormungand sought to devour the world.

column1: 就在此时，卢恩王国七皇室的祖先们挺身而出。同时，有六位出类拔萃的各职业勇士辅佐他们，最终他们战胜了恶魔，保护了大陆。
column2: At that moment, the ancestors of the Rune Kingdom's seven royal families rose to the challenge. Aiding them were 6 exceptional Warriors from various jobs. Together, they Defeated the Demon and protected the continent.

column1: 触摸前方的转职之书，去选择适合自己的道路吧。
column2: Touch the Book of Job Advance ahead and choose the path that's right for You.

column1: 很好。从今天起，你便正式踏上了属于自己的道路。记住，这仅仅是一个开始。
column2: Excellent. From this day forward, you officially walk your own path. Remember, this is only the beginning.

column1: 太好了，^{1}PlayerName^{2}，接下来咱们就可以开始尽情冒险咯！
column2: Great! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, now we can finally start adventuring to our hearts' content!

column1: 先别急。转职赋予了你全新的力量，但这股力量需要你去理解和驾驭。
column2: Not so fast. Your Job Advance granted you Newfound Power, but you must learn to understand and master it.

column1: 去熟悉一下你所获得的那些新技能吧。它们将是你未来冒险中最可靠的武器。
column2: Take some time to familiarize You with your new skills. They'll be the most reliable Weapon on your future adventures.

column1: 做得不错，你对新技能的领悟比我预想的要快。
column2: Well done. You've grasped your new skills faster than I expected.

column1: 但是，技能的威力根植于你自身。只有更强的体魄或更深邃的魔力，才能将这些技巧发挥到极致。
column2: However, the power of your skills comes from within. Only a stronger physique or deeper magical power will let you use these techniques to their fullest potential.

column1: 啊，我知道我知道，光会耍花招可不行，要把力气用在对的地方才算厉害！
column2: Yeah, yeah, I know! Fancy tricks aren't enough. You're only strong if you put your STR to good use!

column1: 每一次^{1}升级^{2}都会赋予你新的^{3}属性点^{4}。如何分配它们，将直接决定你未来的发展。
column2: Every ^{1}Level-up^{2} grants new ^{3}Stat Points^{4}. How you distribute them will directly determine your future growth.

column1: 现在，根据你的职业特性，去完成第一次属性加点吧。
column2: Now, complete your first Stat Distribution based on your job's strengths.

column1: 很好。看来你已经领会了如何驾驭自身的力量，这便是成为一名合格冒险者的根基。
column2: Excellent. It seems you've learned to control your own STR. That's the foundation of becoming a Qualified Adventurer.

column1: 我在普隆德拉的教导到此为止，真正的成长需要你自己去广阔的世界中磨砺。
column2: My instruction in Prontera ends here. True growth requires You to hone your skills out in the wider world.

column1: 去^{1}南门外^{2}找乐园团的试炼官吧，他们会有适合新人的委托。
column2: Find the Eden Group Trial Officer ^{1}outside the South Gate^{2}. They'll have Quests suitable for Beginners.

column1: 嘿嘿，既然都这么强了，那接下来的委托任务肯定难不倒我们啦！
column2: Hehe, now that we're this strong, the next set of Quests will be a piece of cake!

column1: 你好，又见面了。你看起来都比刚才沉稳了不少，看来已经顺利完成转职了。
column2: Hello, we meet again. You seem much more composed than before. It appears you've successfully completed your Job Advance.

column1: 这是为你准备的低阶委托——清理南门附近的@{1}只魔物。另外，这是乐园团向新人冒险者提供的武器箱，拿好。
column2: Here's a Basic commission for you: clear out @{1} monsters Nearby the South Gate. Also, take this Weapon Box provided by the Eden Group for Beginner Adventurers.

column1: 哇，新装备！看来乐园团还挺大方的嘛，快选个顺手的~
column2: Wow, new equipment! The Eden Group is pretty generous. Hurry and choose something that feels right~

column1: 装备好新武器，就可以开始你的委托了，注意安全。
column2: Equip your new Weapon, and you can begin your commission. Stay safe.

column1: 咦？你获取了新的装备啊。这效率比预想的要快。在外冒险，根据战况及时更换装备是提升实力的关键。
column2: Oh? You've obtained new equipment. That was faster than expected. When adventuring in the Field, knowing when to Change Equipment based on the situation is key to becoming stronger.

column1: 每件装备都有不同的属性词条，你需要自己研究如何搭配才能发挥最大效用。打开装备界面，好好研究一下吧。
column2: Each piece of equipment has different Affixes. You'll need to figure out how to combine them into the best Preset to get the most out of your gear. Open the equipment screen and take a closer look.

column1: 词条？听起来有种很专业的感觉诶……快！咱们开始研究吧！
column2: Affixes? That sounds so technical... Come on! Let's check them out!

column1: 看来你已经熟悉装备的替换流程了。这片大陆上所有的冒险者，都是通过冒险和战斗获取的装备，不断变强的，你记得要认真研究，哪些装备才是最适合你的。
column2: Looks like you've gotten the hang of changing equipment. Every Adventurer on this continent grows stronger by acquiring equipment through adventures and Battle. Make sure you carefully consider which equipment suits you best.

column1: 这是乐园团为你准备的进阶装备，包括武器和防具，收好它。接下来的委托，就需要你用这身行头来应对了。
column2: This advanced equipment was prepared for you by the Eden Group. It includes a Weapon and Armor, so be sure to Receive it. You'll need this gear for your upcoming assignments.

column1: 哇，这质感比刚才那套好多了！快换上让我看看~
column2: Wow, this set looks way better than the last one! Put it on and let me see~

column1: 嗯，看来你已经换好装备了。
column2: Good. Looks like you've changed your equipment.

column1: 嘻嘻，果然人靠衣装，现在的你看起来可靠多啦！
column2: Hehe, clothes really do make the Adventurer. You look much more reliable now!

column1: 现在的距离你接手更高阶的委托只差一步了。拿好，这只坐骑能够大幅提高你的移动效率，以后赶路就方便多了。
column2: You're just one step away from taking on higher-level assignments. Here, this Mount will greatly improve your Move speed, making long journeys much easier.

column1: 免、免费送的坐骑？快收下！
column2: A-A free Mount? Hurry and Receive it!
Come on, try to Ride your Mount!

column1: 坐骑驾驭得很熟练，看来你已经做好了接取更高级委托的准备。那么，告诉我，你打算从哪种难度的委托开始你的冒险？
column2: You handle that Mount well. It looks like you're Ready to take on more advanced assignments. So tell me, what Difficulty would you like to start your adventure with?

column1: 那还用问吗，当然是最厉害的那种~比如单挑梦洛克，或者是去把那个耶什么加得的老巢给端了！
column2: Do you even have to ask? The hardest one, obviously~ Like taking on Morroc alone or raiding the lair of that Jormun-whatever!

column1: 很遗憾，目前梦罗克的封印还很牢固，耶梦加得也早就不存于世了。不过，斐扬城确实有一个紧急的委托需要处理。
column2: Unfortunately, Morroc's seal remains secure, and Jormungandr has long since vanished from this world. However, there is an urgent assignment in Payon that requires attention.

column1: 乐园团总部正在征集精英冒险者前往支援。你立刻出发，去斐扬城找乐园团的教官保亚，就告诉她你是我推荐的人选。
column2: La sede del Grupo Edén está reclutando aventureros de élite. Ve de inmediato a Payon a buscar a la instructora Boya del Grupo Edén y dile que vas de mi parte.

column1: 嘿嘿，我就知道没那么简单！既然要赶路，那正好试试新坐骑的速度极限啦！
column2: Hehe, I knew it wouldn't be that Easy! Since we've got a long trip ahead, this is the perfect chance to see how fast the new Mount can go!

column1: 你好啊，新人，找我有什么事？
column2: Hey there, rookie. What is it?

column1: 哦？你就是她推荐来的新人吧？看着挺有干劲啊。
column2: Oh? So you're the rookie she Suggested? You certainly look eager.

column1: 不过先说好，这次的任务可不太轻松。我们得收集一些很稀有的材料。哎，我说有些人可真是趁火打劫——
column2: But let me warn you first: this Quest won't be Easy. We need to gather some Rare Materials. Seriously, some people will exploit any crisis—

column1: 抱怨也解决不了问题，保亚，我们没有其他办法。
column2: Complaining won't solve anything, Boya. We have no Other choice.

column1: 我去为最后一个任务做准备，你们先去斐扬南部收集其他材料，抓紧时间。
column2: I'll prepare for the final Quest. You two head to Southern Payon and gather the Other Materials. We don't have much time.

column1: 行行行，听你的。新人，等会斐扬南部见！
column2: Fine, fine, we'll do it your way. Rookie, I'll meet you in Southern Payon!

column1: 来得正好。咱们先解决第一个任务——去搞几颗新鲜的青蛇胆。
column2: Perfect timing. Let's tackle the first Quest—getting a few fresh Snake Gallbladders from the Boas.

column1: 附近的森林里，就有一群剧毒的青蛇。别看它们个头不大，那一口下去可够你受的，小心别被咬到了。
column2: There's a pack of Boas in the Nearby forest, and each one has a nasty Venom Sting. They may be small, but one bite will leave you in agony. Be careful not to get bitten.

column1: 什么，毒性这么强？万一我们被咬到怎么办！^{1}PlayerName^{2}这种新人去也太危险了吧！
column2: What? They're that venomous? What if we get bitten?! It's way too dangerous to send a rookie like ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

column1: 想成为经验丰富的冒险者，可不能缺少在野外应对各种突发情况的经验。去吧，等你收集好了，我们在前方汇合。
column2: If you want to become an experienced Adventurer, you need EXP handling unexpected situations in the Field. Go on. Once you've gathered everything, meet us up ahead.

column1: 动作够快啊，看来刚才的实战考核你完成得不错，没给我丢脸。
column2: That was fast. Looks like you did well on the Battle assessment. You didn't let me down.

column1: 既然蛇胆到手了，咱们就别耽搁。接下来我们得去弄几张树精的皮，就在前面的林子里，那些老家伙皮糙肉厚，砍的时候记得多用点力。
column2: Now that we have the Snake Gallbladders, let's not waste any time. Next, we need to collect some Tree Bark from the Willows in the forest ahead. Those old things are tough, so put some muscle into your swings.

column1: 我在前面等你，拿到树皮后就赶紧过来，别磨蹭。免得有些人又改变主意……
column2: I'll wait up ahead. Once you have the Tree Bark, hurry over. Don't drag your feet, or certain people might change their minds again...

column1: 哈哈！我就知道这点小事难不倒你。这树皮剥得干净利落，看来你这双手斧使得挺溜啊！
column2: Haha! I knew something this Easy wouldn't stop you. You stripped that Tree Bark off nice and clean. Looks like you're pretty handy with that Two-Handed Axe!

column1: 两样材料到手了，最后一样最麻烦——去把蛇王的蛋给我偷出来。这里的青蛇脾气暴躁得很，蛇王的老巢应该就在前面不远处的草丛里。
column2: That's two Materials down. The last one will be the hardest—go steal the Snake King's egg for me. The Boas around here are extremely aggressive. The Snake King's nest should be hidden in the grass just up ahead.

column1: 哎？不对啊~为什么每次都是我们冲在前头，你却站在这儿当指挥家呀？
column2: Wait a minute~ Why are we always charging in while you stand back here playing Commander?

column1: 呃……你这小家伙懂什么，我得在这儿守着这两样材料，万一被偷了怎么办？而且你放心，你们要是真被那群蛇围住了，我肯定第一时间冲进去把你们捞出来！
column2: Uh... What would a Shorty like you know? I have to stay here and guard these two Materials. What if someone steals them? Besides, don't worry. If those snakes surround you, I'll charge in and rescue you immediately!

column1: 少废话，快去吧。拿到蛋立刻回来，咱们得赶在天黑之前把东西交给那个奸商，我可不想在这破林子里过夜。
column2: Enough Chitchat. Get going. Bring the egg back as soon as you have it. We need to deliver everything to that crooked merchant before dark, because I'm not spending the night in this miserable forest.

column1: 喂！刚才那群蛇围过来的时候你跑哪儿去了？还说什么第一时间冲进来捞我们，我看你就是想在那儿看戏吧！
column2: Hey! Where were you when those snakes surrounded us? You said you'd charge in and rescue us immediately, but I bet you just wanted to stand there and watch!

column1: 咳咳，这个……刚才我看你俩配合得挺默契嘛，我贸然冲进去反而容易打乱你们的节奏……嗯，没错！
column2: Ahem, well... You two were working together so well that rushing in might've thrown off your rhythm... Yes, exactly!

column1: 哎呀，别抱怨了，你看，你居然捡到了波利卡片啊，天哪，那可是好东西！能给你的装备带来意想不到的力量哦。
column2: Oh, stop complaining. Look, you picked up a Card: Poring! Wow, that's a great find! It can grant your equipment unexpected STR.

column1: 赶紧去把它装备上试试，看看能不能让你这小身板再结实点，省得下次我还没出手你就先趴下了。快去吧，别磨蹭。
column2: Hurry and equip it. Let's see if it can toughen you up, so you don't hit the ground before I can act next time. Go on, and don't dawdle.

column1: 好，好！这卡片一镶上，气势立马就不一样了，简直是如虎添翼啊！像刚才那种小危险，以后你就压根儿不用放在眼里了，哈哈哈哈！
column2: Yes, yes! The moment you slot in that Card, you look completely different! It's like giving a tiger wings! You won't even need to worry about little dangers like that anymore! Hahahaha!

column1: 哼，别以为这样我就会忘记你刚才袖手旁观……
column2: Hmph. Don't think this will make me forget how you stood by and did nothing...

column1: 咳咳！那个……那叫战术性观察！好了好了，材料都齐了，咱们赶紧去办正事。
column2: Ahem! That was... tactical observation! All right, all right. We have all the Materials, so let's get down to business.

column1: 最后一步，也是最难的一步，我们要去斐扬树林深处寻找虎王！那家伙是这一带的霸主，你可得打起精神来。出发，咱们在斐扬树林汇合。
column2: The final step is also the hardest. We need to find Eddga in the Deep Forest of Payon Forest! He's the ruler of this region, so stay sharp. Let's Move out and regroup in Payon Forest.

column1: 来得正好。听好了，那头虎王可不是路边的大野猪，它是这一带最凶残的野兽。它位置很难追踪，咱们得分头搜索。
column2: Perfect timing. Listen up: Eddga isn't some Savage wandering by the roadside. He's the fiercest beast in this region. Tracking him won't be Easy, so we'll need to split up and search.

column1: 拿着，这是“苍蝇翅膀”，用了它找虎王就方便多了。省得你跑断腿，赶紧多飞几次，把草丛都给我翻一遍！
column2: Take this. It's a Fly Wing, and it'll make finding Eddga much easier. It'll save you from running yourself ragged, so use it a few times and search every patch of grass!

column1: 你还没用过这个吧。苍蝇翅膀可以把你随机传送到这片区域的某个位置。
column2: You haven't used one before, have you? A Fly Wing can randomly Teleport You to another location within this area.

column1: 虎王非常危险，如果你遇到它了，先不要靠近，等我们和你汇合。
column2: Eddga is extremely dangerous. If you find him, don't Approach. Wait for us to meet up with You.

column1: 喂喂，你们说得这么凶，该不会等下找到了，就让我们俩去跟那个大猫单挑吧？
column2: Hey, with how scary you're making him sound, you're not planning to have the two of us take on that big cat alone once we find him, are you?

column1: 哈哈哈！怕什么，有我在呢，我就是拼了这条命也不会让你死在我前面的。好了，出发把，找到那家伙立刻发信号。
column2: Hahaha! What are you afraid of? I'm here! Even if it costs me my life, I won't let you die before me. All right, Move out. Signal us the moment you find him.

column1: 你这家伙是从哪冒出来的？这块地盘被我承包了，要打猎去别处打去！
column2: Where did you come from? I've claimed this whole territory! If you want to hunt, go somewhere else!

column1: 干得漂亮！敢跟那大家伙硬碰硬，你小子确实有两把刷子。我就知道莱茵没看走眼，你绝对是个当精英的料！
column2: Nicely done! You went head-to-head with that monster, and you've clearly got some real skill. I knew Rhine was right about You. You've definitely got what it takes to become Elite!

column1: 战斗技巧扎实，临危不乱。既然拿到了虎皮，说明你已经具备了执行更高难度任务的资格。
column2: Your Battle skills are solid, and you remain calm under pressure. Since you obtained the Tiger Pelt, you've proven your Eligibility to undertake higher-Difficulty Quests.

column1: 嘿，我们正缺个像你这么能打又靠谱的搭档，怎么样，有兴趣加入我们吗？
column2: Hey, we could use a strong, reliable partner like You. So, are you interested in Joining us?

column1: 你们俩能不能别在那儿搞什么面试啊？我还在这儿呢！难道你们忘了刚才这笨蛋差点被虎王拍飞吗？
column2: Would you two stop conducting an interview over there? I'm still here! Did you forget that idiot almost got swatted away by Eddga?

column1: 哈哈，你这小不点还真记仇啊。不过现在可不是闲聊的时候，咱们得赶紧回斐扬城，把这几样东西交给那个奸商。
column2: Haha, you really know how to hold a grudge, Shorty. But this is no time for Chitchat. We need to hurry back to Payon and deliver these items to that crooked merchant.

column1: 同意，为了防止有新的变数，尽快出发吧。
column2: Agreed. We should leave as soon as possible to prevent any further complications.

column1: 搞定！你要的@{1}个蛇蛋，还有@{2}份树皮，@{3}颗蛇王的蛋，@{4}张虎皮，都在这里了。快把船票拿出来，我们要赶时间。
column2: All done! Here are the @{1} snake eggs, @{2} portions of Tree Bark, @{3} Snake King eggs, and @{4} Tiger Pelts you asked for. Hand over the tickets—we're in a hurry.

column1: 啧……这树皮磨损得太厉害了吧？还有这蛇胆，尺寸不够啊。我觉得当初谈的价格有点高了，这船票……恐怕得再加点钱才行。
column2: Tsk... This Tree Bark is badly damaged, isn't it? And these Snake Gallbladders are too small. I think the price we agreed on was a little too high. As for these tickets... I'm afraid you'll have to pay extra.

column1: 喂，这可是^{1}PlayerName^{2}费了好大力气才弄来的！
column2: Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2} worked really hard to get all this!

column1: 我看你是故意挑刺！这可是我们豁出命弄回来的，你现在跟我说这个？
column2: You're deliberately finding fault with everything! We risked our lives to get these, and now you're telling us this?

column1: 保亚，冷静点。先生，契约就是契约，你这样做很不光彩。
column2: Boya, calm down. Sir, a contract is a contract. What you're doing is dishonorable.

column1: 快点！我耐心有限！要是再敢少一张票，我就把你的腿打断！
column2: Hurry up! My patience is wearing thin! Short us even one more ticket, and I'll break your legs!

column1: 别……别杀我！我给！我这就给！
column2: Don't... Don't kill me! I'll give them to you! Right now!

column1: 哼！活该！刚才不是挺能算计的吗？现在怎么像只缩头乌龟一样？快把票交出来，不然我就挠花你的脸！
column2: Hmph! Serves you right! Weren't you acting all clever just now? Why are you cowering like a turtle now? Hand over the tickets, or I'll claw your face to ribbons!

column1: 给……全在这儿了！这是白鸽号的船票，绝对是真的！求各位勇士高抬贵手，放过我吧……
column2: Here... This is everything! They're tickets for the White Dove, and they're absolutely real! Please, Warriors, have mercy and let me go...

column1: 算你识相！下次再敢耍花样，我就把你的摊位劈成柴火。
column2: Smart choice! Try anything like that again, and I'll chop your stall into firewood.

column1: 啊呸，真是个欺软怕硬的奸商……
column2: Ptooey! What a crooked merchant, bullying the weak and cowering before the strong...

column1: 他简直是不知悔改，要是刚才保亚那一剑劈歪了，我看他还能不能这么嚣张！
column2: He hasn't learned a thing! If Boya's sword had veered off course just now, I'd like to see if he could still act so smug!

column1: 下次别这么冲动。虽然他不对在先，但万一他出事了，我们要耽误更多时间。
column2: Don't be so reckless next time. He may have been in the wrong, but if anything had happened to him, it would've cost us even more time.

column1: 对付这种奸商，讲道理没用。好了，船票拿到了，咱们可以出发了。
column2: There's no reasoning with a crooked merchant like that. All right, we have the tickets. We can set out now.

column1: 哦，对了，这个蝴蝶翅膀给你。你刚回来肯定累了，用这个可以直接传送回普隆德拉城。接下来，你回城向艾昆妮团长汇报一下，我们就可以出发了。
column2: Oh, right. This Butterfly Wing is for you. You must be tired after getting back, so use it to Teleport directly to Prontera. Then Return to Town and report to Captain Aikuni. After that, we'll be ready to depart.

column1: 哇，这个用了之后可以飞吗？保亚，你也给我一个！
column2: Wow, will this let me fly? Boya, give me one too!

column1: 嘿嘿，这是最后一个了，下次，下次。
column2: Hehe, that was the last one. Next time. Next time.

column1: 你好，冒险者，找我有事吗？
column2: Hello, Adventurer. Is there something you need?
Boya sent me to see you.

column1: 那我知道了，你应该就是那个他们一起搞到船票的新人吧？
column2: I see. You must be the new recruit who helped them get the tickets, right?

column1: 哦？原来就是你，保亚已经在信里念叨你好几回了。
column2: Oh? So you're the one. Boya has mentioned you several times in her letters.

column1: 这么好奇？她让我帮你好好提升实力，因为后续我们还有重要的委托要交给你。
column2: Curious, are you? She asked me to help you grow stronger, since we have an important commission for you later.

column1: 听说你已经拿到了装备打造书？很好，你现在立刻去找铁匠忽克连，把你的武器和防具都强化到能发光为止。
column2: I hear you've acquired the Equipment Forging manual. Excellent. Go see Blacksmith Hollgrehenn immediately and Enhance your Weapon and Armor until they glow.

column1: 哇，这么严格吗，我们刚打完虎王，连口气都没喘匀呢，就有新任务了？
column2: Wow, that's strict! We just defeated Eddga and haven't even caught our breath, and now we already have new Quests?

column1: 哈哈哈，年轻人，严是爱，松是害，懂不懂？忽克连的手艺是卢恩王国最好的，去吧，希望等会儿能看到你全副武装归来的样子。
column2: Hahaha! Tough love is good for you, young one. Being too lenient only does harm, understand? Hollgrehenn is the finest craftsman in the Rune Kingdom. Off you go. I hope to see you return Fully Armed.

column1: 嘿！你就是艾昆妮团长特意提起的新人吧？听说你刚在斐扬立了大功，欢迎欢迎。
column2: Hey! You must be the new recruit Captain Aikuni mentioned. I hear you accomplished something impressive in Payon. Welcome!

column1: 刚刚团长已经打过招呼了，说你手里拿到了最新的打造图纸。不过想把它变成能陪你去冒险的真家伙，还需要进行装备打造才可以。
column2: The Captain already told me you obtained the latest Crafting Blueprint. But if you want to turn it into real gear worthy of accompanying you on your adventures, you'll need to use Equipment Forging.

column1: 别担心，打造的步骤很简单，只要材料备齐，保准给你造出全普隆德拉最结实的装备！
column2: Don't worry. The Craft process is Easy. Once you have all the required Material, I guarantee I'll make you the sturdiest equipment in all Prontera!

column1: 漂亮！这光泽、这手感，绝对是上乘货啊。用我的手法加上你的材料，出来的东西肯定错不了。
column2: Beautiful! That sheen, that feel—this is top-quality work. With my craftsmanship and your Material, you can't go wrong.

column1: 哇，确实比刚才看着威风多了~
column2: Wow, it definitely looks way more impressive now~

column1: 以后要是弄到了更高级的图纸，记得第一时间去打造新装备啊，一套好的装备对冒险者来说，关键时刻可是能决定生死的。
column2: If you obtain a higher-grade blueprint later, be sure to Craft new equipment right away. For an Adventurer, a good set of equipment can mean the difference between life and death.

column1: 这身行头不错，看来忽克连那小子这次没偷懒。既然装备到位了，那就只剩下这个东西还对你有用处了——
column2: That gear looks good. Seems Hollgrehenn didn't slack off this time. Now that your equipment is ready, there's only one thing left that might help you—

column1: 拿着这本冒险手册，里面记录了卢恩王国历代强者的成长心得。当你迷茫不知道该往哪走、或者缺资源提升实力的时候，翻翻它，它会给你指出明确的方向。
column2: Take these Adventurer Guides. They Record the wisdom gained by the Rune Kingdom's greatest heroes throughout the ages. Whenever you have No idea. where to go or lack the resources to grow stronger, open them up. They'll point you in the right direction.

column1: 去吧，按照手册上的指引来提升自己。等你把这些基础打牢了，我有个极为重要的绝密委托要交给你。
column2: Go. Follow the Guides to improve your skills. Once you've mastered these Basic fundamentals, I'll have a top-secret commission of the utmost importance for you.

column1: 干得真不赖，看来这本手册在你手里算是物尽其用了。这种进步速度，在我带过的团员里也算罕见。
column2: Excellent work. It seems you've made the most of those Guides. Even among all the members I've trained, such rapid progress is rare.

column1: 关于那份绝密委托的详细内容，容我之后再向你介绍，现在我们需要先前往伊斯鲁德，乘坐飞空艇。
column2: I'll explain the details of that top-secret commission later. For now, we need to head to Izlude and board the airship.

column1: 飞空艇？就是那种在云层里呼啸而过，甲板上还能吹风看风景的大船吗？我们要坐那个去冒险？
column2: An airship? You mean one of those huge ships that races through the clouds, where you can feel the breeze and enjoy the view from the deck? We're taking one on our adventure?

column1: 没错，小家伙。但这次可不是普通的郊游，我们是去完成委托的，途中可能遇到各种危险。
column2: That's right, little one. But this isn't a Normal outing. We're going to Complete the Commission, and we may face all kinds of danger along the way.

column1: 保亚和唔勒已经在伊斯鲁德做登船准备了。你收拾好行装，带上你的新装备，我们在伊斯鲁德见。
column2: Boya and Wule are already in Izlude making preparations to board. Pack your things, bring your new equipment, and meet us in Izlude.

column1: 你来了，正好。给你介绍一下，这位是“白鸽号”的船长，奥尔顿。这次载我们去沙漠，全靠他这艘大家伙。
column2: You're here. Perfect timing. Let me introduce you. This is Alton, Captain of the White Dove. We'll be relying on his enormous vessel to take us to the desert.

column1: 别叫它“大家伙”，这可是精密的机器。本来按计划，我们该在半小时后就升空。但现在……舱里还有三成货舱是空的。
column2: Don't call it an "enormous vessel." This is a precision machine. We were supposed to take off in half an hour, but now... 30% of the cargo hold is still empty.

column1: 哎？三成？是有人还没来吗？
column2: Huh? 30%? Has someone not arrived yet?

column1: 那是属于灰烬商队的仓位。现在人没到齐，货也没装，我没法为了你们几个就擅自起飞，那是违反航运规则的。
column2: That space belongs to the Ash Caravan. Their people aren't all here, and their cargo hasn't been loaded. I can't take off early just for the few of you. It would violate shipping Rules.

column1: 啧，关键时刻掉链子。奥尔顿，附近有没有灰烬商队的队员？去打听一下，到底是怎么回事，我们没时间在这港口耗着。
column2: Tch. Of all the times for this to happen. Alton, are any members of the Ash Caravan Nearby? Let's ask around and find out what's going on. We don't have time to waste at this port.

column1: 喷泉附近似乎有一个。你们自己去问吧，我去检查引擎，有消息立刻通知我。
column2: I believe there's one near the fountain. Go ask them yourselves. I'll inspect the engine. Send me a Notification as soon as you learn anything.

column1: 完了完了……这下全完了……这可怎么办啊……
column2: It's over... It's all over... What am I going to do...?

column1: 你……你是乐园团的人吗？帮帮我们吧！飞空艇那边马上就要起飞了，可我们队长和货物全在沙漠岔路口那边出事了！
column2: A-Are you with the Eden Group? Help Me! The airship is about to depart, but our Party Leader and all our cargo ran into trouble over by the Desert Crossroads!

column1: 出事了？该不会是被那群大嘴鸟给叼走了吧？
column2: Trouble? Don't tell me those Peco Pecos carried them off?

column1: 正是！队长被大嘴鸟抓走了，剩下的货物也散落了一地，被摩卡弄的乱七八糟，没人看管。我们人手不够，实在没办法了……
column2: Exactly! The Peco Pecos abducted our Party Leader, while the remaining cargo was scattered everywhere and made a complete mess by the Mukas. There's nobody to guard it, and we don't have enough people to handle everything...

column1: 求你了，能不能帮帮忙，我们真的没时间了……
column2: Please, can you help us? We really don't have any time left...
Thank You! Thank you so much!

column1: 好啊好啊，果然又要开始跑腿了，冲哇！
column2: All right, All right! Another errand, just as expected. Let's go!

column1: 终于来了啊。我还以为那只肥鸟要把我当点心叼走了呢。谢谢啦，冒险者。
column2: Finally! I thought that fat bird was going to carry me off as a snack. Thank You, Adventurer.

column1: 诶？你是谁啊，也是被大嘴鸟抓来的吗？
column2: Huh? Who are you? Did the Peco Pecos capture you too?

column1: 这个送给你。算是谢礼，也是……为了让我们下次见面时，你能认出我来。
column2: This is for you. Consider it a token of my gratitude and... something to help you recognize Me the next time we meet.

column1: 哇哇哇，你这个女人好奇怪，第一次见面就送礼吗？这里面不会有什么猫腻吧！
column2: Whoa, whoa, whoa! You're a strange Woman! Giving us a gift the first time we meet? This isn't some kind of trick, is it?

column1: 哦？冒险者偶遇落难美女，美女获救后赠送珍宝——这不是很常见的情节吗？没必要这么大惊小怪吧。
column2: Oh? An Adventurer encounters a beautiful Woman in distress, and she rewards her rescuer with a treasure—isn't that a common enough tale? There's no need to make such a fuss.

column1: 女人把东西一把塞进你的手中，你根本来不及拒绝。
column2: The Woman thrusts the item into your hand before you have a chance to Reject it.

column1: 好了好了，快收下吧~我可不是坏人，只是一个流浪四方的吟游诗人罢了。
column2: All right, All right, go ahead and Receive it~ I'm no villain, merely a wandering Bard.

column1: 哎呀，这个可怜的男人还等着被你叫醒呢，干嘛对我这么好奇呢？我得走了，我们很快还会再见的。
column2: Oh my, this poor man is still waiting for you to wake him. Why are you so curious about Me? I must be going, but we'll meet again very soon.

column1: 奇怪，为什么有种觉得她很熟悉的感觉……
column2: Strange... Why does she feel so familiar...?

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，虽然这人神神叨叨的……但我总觉得，她好像认识你很久了。算了，先去看看那个队长吧，这罗盘……你就先留着吧。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, she may have been acting all mysterious... but I can't shake the feeling that she's known you for a very long time. Oh well. Let's check on that Party Leader first. As for this compass... You should hold on to it for now.

column1: 天啊……我刚才以为我要变成大嘴鸟宝宝们的午餐了！那群长着大嘴的小混蛋，一直在我耳边“嘎嘎”叫，还不停地在我身上乱啄，真是太恐怖了！
column2: Oh my... I thought I was about to become lunch for those baby Peco Pecos! Those big-beaked little brats kept squawking in my ears and pecking me all over! It was terrifying!

column1: 咳咳……无论如何，真的太感谢你了。要不是你及时赶到，我估计现在已经在那个鸟窝里被啄成骨头架子了。
column2: Ahem... Anyway, I really can't Thank You enough. If you hadn't arrived when you did, I'd probably be a skeleton picked clean in that nest by now.

column1: 既然你没事了，那我们就赶紧回去吧，飞空艇已经等了你们好久了！
column2: Now that you're all right, let's hurry back. The airship has been waiting for you for ages!

column1: 你说得对，都是我的疏忽……回去后整理好货物就能立刻起飞了。我们先回伊斯鲁德吧，到了那边，我一定好好酬谢你们！
column2: You're right. It was all my fault... Once we get back and organize the cargo, we'll be ready to take off. Let's return to Izlude first. I promise I'll reward you handsomely when we get there!

column1: 当然需要了！你能这么问，可真是太贴心了。我在港口那边等你，冒险者，咱们回见。
column2: Of course! How thoughtful of you to ask. I'll be waiting at the harbor, Adventurer. See you there.

column1: 虽然刚才在沙漠里出了点小意外……咳，但咱们商队一向信誉良好，只要把这些东西码放整齐，马上就能登船出发！
column2: We had a little mishap in the desert... Ahem, but our caravan has an excellent Reputation. As soon as we stack this cargo neatly, we can board and depart!

column1: 来吧，热心的冒险者——^{1}PlayerName^{2}，准备好了吗？咱们来一起摆放货物。
column2: Come, kindhearted Adventurer—^{1}PlayerName^{2}, are you Ready? Let's arrange the cargo together.

column1: 干得漂亮。新人。因为有了你的帮助，我们可以马上起飞了。
column2: Excellent work, rookie. Thanks to your help, we can take off immediately.

column1: 时间紧迫，我长话短说。我们这次的任务，是前往苏克拉特沙漠，寻找失踪的莱恩教授。
column2: Time is short, so I'll get straight to the point. Our mission is to travel to Sograt Desert and Find the missing Professor Ryan.

column1: 我们将乘坐这艘‘白鸽号’货运飞艇，先抵达沙漠入口的梦罗克。还有什么想了解的，现在可以问我。
column2: We'll take the White Dove cargo airship to Morroc, at the entrance to the desert. If there's anything else you'd like to know, ask me now.
What's so special about the White Dove?

column1: 莱恩教授究竟是什么人？
眼光不错！‘白鸽号’属于巴基力航空公司，是教国和共和国合作的象征。名义上是货运，但保留了客运舱，最适合我们这种需要低调行事的队伍。
column2: Good eye! The White Dove belongs to Valkyrie Airlines and symbolizes the partnership between the Church State and the Republic. It's officially a cargo ship, but it still has a passenger cabin, making it perfect for teams like ours that need to keep a low profile.

column1: 他的安全，是任务最高优先級。
column2: His safety is the Quests' highest priority.

column1: 所以，我们必须要找到他，保证他的安全。
column2: That's why we must find him and ensure his safety.

column1: 所以，别担心那么多，跟我走就是了。我会把你们全都安全带回来的。
column2: So don't worry so much. Just follow Me, and I'll bring all of you back safely.

column1: 好了，没有疑问了吧？拿好你的船票，新人。准备登船。
column2: All right, no more questions, right? Take your ticket, rookie. Get ready to board.

column1: 哎呀，对了！差点忘记给你天赋石了！等会儿在天上，万一遇到危险，你总得有点自保的手段。这玩意有大用处，快拿着。
column2: Oh, right! I almost forgot to give you a Talent Stone! If we run into trouble up there, you'll need some way to defend yourself. This thing will be a huge help, so take it.

column1: 好的，请带好随身行李，立刻登船。
column2: All right. Please gather your belongings and board immediately.

column1: 呜……大笨蛋！吓死波波了，波波还以为你的脑袋被撞坏了呢！
column2: Wah... You big dummy! You scared Bobo half to death! Bobo thought you'd hurt your head!

column1: 是的。我想向你打听一个人。最近你见过一名叫莱恩的学者吗？戴着眼镜，眼神很不好，文质彬彬的。
column2: Yes. I'm trying to Find someone. Have you seen a scholar named Ryan Recent? He wears glasses, has terrible eyesight, and is very refined.

column1: 莱恩，戴眼镜，眼神不好……他的家乡是不是在斐扬？他是不是还在朱诺留过学？
column2: Ryan... Glasses, poor eyesight... Is he from Payon? Did he also study abroad in Juno?

column1: 最近一周都住在营地里，每天早出晚归的，哦！今天早上他出门前我还跟他打招呼了呢。今天一大早他又带着设备^{1}往营地的西边^{2} 去了，说是要去找什么【思念粒子】。那家伙倔得很，劝他找个帮手也不听。
column2: He's been staying at the camp for the past week, leaving early and returning late every day. Oh! I even said hello to him before he left this morning. He headed west^{2} of the camp at dawn with his equipment^{1}, saying he was looking for something called [Memory Particles]. He's so stubborn—he wouldn't listen when I told him to find someone to help.

column1: 寻找教授的任务，就先交给你了。我需要先向总部汇报“白鸽号”的重大事故，等搞定这件事，我再回来和你汇合。
column2: I'll leave the Find the Professor Quests to you for now. I need to report the White Dove's major accident to headquarters. Once that's taken care of, I'll rejoin you.

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，走吧，又到了咱俩大显身手的时候了。
column2: Come on, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. It's time for the two of us to shine again.

column1: 呼……总算清静了。谢谢你，朋友，这些沙漠苍蝇简直比魔物还难缠。我从没在附近见过你啊，新来的？
column2: Phew... Finally, some peace and quiet. Thank You, my friend. These desert Chonchons are even more annoying than monsters. I've never seen you Nearby before. Are you new here?

column1: 对，我们在找一个戴着眼镜，黄色头发的中年男人，你见过他吗？
column2: Yes. We're looking for a middle-aged man with glasses and Yellow hair. Have you seen him?

column1: 是不是还穿着西装？这种人在这片区域还挺乍眼的。大概两小时前，我亲眼见他往西边——就是蚂蚁密穴那个方向去了。
column2: Was he wearing a suit, too? Someone like that really stands out around here. About two hours ago, I saw him heading west—toward Ant Hell.

column1: 蚂蚁密穴？听起来就让人浑身发毛，那老头儿去那种鬼地方干嘛？
column2: Ant Hell? Just hearing that gives me the creeps. What's that old guy doing in a horrible place like that?

column1: 等等，你这只宠物……刚才是在说话吗？天哪，这是波利变异种？还是恶魔系的高智慧个体？这简直是活体解剖的……不，是学术研究的无价之宝啊！
column2: Wait, did that Pet of yours just talk? My goodness! Is it a Poring mutant, or perhaps a highly intelligent Demon? It's an invaluable specimen for live dissection... No, for academic research!

column1: 你这怪人看什么看！别靠近我！而且……我不是他的宠物！
column2: What are you staring at, you weirdo?! Don't Approach Me! And... I'm not his Pet!

column1: 别动别动！让我量量你的头围，还有这翅膀的扇动频率！我从来没见过智商这么高的恶魔波利……
column2: Hold still! Let Me measure your head circumference and the frequency of those wingbeats! I've never seen such an intelligent Deviling...

column1: 快走，这人是个疯子，教授往那边走了，咱们赶紧溜！
column2: Let's go! This guy's crazy. The Professor went that way, so let's get out of here!

column1: 没找着？那老头儿真是滑得像条沙蛇。我也派了一位老练的冒险者去蚂蚁密穴附近寻找了，那地方不适合新手乱闯。
column2: You didn't Find him? That old man is as slippery as a desert snake. I also sent a seasoned Adventurer to search Nearby Ant Hell. It's no place for rookies to wander around.

column1: 有线索我会通知你们，现在，老老实实待在营火旁边，别到处乱跑。
column2: I'll send you a Notification if I Discover a Clue. For now, stay by the campfire and don't wander off.

column1: 你知道吗， 二转的真正战力核心在于那些你新获得的技能。
column2: You know, the true core of your Second Job combat power lies in the new skills you've acquired.

column1: 哇！还有新招式要学吗？是不是那种一挥手就能召唤大风暴，或者一跺脚就能把蚂蚁密穴震塌的厉害功夫？
column2: Whoa! There are more new moves to learn? Like Summon a giant storm with one wave of your hand, or stomp so hard that Ant Hell collapses?

column1: 修炼职业必须得脚踏实地，如果想成为名震一方的冒险者，你必须从掌握好二转的新技能开始。
column2: Mastering your job takes steady effort. If you want to become a renowned Adventurer, you must start by mastering your new Second Job skills.

column1: 很好，看来你已经完全掌握了新力量的精髓。懂得审视并分配技能点，说明你已经开始像个真正的冒险者那样思考了。
column2: Excellent. It seems you've fully grasped the essence of your new power. Knowing how to review and Allocate Skill Points. shows that you're beginning to think like a true Adventurer.

column1: 但只掌握技能还不够。二转后，新的^{1}【天赋】^{2}系统已经开启了。去吧，这是能够决定你能力上限的关键。
column2: But mastering skills isn't enough. After your Second Job, the new ^{1}[Talent]^{2} System has been unlocked. Go—this is the key to determining the limits of your abilities.

column1: 回来了？我派出去的人刚回来，在蚂蚁密穴第一层发现了莱恩教授的脚印。他应该就在里面，只是还不清楚具体位置。
column2: You're back? The scout I sent just returned. They found Professor Ryan's Footprints on the first floor of Ant Hell. He should be inside, but we still don't know his exact location.

column1: 哎呀，这地方听起来都觉得瘆得慌，我们还是等保亚和唔勒回来以后再一起去吧。
column2: Ugh, that place sounds terrifying. Let's wait for Boya and Wuhler to return, then go together.

column1: 那俩家伙估计正在附近和皮里恩干架呢，估计脱不开身。
column2: Those two are probably fighting Phreeoni Nearby, so I doubt they can get away.

column1: 本来不应该让你这样的新人去的，但你刚转职完，看上去身手也挺利索，教授没有自保能力，我们必须争分夺秒。
column2: I shouldn't send a rookie like you, but you've just completed your Job Advance and seem capable. The Professor can't defend himself, so every second counts.

column1: 要去吗？听你的。不过，要是敢有蚂蚁咬我，我可要放火烧洞了……
column2: Do you want to go? It's your call. But if any ants bite Me, I'm setting the whole cave on fire...

column1: 够勇敢，不愧是乐园团的人。如果你在蚂蚁密穴遇到危险，可以找费因斯帮忙，你们之前见过。
column2: Brave of you. That's an Eden Group member for you. If you're in danger inside Ant Hell, ask Fiennes for help. You've met before.

column1: 你看，地上好像有东西诶！
column2: Look! I think there's something on the ground!

column1: 会不会是教授的东西啊，快去看看。
column2: Could it belong to the Professor? Hurry, let's take a look.

column1: 喂！你就是莱恩教授吧！你还好吗？
column2: Hey! You're Professor Ryan, right? Are you okay?
Hey there! Good to see you again.

column1: 我就是霍克派出来寻找教授，顺便采集样本的那个倒霉蛋，自我介绍一下，我的名字叫费因斯，是一名炼金术学者。
column2: I'm the poor sap Hawke sent to Find the Professor and collect samples along the way. Allow Me to introduce myself. My name is Fiennes, and I'm an alchemy scholar.

column1: 天啊……你们刚才看到了吧，太壮观了！这就是蚁后的拟态变形吗？居然能模拟出人类女性的形态，这简直是魔物学奇迹！
column2: My goodness... You saw that, didn't you? Magnificent! Was that Maya's mimicry transformation? She actually assumed the form of a human woman! This is a miracle of monster biology!

column1: 喂，你还有空研究这个？那个大蚂蚁精把教授抓走当储备粮了，我们要去救人！
column2: Hey, you have time to study this?! That giant ant freak carried off the Professor as emergency rations! We have to save him!

column1: 别急别急，听我说。你们看，这蚂蚁密穴呢，其实只是蚁穴的外围，蚁后所居住的地方呢，在蚁穴的最深处，那里也是她的产房。
column2: Easy, easy—hear Me out. Ant Hell is really just the outer edge of the ant nest. Maya lives in its deepest reaches, where her brood chamber is also located.

column1: 那里通道错综复杂，你们根本找不到入口。不过…… 【寻路蚁】可以闻到蚁后留下的独特信息素。只要你们跟着它，就能直达老巢。
column2: The passages there form a complicated maze, so you'll never Find the entrance on your own. But... a [Pathfinder Ant] can smell Maya's unique pheromones. Follow it, and it'll lead you straight to her lair.

column1: 这样吧，你们去干掉几只附近的蚂蚁，把他们的身体碎片给我带回来，什么都行！我用炼金术催化一下，就能给你整出一只听话的寻路蚁来。
column2: Here's the plan: take out a few Nearby ants and bring Me fragments of their bodies. Any Material will do! I'll catalyze it with alchemy and make you an obedient Pathfinder Ant.

column1: 又是找材料？这法子能行吗？教授能不能撑到那时候啊……
column2: We're gathering Material again? Will this really work? Can the Professor hold out that long...?

column1: 相信科学，小恶魔波利。快去快回，我保证效率！
column2: Trust in science, you little devil of a Poring. Hurry back—I guarantee results!

column1: 不错不错！材料很新鲜！看好了，这可是高级炼金术！
column2: Excellent! This Material is incredibly fresh! Watch closely—this is advanced alchemy!

column1: 一阵刺眼的闪光和刺鼻的烟雾过后，菲音斯手里多了一只通体发红、触角不断抖动的怪蚂蚁。
column2: After a blinding flash and a cloud of acrid smoke, a strange, red-bodied ant with twitching antennae appeared in Phines's hand.

column1: 成了！这就是寻路蚁。等下你们走到岔路口把它放出来，它就会自动追踪蚁后的信息素，你们只要跟着它走就行。要注意，它如果钻洞了，你们也得跟着钻进去。
column2: It worked! This is the Pathfinder Ant. When you reach a fork in the road, Release it, and it'll automatically track Maya's pheromones. All you have to do is follow it. Notes: If it crawls into a hole, you'll have to follow it inside.

column1: 啊？要钻洞！我的天，里面该不会全是蚂蚁吧？
column2: What? We have to crawl into a hole?! Oh my gosh, it's not going to be full of ants, is it?

column1: 里面肯定很危险，毕竟是蚁后的老巢。不过嘛……小家伙，你要是被那些蚂蚁咬坏了就太可惜了。对了，你的宠物卖吗？多少钱都行，我可以拿新炼的高级宠物跟你换！
column2: It'll definitely be dangerous in there. It is Maya's lair, after all. But... it'd be such a shame if those ants hurt you, little one. By the way, is your Pet for sale? Name your price! I'll even trade you a newly refined, high-grade Pet!

column1: 你这疯子！听到没有，我都说过我不是他的宠物了！
column2: You lunatic! Are you even listening? I already told you I'm not his Pet!

column1: 唉，真是暴殄天物……行吧，那咱们后会有期。我还会再见到你的，小波利，一定会的。
column2: What a terrible waste... Fine, until we meet again. And we will meet again, little Poring. I know we will.

column1: 干得漂亮。能把人从蚁后眼皮子底下捞出来，现在的你，确实已经有资格参与这种级别的机密任务了。
column2: Nicely done. After rescuing someone right from under Maya's nose, you've proven that you have the Eligibility to take on classified Quests of this caliber.

column1: 咳咳，感谢你们的帮助。我记录了沿途的魔法波动数据，这对我当下的研究课题很有帮助。
column2: Ahem. Thank You for your help. I made a Record of the Magic fluctuation Data along the way. It'll be very useful for my current research.

column1: 行了，人没事就好，这鬼地方我是一秒钟都不想多待了。收拾一下，我们立刻回营地。
column2: All right, as long as everyone's safe. I don't want to spend another second in this wretched place. Pack up—we're returning to camp immediately.

column1: 你们先走吧，我和^{1}PlayerName^{2}还有点事，等一下再回去。
column2: You all go on ahead. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} and I still have something to take care of. We'll return later.

column1: 好，这附近很危险，注意安全。
column2: All right. This area is dangerous, so be careful.

column1: 哼哼，笨蛋！经过刚才的危机，我已经充分认可了你的实力。
column2: Heh-heh, dummy! After seeing how you handled that crisis, I fully acknowledge your strength.

column1: 我们签订契约吧，这样未来遇到危险的时候，我们就可以一起战斗了。
column2: Let's form a pact. Then, whenever danger strikes, we can fight together.

column1: 回来了？听说你把教授从蚁后嘴里抠出来了。行啊，你这身手确实硬朗。
column2: You're back? I heard you pulled the Professor right out of Maya's jaws. Not bad—you've certainly got some serious skills.

column1: 任务圆满结束。霍克，这次多谢你的情报和接应。
column2: Quests complete. Hawke, Thank You for the intelligence and backup.

column1: 都是老朋友了，相互照应是应该的。对了，^{1}PlayerName^{2}，费因斯托我转交给你个玩意儿。他说这是“宠物孵化器”，具体怎么用他也没说清楚，就让你回普隆德拉找个宠物商人了解一下用法。
column2: That's what old friends are for. Oh, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Phines asked me to give you this thing. He called it a "Pet Incubator," but didn't explain how to use it. He just said to return to Prontera and ask a Pet Merchant about it.

column1: 那个疯疯癫癫的炼金术师？他居然送你礼物？该不会又在打我的主意吧。
column2: That crazy alchemist? He actually gave you a gift? He's not after Me again, is he?

column1: 别废话了，拿着。你们赶紧都回城里去吧，别在这沙漠里吹风了。
column2: Enough talk. Take it. Now, both of you, Return to Town. Stop standing around in this desert wind.
Let's set out and return to Prontera.
Ha! Didn't expect to see Me again, did you?

column1: 来来来，把孵化器给我。这可是结合了魔物生态学的最新成果，只要把蛋放进去，调整好温度，很快就能孵出一只听你话的小家伙。
column2: Come on, hand me the incubator. This is the latest achievement in monster ecology. Just put an egg inside, adjust the temperature, and you'll soon Hatch a little creature that'll obey your every command.

column1: 你这家伙又在搞什么危险的实验？要是敢孵出什么奇怪的触手怪，我可第一个烧了你的店！
column2: What kind of dangerous experiment are you running this time? If you Hatch some weird tentacle monster, I'll be the first to burn your shop down!

column1: 不不不，这可是盛行整个米德加兹大陆的炼金孵化法，快去试试。
column2: No, no, no! This alchemical hatching method is all the rage across the entire Midgard continent. Go try it!

column1: 恭喜你啊，掌握了孵化宠物的秘诀。
column2: Congratulations! You've learned the secret of Pet Hatching.

column1: 这可不是普通的跟班，它不仅能帮你打架、提升属性，以后还能带去爬那些高难度的塔，用处很大哦。
column2: This isn't just a Normal sidekick. It can help you in Battle, boost your stats, and even accompany you into high-Difficulty towers later on. It's incredibly useful!

column1: 不过……你既然有的新的宠物，不如考虑把波波给我？我一定会好好对它的~
column2: But... now that you have a new Pet, why not give Bobo to Me? I promise I'll take good care of Bobo~

column1: 喂，你少在那儿吹牛了。这些家伙看起来呆头呆脑的，肯定没我厉害！
column2: Hey, quit bragging! These guys look like a bunch of dimwits. There's no way they're stronger than Me!

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，你来了。艾昆妮团长刚才传话过来，说她手头事务繁忙，以后有什么需要跑腿、出力或者深入险境的活儿，都尽管吩咐你去做。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're here. Captain Aikuni just sent word that she's swamped with work. From now on, if we need someone to run errands, lend a hand, or venture Into Peril, we're free to send you.

column1: 什么叫“跑腿的活”啊？她有点过分了。
column2: What does she mean by "run errands"? She's gone a little too far.

column1: 别吵，那个黑色的……煤球精，离我的实验器材远一点。
column2: Quiet! You there—the black... soot sprite. Stay away from my experimental equipment.

column1: 其实我一直在研究普隆德拉里出现的那些“界律之钉”。我觉得它们和优佩雷斯失传已久的“思念体”技术有关。给你看看这个，这是我当时在蚂蚁密穴收集到的样本。
column2: I've actually been studying the "Nails of World Law" appearing throughout Prontera. I believe they're connected to Juperos's long-lost "Thought Form" technology. Take a look at this. It's a sample I collected in the Ant Cavern.

column1: 小心拿好，这可是很珍贵的研究材料……虽然看起来好像只是一团魔法辉光。
column2: Handle it carefully. This is extremely valuable research Material... even if it does look like nothing more than a glowing mass of Magic.

column1: 你已经看到过罗盘向你展示的景象了吧？
column2: You've already seen the vision the compass showed you, haven't you?

column1: 那是对未来的预示。它的作用还不仅于此，收好它吧，未来它还会有更重要的作用。
column2: It was a glimpse of the future. But that isn't its only purpose. Keep it safe—it will play an even more important role in the future.

column1: 其他的……现在我还不能告诉你太多。我能够说的是，至今你所经历的一切，都只是宏大乐章中的第一个小节而已。
column2: As for everything else... I can't tell you much right now. All I can say is that everything you've experienced so far is merely the first measure of a grand symphony.

column1: 而你，将成为唯一能决定它们命运的人。
column2: And You will be the only one capable of deciding their fate.

column1: 这个地方很漂亮，比^{1}PlayerName^{2}的背包舒服多了~就是……怎么觉得有点熟悉呢？
column2: This place is beautiful! It's much more comfortable than ^{1}PlayerName^{2}'s Backpack~ But... why does it feel so familiar?

column1: 时间差不多了，你该回去了。
column2: It's almost time. You should go back.

column1: 下次见面时……希望你能带来更有趣的故事。
column2: The next time we meet... I hope you'll bring Me a more interesting Story.

column1: 记住——坠落不是终结，而是另一种开始。
column2: Remember—falling is not the end. It is simply another beginning.

column1: 你刚才怎么了？突然像座雕像一样一动不动，还把“思念体”的存储瓶给碰碎了！我还以为你在沙漠里得了什么热疫病……
column2: What happened to you just now? You suddenly froze like a statue, and you even knocked over and shattered the "Thought Form" storage vial! I thought you'd caught some kind of desert fever...

column1: 唉……这可是我好不容易才提取出来的样本。算了，你没事就好。今天你也累了，先回去休息吧，我也得重新整理一下数据。
column2: Sigh... It took me so much effort to extract that sample. Never mind. As long as you're all right. You've had a long day, so go get some rest. I need to reorganize the Data anyway.

column1: 终于结束了！这一天过得比被大嘴鸟追还累！终于可以休息喽~
column2: It's finally over! Today was even more exhausting than being chased by a Peco Peco! Time to get some rest~

column1: 冒险者，许久未见。看你现在的心境与体魄，比起当初那个懵懂的新人，已然脱胎换骨，进阶的时机终于成熟了。
column2: Adventurer, it has been far too long. Your mind and body have undergone a complete transformation since you were an inexperienced novice. At last, the time for your Advance has come.

column1: 既然你已经做好了准备，我将为你举行二阶转职的仪式，让诸神的力量彻底融入你的血脉。
column2: Since you're Ready, I shall perform the Tier Two Job Advance Ritual and let the power of the gods fully merge with your blood.

column1: 来吧，转职后的你，将以全新的职业姿态，去迎接更严峻的挑战。
column2: Come. With your new job, You will face even greater Challenges.

column1: 祝贺你，冒险者。从今日起，你已正式晋升进阶二转的冒险者了。力量提升意味着责任加重，你也是时候提升一下自己的装备了。
column2: Congratulations, Adventurer. As of today, you have officially advanced to Trans. 2nd. Greater power brings greater responsibility, and it's time to improve your equipment.

column1: 去见见忽克连吧，他那里有特里图拉学院为每一位初心者准备的礼物。
column2: Go see Hollgrehenn. He has a gift from Tritura Academy for every Beginner.

column1: 哈哈！我就知道是你！好久不见啊，冒险者！听说你进阶二转了？这成长速度真是让人刮目相看。
column2: Ha-ha! I knew it was you! Long time no see, Adventurer! I heard you reached Trans. 2nd? Your growth has been nothing short of remarkable!

column1: 没错，特里图拉学院确实跟我有合作，所以每个冒险者，都能到我这里获得一份礼物。
column2: That's right. Tritura Academy does work with me, so every Adventurer can come here to receive a gift.

column1: 你也是时候自己动手打造进阶装备了。来，这是学院送你的高级材料，拿去练练手。快去试试，我赌你能打出金色传说！
column2: It's time for you to Craft your own advanced equipment. Here—this high-grade Material is a gift from the Academy. Use it for practice. Go on, give it a try! I bet you'll Craft a golden Legend!

column1: 不可原谅……教廷明明承诺过会保护研究设备，结果呢？那可是我花了三年调试的精密仪器！
column2: Unforgivable... The Church clearly promised to protect the research equipment, and look what happened! I spent three years calibrating that precision instrument!

column1: 哎呀，教授，您冷静点。这不就是个仪器嘛，我们肯定会赔的……
column2: Come now, Professor, please calm down. It's just an instrument. We'll certainly compensate you for it...

column1: 赔？你拿什么赔？那是整个米德加兹大陆唯一的原型机！没有它，我对“界律之钉”的研究至少要停滞三年！
column2: Compensate me? How? That was the only prototype on the entire Midgard continent! Without it, my research into the "Nails of World Law" will be set back by at least three years!

column1: 呃……确实是我们的疏忽。不过我们的调查员已经带人去追查线索了，您先消消气，我们会负责找回来的。
column2: Er... this was indeed our oversight. But our investigators have already taken a team to pursue the Clue. Please try to calm down. We'll take responsibility and recover it.

column1: 消气？这种不负责任的调查，我一个字都不信！要是找不回来，你们谁能填补我几年的研究成果？我现在只相信我的助手。
column2: Calm down? I don't believe a word of this irresponsible investigation! If you fail to recover it, which of you can replace years of my Research Results? The only person I trust now is my assistant.

column1: 唉，您这又是何苦……行吧，既然您坚持。我们在现场找到了这个，应该是窃贼落下的。
column2: Sigh... Why put yourself through this? Fine, if you insist. We found this at the scene. The thief must have dropped it.

column1: 你，教授的新助手是吧？喏，拿着，这个领结是遗留在犯罪现场的证物。
column2: You're the Professor's new assistant, right? Here, take this. This bow tie was left behind at the crime scene as evidence.

column1: 你拿着这东西去下水道第一层，和骑士团的调查员激昂见面。那家伙虽然贪吃，但肯定能追到踪迹。快去吧，我真是被骂的头都痛了。
column2: Take this to the first floor of the Culvert and meet Fervor, an investigator with the Knight Order. He's a glutton, but he'll definitely be able to track the scent. Now hurry. All this scolding is giving me a headache.

column1: 这领结……怎么闻起来有一股臭臭的味道？该不会是什么流浪汉偷了仪器吧？这下可有的忙了。
column2: This bow tie... Why does it smell so bad? Don't tell me some Vagrant stole the device. This is going to be a lot of work.

column1: 诶，这附近没有人呀，调查员在哪里？
column2: Huh? There's no one Nearby. Where's the investigator?

column1: 要不大喊一下他的名字吧，说不定他听到就会出来了，你觉得怎么样？
column2: Why don't we call out his name? Maybe he'll come out when he hears us. What do you think?

column1: 真是难以想象……调查员居然是条狗，那个骑士到底靠不靠谱啊？
column2: I can't believe it... The investigator is a dog! Can that Knight really be trusted?

column1: 好吧好吧~它说它确实是是在骑士团任职的调查员，让我们不要看不起它。
column2: Okay, okay~ It says it really is an investigator with the Knight Order and that we shouldn't look down on it.

column1: 你怎么能听懂狗的语言
column2: How can you understand a dog's Language?

column1: 好问题，我也不知道为什么，可能是天赋异禀吧，毕竟我可是米德加兹大陆智商最高的恶魔波利。
column2: Good question. No idea. Maybe I'm just exceptionally gifted. After all, I'm the smartest Deviling on the entire continent of Midgard.

column1: 它说你身上有证物，它要闻一下。应该是那个蝴蝶结吧？
column2: It says you have some evidence on you, and it wants to sniff it. It probably means that bow tie, right?

column1: 啧啧，谁把衣服扔在这里了？瞧瞧这布料，少得跟绷带似的，还沾了这么多猫毛……这主人是有多不讲卫生啊？穿这种衣服偷仪器，该不会是什么性感猫妖吧？
column2: Tsk, tsk. Who left these Clothes here? Look at this fabric—there's barely more than a bandage, and it's covered in cat hair... Just how filthy is the owner? Could the device have been stolen by some sexy cat Demon wearing this?

column1: （前爪疯狂刨地，尾巴甩得像螺旋桨，对着背心狂吠）汪汪汪！汪！汪汪汪汪！
column2: (Frantically paws at the ground, tail spinning like a propeller, and barks wildly at the vest) Woof, woof, woof! Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

column1: 哼，他说这味儿没错，就是那个偷东西的小偷留下的。虽然我不想承认，但这只边牧的鼻子确实挺灵光。
column2: Hmph. It says there's no mistaking the scent. The thief who stole the device left this behind. I hate to admit it, but this border collie really does have a sharp nose.

column1: 既然这家伙这么兴奋，那咱们就勉强跟着这位调查员走吧。只要顺着这股味道，应该能揪出那个变态毛贼。
column2: Since it's so excited, I suppose we can follow our dear investigator. If we follow this scent, we should be able to catch that perverted little thief.

column1: （鼻子贴在纸箱子附近疯狂嗅闻，发出了急切的叫声）汪！汪汪汪！汪汪！
column2: (Presses its nose close to the cardboard box, sniffing frantically and barking urgently) Woof! Woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof!

column1: 天啊！这又是什么鬼东西？！装着沙子的纸箱？里面的条状物是什么，呃，好臭！
column2: Oh my gosh! What the heck is this now?! A cardboard box full of sand? What are those little logs inside? Ugh, they stink!
It looks like a litter box.

column1: 什么？？？你的意思这是猫的排泄物？！
column2: What??? You mean that's cat poop?!

column1: （伸出舌头，作势就要去舔食纸箱里的“宝藏”）汪汪汪！
column2: (Sticks out his tongue, about to lick the "Treasure" in the cardboard box) Woof, woof, woof!

column1: 住口！激昂你给我停下！不准吃那个！那是排泄物！排泄物懂吗？！啊啊啊，我眼睛要瞎了！
column2: Stop! Fervor, don't you dare! You can't eat that! It's poop! Poop, understand?! Aaaah, I'm going blind!

column1: 这真的是线索吗？我看这只笨狗纯粹是想找地方加餐才把我们骗到这儿来的吧？
column2: Is this really a Clue? I bet this dumb dog only tricked us into coming here because he wanted a snack!

column1: 算了……看在那台珍贵仪器的份上，我就再信这贪吃鬼最后一次。赶紧走，趁我还没吐出来……
column2: Fine... For the sake of that precious device, I'll trust this glutton one last time. Let's go, before I throw up...

column1: （目光殷切地看向不远处的传送阵）汪汪！汪汪汪汪！
column2: (Looks eagerly toward the Teleport portal Nearby) Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

column1: 还得去下一层吗？这下水道的尽头到底是什么鬼地方……
column2: We have to go down another floor? What the heck is at the end of this Culvert...?

column1: 唉，真不知道这只傻狗靠不靠谱。走吧……要是这一层还有那种“粑粑线索”，我可真的要罢工了！
column2: Ugh, No idea. Can this dumb dog really be trusted? Let's go... But if there are any more "poop Clues" on this floor, I'm going on strike!

column1: 哎？激昂，怎么了？那不是个路人吗？你拦着他干嘛呀？
column2: Huh? What's wrong, Fervor? Isn't that just some passerby? Why are you stopping him?

column1: 别……别咬我！我是搞学术的！我在研究……研究城市蟑螂的种群分布！对，就是蟑螂！我是蟑螂研究员！
column2: D-Don't bite me! I'm an academic! I'm studying... the population distribution of urban cockroaches! Yes, cockroaches! I'm a cockroach researcher!

column1: 真的！我不骗你们！哦……我想起来了！一定是早上为了诱捕巨型蟑螂，我口袋里塞了两个肉三明治当诱饵，肯定是这个味道把这狗招来的！
column2: It's true! I'm not lying! Oh... I remember now! I put two meat sandwiches in my pockets this morning as bait for giant cockroaches. The smell must have attracted this dog!
Here... give them to it! Just don't let it bite me!

column1: 喂！激昂！你太没出息了吧！为了两个破三明治就把正事给忘了？那可是罪犯啊！
column2: Hey, Fervor! Have you no shame?! You forgot all about the job for two lousy sandwiches? That guy is a criminal!

column1: 还好这次是正常的食物。上次你偷吃猫砂盆里那坨“巧克力条”的事我还没忘呢，真是丢死人了。
column2: At least it's Regular food this time. I still haven't forgotten how you snuck a bite of that "chocolate bar" from the litter box. That was so embarrassing.

column1: 恶心到我了，它说它没有吃饱，还说……三明治没有“巧克力条”好吃。
column2: That's disgusting. It says it isn't full, and... that the sandwiches aren't as Delicious as the "chocolate bar."
Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof!

column1: 别再提吃的了！这一路上你简直是吃个没完，你到底是来工作的还是来吃自助餐的？骑士团都不给你饭吃吗？
column2: Enough about food! You've been eating nonstop this entire time. Are you here to work or hit the buffet? Doesn't the Knight Order feed you?

column1: 激昂，能不能认真点干活？下次再因为吃的耽误工作，我……我就把你的毛剃光！
column2: Fervor, could you please focus on the job? If food distracts you from your work again, I'll... I'll shave off all your fur!

column1: 喂，激昂，怎么又停下来了？这次又是闻到什么好吃的了？
column2: Hey, Fervor, why did you stop again? Did you smell something Delicious this time?

column1: 地上扔着一套衣服和一双鞋子，看起来有些眼熟……
column2: A set of Clothes and a pair of Shoes are lying on the ground. They look kind of familiar...

column1: 哈？人不见了，衣服扔这儿了？这什么操作？
column2: Huh? The guy vanished and left his Clothes here? What's going on?

column1: 等等……这好像是刚才那个人的衣服？哪个正经研究员会跑到这种臭水沟里，还把衣服鞋子全脱了扔这儿？这不明摆着是心虚跑路了吗！
column2: Wait... Aren't these the Clothes that guy was wearing? What respectable researcher would come down to this stinking drain, strip off all his Clothes and Shoes, and leave them here? He obviously felt guilty and ran away!

column1: （气得在空中转圈）我就说那家伙鬼鬼祟祟的！什么破三明治，肯定是他偷了东西，为了甩掉激昂才故意扔的诱饵！激昂，快闻闻，他往哪跑了？
column2: (Spins through the air in fury) I knew that guy was acting suspicious! Forget those stupid sandwiches—he must've stolen something and deliberately used them as bait to throw Fervor off his trail! Fervor, sniff around! Which way did he go?
Meow, meow, meow, meow... Meow, meow!

column1: 啊？怪不得能找过来。路易，凯蒂说它的领结在这些人手上啊，太卑鄙了！
column2: Huh? No wonder they found us. Louie, Katie says these people have its bow tie! How despicable!

column1: 明明是你们偷了教授的东西，到底是谁卑鄙啊？
column2: You're the ones who stole the Professor's things! Who's really despicable here?

column1: 诸位，冷静，冷静~何必这么充满敌意呢？既然我们手上都有对方想要的东西，不如采取一种更和平的方式来解决吧。
column2: Everyone, please, calm down~ Why all the hostility? Since we each have something the other party wants, why don't we resolve this in a more Peaceful manner?

column1: 非得这样吗？直接把他们揍到失忆不就好了……
column2: Do we have to? Why not just beat them until they lose their memories...?

column1: 正式自我介绍一下。我是路易·旁·希勒肯斯，一位被现行体制辜负的可怜人,也是这个小团体的.....嗯，战略顾问。
column2: Allow me to give you a Regular introduction. I am Louie von Schillerkens, a poor soul failed by the current system and... well, the strategic advisor of this little group.

column1: 我们愿意跟你交换你想要的东西。但你发现了我们的秘密，也不能就这样轻易地让你离开。不如这样……
column2: We're willing to give you what you want in exchange. But now that you've Discovered our secret, we can't simply let you leave. How about this...?

column1: 我们来玩个游戏吧,规则很简单。我们会躲进这三个铃铛里，而你，需要猜我们三个分别在哪里。猜对了，东西可以给你。猜错了嘛......你就得加入我们，从最底层的杂役做起!
column2: Let's play a game. The Rules are Easy. The three of us will hide inside these three Bells, and you'll have to guess where each of us is. Guess correctly, and we'll give you the item. Guess wrong... and you'll have to Join us, starting as our lowest-ranking lackey!

column1: 所以——按照备用计划，我们决定即刻搬家，后会有期啦~
column2: So, in accordance with our Alternate plan, we've decided to move out immediately. Until we meet again~

column1: 领结到手，那没用的破铜烂铁留给你们了！
column2: We've got the bow tie! You can keep that useless piece of junk!

column1: 回、回来了？我的天哪……竟然真的完整找回来了！
column2: It's back? Oh my gosh... You really brought it back in one piece!

column1: 这效率简直让骑士团那群饭桶汗颜。我就知道，把活交给可靠的人比让他们填一百张申请表管用多了。
column2: That kind of efficiency would put those idiots in the Knight Order to shame. I knew giving the job to someone reliable would work better than making them fill out a hundred Request forms.

column1: 还好核心部件没坏，但控制组件有点偏移。你先去忙你自己的事吧，我要立刻着手修复和校验，没个三天三夜搞不定。
column2: Fortunately, the core parts are intact, but the Control components are slightly misaligned. Go take care of whatever You need to do. I have to start the Repair and calibration immediately, and it'll take at least three days and nights.

column1: 这就把我们打发了？好歹我们也钻了臭水沟、看了不该看的东西……
column2: That's it? You're just dismissing us? We crawled through filthy sewers and saw things we were never meant to see...

column1: 哦，辛苦了。那个……酬劳拿好，不送。
column2: Oh, good work. Um... take your payment. That'll be all.
You're here! I desperately need your help.

column1: 前天傍晚，一支从朱诺来的商队在迷藏森林附近遭到了巴风特的袭击。那头该死的魔物现在就盘踞在那片区域，拦住了去路。
column2: The evening before last, a caravan from Juno was attacked by Baphomet Nearby the Hidden Forest. That damned Monster is still occupying the area and blocking the road.

column1: 更糟糕的是，我订购的核心零件就在那辆货车上。没有那个组件，这台仪器就是一堆废铁，根本不可能启动。
column2: Worse yet, the core part I ordered was on that wagon. Without that component, this instrument is nothing but scrap metal. There's no way to start it.

column1: 真是荒谬！教廷那群人整天守着界律之钉不许我们靠近，结果却纵容魔物在自家门口抢劫货物？这简直是渎职……
column2: How absurd! Those church officials guard the Nail of Discipline all day and refuse to let us Approach it, yet they allow Monsters to plunder cargo right under their noses? This is a complete dereliction of duty...

column1: 没办法，我只能指望你了，^{1}PlayerName^{2}。这次的任务非常危险，但我可以向卢恩王室申请一笔特别津贴作为你的报酬。请务必把零件带回来！
column2: I have no choice but to rely on you, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Of all your Quests, this one is very dangerous, but I can submit a Request to the Rune-Midgarts royal family for a special stipend as your reward. Please bring the part back!

column1: 你们是替莱恩教授来的吧？真是丢脸啊……收了教授那么多佣金，结果连半车零件都没保住。
column2: You're here on behalf of Professor Ryan, aren't you? How humiliating... We accepted such a large commission from the Professor, yet couldn't even protect half a wagonload of parts.

column1: 那头该死的巴风特从天而降，我们拼死抵抗也没用。现在那批货被他弄得乱七八糟，也没人敢去拿回来。
column2: That damned Baphomet descended from the sky, and even fighting for our lives did no good. He scattered the cargo everywhere, and now no one dares to retrieve it.

column1: 可恶的巴风特！要是我能再强一点，非得扒了那畜生的皮不可！
column2: Curse you, Baphomet! If I were only stronger, I'd skin that beast alive!

column1: 就是这个……流量控制阀，完好无损！你居然真的从巴风特手里抢回来了……不，是取回来了。
column2: This is it... the flow Control valve, completely intact! You actually took it back from Baphomet... No, I mean, retrieved it.

column1: 很好，有了这个，我的装置修复就能完成了。你先去城东北方向的骑士团驻地找我，我要在“界律之钉”的现场进行最终测试。
column2: Excellent. With this, I can finish the Repair of my device. Meet Me at the Knight Order outpost northeast of the city. I need to perform the final test at the Nail of Discipline.

column1: 喂！这就完了？你不夸夸我们吗？我们可是刚跟牛头怪干了一架诶！
column2: Hey! That's it? Aren't you going to praise us? We just fought a bull-headed Monster!

column1: 效率是学者的基本素养。晚了恐怕会有数据偏差……还有，别再叫它“牛头怪”了，那是巴风特，学名是“Minotaur”，一点都不严谨。
column2: Efficiency is a fundamental quality for any scholar. Arriving late could skew the Data... And stop calling it a "bull-headed Monster." That's Baphomet. Its scientific name is "Minotaur." Your terminology is terribly imprecise.

column1: 你来了。正好，仪器刚刚完成启动，可以开始现场实测了。
column2: You're here. Perfect timing—the instrument has just finished starting up, so we can begin the field test.

column1: 帮我把这台仪器搬到石柱基座旁边。千万要轻拿轻放。
column2: Help Me move this instrument beside the base of the Stone Pillar. Handle it with extreme care.

column1: 放好之后，就是最关键的一步。把机器顶部的机械软臂接在石柱表面。它就能够抽取“戒律之钉”内部流动的能量了。
column2: Once it's in position, we can perform the most critical step. Connect the mechanical flexible arm on top of the machine to the surface of the Stone Pillar. Then it can extract the energy flowing inside the Nail of Discipline.

column1: 这块黑漆漆的大石头到底是什么，随便接触难道不会对身体有害吗？
column2: What exactly is this huge black Stone? Won't making Contact with it harm us?

column1: 别胡说八道，这是严肃的实验！快动手，能量窗口只有几分钟，错过了又要等明天。
column2: Enough nonsense! This is a serious experiment! Hurry—the energy window will only last a few minutes. If we miss it, we'll have to wait until tomorrow.

column1: 止步。此处是“界律之钉”的封印区，闲杂人等严禁靠近。
column2: Stop. This is the sealed area surrounding the Nail of Discipline. Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden to Approach.

column1: 原来是那个疯疯癫癫的学者的人……哼，竟放任一个朱诺来的外人来摆弄这关乎王国安危的东西。
column2: So you're with that deranged scholar... Hmph. I can't believe they're allowing an outsider from Juno to tamper with something vital to the kingdom's security.

column1: 朱诺人？教授不是卢恩王国的学者吗？
column2: Someone from Juno? Isn't the Professor a scholar of the Rune Kingdom?

column1: 他在朱诺研究了十几年的魔法原理，满脑子都是些危险的异端理论。这和外国人有什么区别？不过既然有命令，我也不便阻拦。
column2: He spent more than a decade in Juno studying the principles of Magic, filling his head with dangerous, heretical theories. How does that make him any different from a foreigner? Still, I have my orders, so I won't stop you.

column1: 去吧，动作快点，小心接触。要是破坏了神迹，这责任可不是你承担得起的。
column2: Go on, but be quick and exercise caution when making Contact. If you Destroy this miracle, the consequences will be far beyond anything you can bear.

column1: 切，说得好像你们有多负责似的，上次还不是把仪器弄丢了。
column2: Hmph. You talk as if you're so responsible, but weren't you the ones who lost the instrument last time?

column1: 这确实是骑士团的责任。不过现在由我值守，绝不会再出这种纰漏。过去吧，尽快完成你的使命。
column2: That was indeed the Knight Order's responsibility. But I'm standing guard now, and I won't allow such a blunder to happen again. Go on and complete your mission as quickly as possible.

column1: 我的名字是布拉吉丝·斯嘉尔德，一名吟游诗人……也是这个时空的史诗记录者。
column2: My name is Bragis Skjald, a bard... and the chronicler of this timeline's epic.

column1: 这个时空即将迎来灭顶之灾，而你是唯一能解决这场危机的人。
column2: This timeline is on the verge of destruction, and you're the only one who can resolve this crisis.

column1: 或许听起来很俗套，但界律之钉对你的反应，就是最好的证明。
column2: It may sound cliché, but the way the Nail of Natural Law responds to you is all the proof we need.

column1: 你的罗盘……也快要开始收集‘灵魂残响’了吧？它们比你想象的更重要。
column2: Your compass... It should begin collecting Soul Echoes soon, shouldn't it? They're more important than you realize.

column1: 再会了，我的朋友。当你准备好时，我们会再次见面，届时，我会告诉你更多。
column2: Farewell, my friend. When you're ready, we'll meet again, and I'll tell you more.

column1: 冷静点，告诉我出了什么事？
column2: Calm down and tell me what happened.

column1: 长官，金字塔地区今天上午突然出现了一个奇怪的石台，而且金字塔地区的怪物现在异常躁动，攻击欲望很强！
column2: Sir, a strange Stone platform suddenly appeared in the Pyramid area this morning! The Monsters there have also become unusually agitated and extremely aggressive!
Oh? What do you mean by "suddenly appeared"?

column1: 呃，就是，仿佛神迹降临一般，突然凭空出现……
column2: Well... it simply materialized out of nowhere, almost as if a divine miracle had descended...

column1: 怪物的异常躁动是怎么回事？
column2: What's causing the Monsters' unusual agitation?

column1: 自从上午石台出现之后，金字塔地区的怪物不知道为什么变得很狂躁，已经有好几个冒险者受伤了！我们小队被派遣去那里清理魔物，完全无法应付啊！
column2: Ever since the stone platform appeared this morning, the Monsters in the Pyramid area have become extremely agitated for some unknown reason. Several Adventurers have already been injured! Our squad was sent to clear them out, but we can't handle them at all!

column1: 明白了，你现在就带我去现场支援。
column2: Understood. Take Me there immediately so I can provide Utility support.

column1: 莱恩教授，我们是去执行公务，这与你无关。
column2: Professor Ryan, we're carrying out official duties. This has nothing to do with you.

column1: 我不管，那玩意和界律之钉出现的方式一模一样，出现时间也相当接近，肯定有什么关联，我必须立刻去调查。
column2: I don't care. That thing appeared in exactly the same way as the Nail of Discipline, and at nearly the same time. There must be a connection. I have to investigate immediately.

column1: 看我干嘛，王后不是让你们全力协助我吗？你不乐意？
column2: Why are you looking at Me? Didn't the queen order you to give Me your full cooperation? Is that a problem?

column1: ……当然没有了。行，那你跟我们一起走吧。
column2: ...Of course not. Fine, you can come with us.

column1: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}，我先过去了，你有空的话也赶紧过来吧，估计会有很多活儿需要你来干。
column2: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm heading there now. Come over as soon as you have time. I'm sure we'll have plenty of work for you.

column1: 站住！金字塔一层现在被列为禁区，普通冒险者禁止入内，现在这里太危险了。
column2: Stop! The first floor of the Pyramid has been declared a restricted area. Normal Adventurers are forbidden from entering. It's far too dangerous right now.

column1: 神器……你是跟教授和伊西斯骑士一起的？那东西现在就在金字塔深处，自从它出现，这里的魔物就像疯了一样躁动不安。
column2: The Relic... Are you with the Professor and Knight Isis? That object is deep inside the Pyramid. Ever since it appeared, the Monsters here have been agitated beyond Control.

column1: 放心吧，我们就是专门来搞定那个神器的，我才不怕这里的魔物呢，^{1}PlayerName^{2}肯定能把他们打跑，对吧？
column2: No worries. We're here specifically to deal with that Relic! I'm not afraid of the Monsters here. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} can definitely drive them away, right?

column1: 好吧，看你们装备精良，应该实力不俗。既然这样，能不能帮我个忙？我的同僚应该正在这附近与魔物们苦战着……
column2: All right. You're wearing Fine equipment, so you must be capable. In that case, could you do Me a favor? My comrades should be fighting the Monsters Nearby...

column1: 如果你们在里面遇到他们，请务必施以援手，那些怪物的攻击力现在高的离谱，我怕他们撑不住。拜托了！
column2: If you encounter them inside, Please help them. The Monsters' ATK is absurdly high right now, and I'm afraid they won't last much longer!

column1: 太感谢了你了，冒险者。神器的大概方位，我已经帮你标出来了。请小心。
column2: Thank You so much, Adventurer. I've marked the Relic's approximate location for you. Be careful.

column1: 多谢出手相助！这帮红蝙蝠不知道发了什么疯，攻击欲望强得吓人……这里太危险了，你们赶紧原路返回吧。
column2: Thank You for your help! No idea what has gotten into these Drainliars, but they've become terrifyingly aggressive... It's too dangerous here. You should turn back immediately.

column1: 回去？开什么玩笑！我们是莱恩老头的助手，是专门来保护他的。这种程度的魔物，完全不在话下呀~
