column2: Go back? You've got to be kidding! We're old man Ryan's assistants, and we're here specifically to protect him. Monsters at this level are no problem at all~

column1: 哦……是那位跟骑士大人一起来的学者？难怪气势这么足。既然你们执意要前进，那务必小心。自从那个发光的玩意儿出现后，整座金字塔的怪物都像喝了烈酒一样狂暴。
column2: Oh... You're with the scholar who came with the Knight? No wonder you're so confident. If you're determined to move Forward, then Please be careful. Ever since that glowing object appeared, every Monster in the Pyramid has gone Berserk, as if they'd been guzzling strong liquor.

column1: 神器在哪个方向，可以帮我们地图上标注一下吗？谢谢啦！
column2: Which direction is the Relic? Could you mark it on our map? Thank You!

column1: 好，我明白了。神器的方向，我已经给你们标在地图上了。祝好运，冒险者……愿奥丁与你同在。
column2: Understood. I've marked the direction of the Relic on your map. Good luck, Adventurer... May Odin be with you.

column1: 谢……谢谢！你们怎么会闯到这种地方来？金字塔已经全面戒严了，这里极度危险！
column2: Th-Thank You! Why would you venture into a place like this? The entire Pyramid is under lockdown. It's extremely dangerous here!

column1: 我们是来保护莱恩教授的，接了委托就得负责到底。刚才我们还救了你的几个同事，他们已经没事了。
column2: We're here to protect Professor Ryan. Once we accept a request, we see it through to the end. We also rescued several of your colleagues just now. They're safe.

column1: 原来是教授的人……请务必万分小心，现在金字塔中，传说中最为凶恶的魔物“法老王”好像苏醒了。要是撞上它，那可真是凶多吉少。
column2: So you're with the Professor... Please be extremely careful. It seems Pharaoh, the most vicious Monster of Legend within the Pyramid, has awakened. If you encounter it, your chances of survival will be slim.

column1: 呃……法老王，那是什么东西，很厉害吗？只要它敢挡路，我们肯定能把它劈了当柴火烧，对吧？^{1}PlayerName^{2}。
column2: Uh... Pharaoh? What is that? Is it strong? If it gets in our way, we'll chop it up and burn it for firewood, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}?

column1: 好，我明白了。神器大概在这个方向，我帮你们标在地图上了。
column2: Understood. The Relic should be in this direction. I've marked it on your map.

column1: 太可怕了，越靠近神器，怪物的躁动就越失控。刚才那个法老王，简直像是从地狱里爬出来的一样……
column2: It's terrifying. The closer we get to the Relic, the further the Monsters spiral out of Control. That Pharaoh we just saw looked as though it had crawled straight out of hell...

column1: 你被石棺抓走后，法老王也跟着消失了。要不是你挺身而出把它引走，我们这些人恐怕早就变成这沙漠里的枯骨了。
column2: After the sarcophagus dragged you away, Pharaoh disappeared as well. If you hadn't stepped Forward and lured it away, all of us would probably be nothing but bleached bones in the desert by now.

column1: 对不起，之前在城门口是我态度不好。现在我收回那些话，你真是一位令人佩服的冒险者。这次真的多谢了，身体……没受什么内伤吧？那股吸力看着就不像是能活着出来的。
column2: I'm sorry. My attitude at the City Gate was No good. I take back what I said—you truly are an admirable Adventurer. Thank you for everything. You didn't suffer any internal injuries, did you? That suction looked impossible to survive.

column1: 嘻嘻，算你这傻大个有眼光。^{1}PlayerName^{2}运气好得很，毕竟还要带我去吃甜品呢。
column2: Hehe, not bad for a big dummy. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} is incredibly lucky, especially since they still have to take me out for dessert.

column1: 还好你没事。刚才那阵空间扭曲的动静可不小，我差点以为你被卷进法老王的空间里出不来了。
column2: Thank goodness you're all right. That Spatial Distortion caused quite a commotion. I was afraid you'd been pulled into Pharaoh's dimension and wouldn't make it back.
Want to hear about my new Discover?

column1: 这个神器上的符文结构和能量残留，跟普隆德拉城外的“戒律之钉”简直一模一样。这绝不是巧合，它们一定什么深层次的联系。
column2: The runic structure and residual energy on this Relic are identical to the Nail of Discipline Outside the City of Prontera. That can't be a coincidence. There must be some deeper connection between them.

column1: 之前只有你激活了城里的石柱，我折腾了几个月都没反应。既然这样……你要不要试着碰一下这个？放心，我让伊西斯在那边候着。万一被弹开，他那壮硕的身板应该大概能接住你。
column2: You're the only one who managed to Activate the Stone Pillar in the city. I spent months tinkering with it and got no response. So... would you like to try touching this? Don't worry, I have Isis standing by over there. If it throws you back, his sturdy frame should probably—maybe—be able to catch you.

column1: 臭老头，什么叫“应该大概”？要是接不住，我家冒险者可就要摔成肉饼了！不行！
column2: You stinky old man! What do you mean, "should probably—maybe"? If he doesn't catch my Adventurer, they'll be squashed flat! No good!

column1: 黑煤球精别干扰我的研究，我在问^{1}PlayerName^{2}！
column2: Stay out of my research, you black sootball freak! I'm asking ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

column1: 哈哈哈，不愧是我有觉悟，有干劲，有勇气的首席助手！
column2: Hahaha! That's my enlightened, motivated, and courageous Chief assistant!

column1: 哼，我看你真是昏了头了……
column2: Hmph. I think you've really lost your mind...

column1: 又见面了。看来，你已经找到了拼图的第二块碎片。
column2: We meet again. It seems you've found the second piece of the puzzle.

column1: 呼吸正常，但意识丧失……大概率是……脑震荡导致的保护性昏迷？再等等他就会醒……了吧？
column2: Breathing is normal, but there's no consciousness... Most likely... a protective coma caused by a concussion? If we wait a little longer, they'll wake up... right?

column1: 都怪你！非要他去碰那个破石头！这下把^{1}PlayerName^{2}的脑子撞坏了，怎么办啊！
column2: This is all your fault! You insisted they touch that stupid Stone! Now ^{1}PlayerName^{2} has brain damage! What are we going to do?!

column1: 嘶……理论上来说，这种强度的撞击，不会导致更严重的问题吧？
column2: Oof... Theoretically, an impact of this intensity shouldn't cause anything more serious... right?

column1: 两位，若是因为脑部受创导致窒息风险，需要我进行人工呼吸吗？哪怕牺牲我的尊严也在所不辞。
column2: If the head trauma poses a risk of Suffocation, would you like me to perform rescue breathing? I am prepared to do so, even at the cost of my dignity.

column1: 呃……对！按黄金四分钟原则，必须介入。骑士，你来！
column2: Uh... right! According to the Gold four-minute rule, we must intervene. Knight, you're up!
All right. For honor and duty...
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're finally awake! I was worried sick!

column1: 呼……还好你醒得及时，差点就……
column2: Phew... Thank goodness you woke up in time. We almost...

column1: 没事，没事，刚才我们商量着你要是还不醒，就让这位骑士大人把你背回普隆德拉。
column2: Nothing, nothing. We were just discussing having this esteemed Knight carry you back to Prontera if you didn't wake up.

column1: 哈哈哈，对，没错。既然你没事，我就先走了，我还有任务在身。
column2: Hahaha! Yes, exactly. Since you're okay, I'll be going. I still have a mission to carry out.

column1: 呼，你终于醒了！真的吓到我了……没想到那股反向推力这么大，直接把你崩晕了过去。
column2: Phew, you're finally awake! You really scared me... I never expected the recoil to be so powerful that it would knock you unconscious.

column1: 不过从结果来看，你的昏迷可是很有价值的。这再次证明了我的推断——这世上恐怕只有你才能激活这些玩意儿。教廷的人已经把那件神器运走了，暂时存放在皇宫里。
column2: Still, your unconsciousness proved quite valuable. It confirmed my theory once again—you may be the only person in the world capable of activating these things. The Church has already taken the Relic away and placed it in temporary storage at the palace.

column1: 好了，经历这么多危难时刻，你也累坏了。我在城南的『橡木旅店』有VIP会员，你去那儿休息吧，报我的名字就行，他们会安排最好的房间。
column2: All right, you've been through one danger after another, so you must be exhausted. I'm a VIP member at the Oak Inn in southern Prontera. Go rest there and give them my name. They'll arrange their best room for you.

column1: 喂！老头，你也太抠门了吧？^{1}PlayerName^{2}可是因为你受的伤，你就只给个房间睡觉？
column2: Hey! You stingy old man! ^{1}PlayerName^{2} got hurt because of you, and all you're offering is a room for the night?

column1: 废话，那已经是最高规格的待遇了。快走吧，我先回实验室整理数据，你也赶紧去补觉，养足精神，谁知道明天又会发生什么怪事。
column2: Of course! That's already the finest treatment available. Now get going. I'll return to the laboratory and organize the Data, and you should catch up on sleep. Get plenty of rest—who knows what strange things will happen tomorrow?

column1: 欢迎光临橡木旅店！请问是吃饭还是住店呢？还是想来上那么一小口~
column2: Welcome to the Oak Inn! Are you here for a meal or a room? Or perhaps a little drink~?

column1: 住店！记在那个臭老头莱恩教授的账上！他让我们来的。
column2: A room! Put it on that stinky old Professor Rhein's tab! He sent us.

column1: 啊，教授是我们这里的高级VIP会员，提起过你们两位。他特意嘱咐过，给您准备了二楼靠窗的安静房间——教授说您需要好好休息。
column2: Ah, the professor is one of our premium VIP members. He mentioned the two of you and specifically asked us to prepare a quiet room by the window on the second floor. He said you needed a good rest.

column1: 你回忆着最近几天经历的一切，一切都是那么的不真实。
column2: You think back on everything you've experienced over the Recent few days. None of it feels real.

column1: 想着想着，你觉得十分困倦，终于闭上了眼睛……
column2: As your thoughts wander, drowsiness overtakes you, and at last you close your eyes...

column1: 等你好久了，冒险者。我是一名致力于记录万物生态的魔物学者。
column2: I've been waiting for you, Adventurer. I'm a Monsterologist dedicated to creating a Record of every creature's ecology.

column1: 我在编写一本前所未有的《魔物大全》。但我需要的不是几张皮毛，而是深度的数据。听着，你去各地狩猎魔物，杀得越多越好，把它们的情报带回来给我。
column2: I'm compiling an unprecedented Encyclopedia of Monsters. But I don't need a few scraps of fur—I need comprehensive Data. Listen: travel far and wide, hunt monsters, Kill as many as you can, and bring their information back to me.

column1: 因为只有数量够了，我的研究才能深入，研究越深入，我能给你的回报就越惊人，这可是双赢。
column2: Only sufficient numbers will let me take my research deeper, and the deeper my research goes, the more amazing your rewards will be. We both win.
All right, go give it a try.

column1: 又见面了，冒险者。你这身装备升级得这么快，看来没少在外面拼命啊，佩服佩服！
column2: Good to see you again, Adventurer. You've managed to Level-up your equipment incredibly quickly. You must have been fighting for your life out there. Excellent work!

column1: 既然你都进阶了，有些事必须得教你了——那就是精炼！这可是米德加兹最大的“合法赌博”。来，把装备给我，咱们试试能不能把它冲碎……啊不，冲上巅峰！
column2: Now that you've advanced, there's something I have to teach you—Refine! It's Midgard's greatest form of "legal gambling." Come on, hand over your equipment and let's see if we can smash it to pieces... Er, I mean, send it soaring to new heights!

column1: 呃，教人赌博，天打雷劈啊~
column2: Uh-oh. Teaching someone to gamble is asking to get struck by lightning~

column1: 咳咳……别乱说。记住，这玩意儿三分靠运气，七分靠保护。要是爆了可别怪我，毕竟我也只是个“搬运”幸运女神眷顾的小铁匠。
column2: Ahem... Don't talk nonsense. Remember, this is 30% LUK and 70% Fortify. Don't blame me if it breaks. After all, I'm just a humble Blacksmith who "delivers" the Goddess of Fortune's blessings.

column1: 不过你也别太担心了，有新手保护期，前几次的成功率非常高哦！
column2: But don't worry too much. There's a beginner protection period, so the Success Rate is extremely high for your first few attempts!

column1: 今天我还要告诉你一项特殊的活动，名为“嘉奖宝库”。
column2: Today, I also want to tell you about a special event called the Commendation Vault.

column1: 这并非战斗训练，而是关于获取资源的途径。参与其中，你将有机会获得大量的金钱与经验回馈。
column2: This isn't Battle training. It's a way to Obtain Resources. By participating, you'll have a Chance to earn plenty of money and EXP.

column1: 金钱和经验？还有这种好事，波波也要参加！
column2: Money and EXP? What a sweet deal! Bobo wants to join too!

column1: 来吧，现在，让我来教你如何开启嘉奖宝库活动。
column2: Come. Now I'll teach you how to unlock the Commendation Vault event.

column1: 你好呀，冒险者。我们公司举办了一档电视竞技节目——卡普拉生存者之战，来玩玩看吧，最后的胜利者会得到超级大奖哦！
column2: Hello, Adventurer! Our company is hosting a televised competition called Kafra Survivor Showdown. Come give it a try—the last contestant standing will win a fantastic grand prize!

column1: 让我来教你如何进行活动报名吧~
column2: Let me show you how to register for the event~

column1: 又见面了，亲爱的冒险者^{1}PlayerName^{2}。还记得我送你的罗盘吗？你一直把它带在身边，但它其实远未发挥出真正的力量。
column2: We meet again, my dear Adventurer, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Do you remember the compass I gave you? You've carried it with you all this time, but it has yet to reveal its true power.

column1: 想要激活它深层的力量，你需要收集一种名为“灵魂残响”的东西。那是生灵在世间留下的记忆与强烈情感，蕴含着独特的频率，世间罕有。
column2: To Activate its deeper power, you must collect something called Soul Echo. These are the memories and powerful Emotions that living beings leave behind in the world. Each holds a unique frequency, making them exceptionally rare.

column1: 让我来告诉你该如何把这些残响镶嵌进去。唤醒罗盘真正的潜能吧。
column2: Let me show you how to Insert these echoes into the compass. Awaken its true potential.

column1: 你好，我们又见面了。别问我为什么会出现在这片酷热的沙漠里，为了见证优秀苗子的成长，我这把老骨头也只能到处奔波。
column2: Hello, we meet again. Don't ask why I've come to this scorching desert. To witness the growth of an Excellent prospect, these old bones of mine must travel far and wide.

column1: 哇！又见面了，最近我们换了很多新装备呢，怎么样，有没有变得更厉害！
column2: Wow, it's you again! We've gotten lots of new equipment Recent. What do you think? Do we look stronger?

column1: 光看装备可说明不了什么。我感受到了你体内涌动的、尚未完全受控的力量。 你也是时候进行职业二转了。
column2: Equipment alone proves nothing. I can sense power surging within you, still not fully under control. It's time for your Second Job Change.

column1: 来，击杀一些附近的魔物，让我看看你现在的实力吧。
column2: Come, Kill some Nearby monsters and show me your current strength.

column1: 很好，你对力量的掌控力，比第一次见面时沉稳多了。看来这片沙漠的历练，确实让你脱胎换骨。
column2: Excellent. Your control over your STR is much steadier than when we first met. Your trials in this desert have truly transformed you.

column1: 记住，二转不是终点，而是通往更残酷冒险的门票。从今天起，你的肩膀上要扛起更重的责任，别让我和支持你的人们失望。
column2: Remember, the Second Job isn't the end. It's your ticket to even harsher adventures. From this day forward, you'll shoulder greater responsibilities. Don't disappoint me or those who support you.

column1: 太棒啦！你转职后是不是就能把我这小身板也带飞了？我可不想每次都只能躲在后面喊加油。
column2: That's amazing! After your Job Advance, will you be able to carry little Me to victory too? I don't want to hide in the back and cheer every time.

column1: 好了，我们开始吧。来，把你的手放在转职之书，让我来引导你进行二转。
column2: All right, let's begin. Place your hand on the Book of Job Advance, and I'll guide you through your Second Job.

column1: 真是惊人的成长！你已经具备三转资质了，请在职业道路上继续前进吧！
column2: What astonishing growth! You're ready for your third job change. Continue onward along your chosen career path!

column1: 前方施工，暂时不开放通行，请稍后再来吧。
column2: The road ahead is under construction and temporarily closed. Please come back later.

column1: 深渊中似乎有什么东西注视着你……(仅队长可以进行目标选择)
column2: Something in the abyss seems to be watching you... (Only the Party Leader can select a target)

column1: 公会主建筑，决定公会可容纳成员上限。提升主建筑等级，公会成员数量也跟随提升
column2: The main guild building determines the Guild Member capacity. Level-up the main building to increase the Guild Member capacity.

column1: 公会商店内可购买个人养成、装饰道具。更高等级商店可解锁更多商品购买权限。
column2: Purchase character progression and decorative items in the Guild Store. More items Can be unlocked for purchase at higher Guild Store levels.

column1: 公会研究所等级决定当前解锁的公会科技。研究所等级越高，可解锁升级的公会科技效果越多。
column2: The Institute level determines which Guild Technologies are currently unlocked. As the Institute reaches higher levels, more Guild Technology effects Can be unlocked for Level-up.

column1: 公会卖场等级越高，可解锁更高级的公会礼包购买权限。
column2: Reach higher Guild Store levels to unlock access to more advanced guild gift packs.

column1: 攻城战未开启时也可查看器械储备
column2: Siege equipment reserves can be viewed even when the Siege War is not open.

column2: Participate in one Guild League and earn more than ^{1}@{1}^{2} individual points.

column2: Goodbye, imitators! Only the real RO can fight!

column1: 这是测试纸条（无需翻译）

没想到你居然能从月夜猫的手里溜出来，算你有点本事，不像之前的那些蠢货。
看来你勉强通过了我们精心设置的第一轮‘资格测试’——毕竟，连游戏都玩不起的家伙，可没资格做我们的对手。
不过别得意，刚才只是热身。如果你真以为自己有能力与我们抗衡，那就来梦罗克南部的沙海迷宫（具体坐标：@{1}, @{2}）做个了断吧。
我们在此郑重承诺——这次绝不失约，必将与你正面一战！
又及：这一战如果你输了，你身上的东西就都归我们了，胜利者理应赢得一切。
column2:
I can't believe you managed to slip away from Moonlight Flower. You've got some skill after all, unlike the fools who came before you.
It seems you've barely passed the first round of our carefully designed "qualification test." After all, anyone who can't even play the game has no right to challenge us.
But don't get cocky. That was just a warm-up. If you truly think you have what it takes to stand against us, come settle this at the Sandsea Labyrinth in South Morroc (exact coordinates: @{1}, @{2}).
We solemnly swear that we will keep our word this time and face you in a fair fight!
P.S. If you lose, everything you're carrying belongs to us. The victor deserves to take all.

column1: 愿你能抽出片刻。自从上次听闻你驾驭巨蚁穿越巢穴的经历，这个不可思议的情景就始终萦绕在我脑海里。基于我们那段……呃，不太愉快的共同记忆，我成功从残留的蚁后甲壳样本中逆向提取出了一种独特的信息素，我似乎找到了能够复制你那非凡经历的"钥匙"！\n这绝对是生物学上的一个妙趣横生的案例，我迫切需要一个见证者。请务必来普隆德拉西门附近的树林中找我。\n另外：如果方便，能顺路带给我一份三明治吗？我午餐又失踪了。
column2: I hope you can spare a moment. Ever since I heard about you riding a giant ant through the nest, I haven't been able to get that incredible image out of my mind. Drawing on our... ahem, less-than-pleasant shared experience, I successfully reverse-engineered a unique pheromone from the remaining Ant Queen carapace samples. I believe I've found the "key" to recreating your extraordinary feat!\nThis is an absolutely fascinating case study in biology, and I urgently need a witness. Please meet me in the woods near Prontera West Gate.\nOne more thing: If it's not too much trouble, could you bring me a sandwich on your way? My lunch has disappeared again.

column1:
我分别给莱恩教授和团长寄了信，但都没有回音。我猜想你很可能正和他们在一起”，所以这封信直接寄给你。
长话短说，情况有些棘手。一支为教授运送重要包裹、从朱诺出发的陆运商队，在森林边缘一带再次遭到了巴风特的袭击。货物目前下落不明，万幸的是商队人员大多只是轻伤，已经安全撤回。
这件事需要尽快处理。如果你那边方便，请务必把这件事转告教授和团长。
具体的位置和情况，已经随信附上了。
column2:
I sent letters to both Professor Ryan and the Captain, but neither has responded. I suspect you're probably with them, so I'm sending this letter directly to you.
To make a long story short, we have a difficult situation. A caravan traveling overland from Juno with an important package for the Professor was attacked by Baphomet near the edge of the forest—again. The cargo is currently missing, but fortunately, most of the caravan members suffered only minor injuries and made it back safely.
This matter must be handled as soon as possible. If you can, please make sure the Professor and the Captain hear about it.
I've enclosed the exact location and details with this letter.

column1: 普隆德拉的公告板最近贴了张有趣的悬赏令，关于一个神出鬼没的盗贼团伙。卫兵队那帮老古板查了半天毫无头绪，我觉得这麻烦事儿正好对你胃口。\n委托金不错，更重要的是，我直觉这事背后不简单。你办事机灵，由你来调查我最放心。\n我已经跟守卫打过招呼了，你直接去查看悬赏令就好。放手去查，有什么需要帮忙的，随时来乐园找我。
column2: An interesting bounty was recently posted on the Prontera bulletin board. It's about an elusive band of Thieves. Those old sticks-in-the-mud in the guard have been investigating for ages without finding a single lead, and I thought this case would be right up your alley.\nThe pay is good, but more importantly, my instincts tell me there's more to this than meets the eye. You're resourceful, so I trust you to investigate it.\nI've already spoken to the guards, so just go take a look at the bounty notice. Follow the trail wherever it leads, and if you need any help, come find me at Eden Group anytime.

column1:
你那偷偷摸摸的跟踪技巧，真是猥琐得让人看不下去！像你这样躲在暗处的老鼠，也配追查我们Z集团的行踪？
不过，你的穷追不舍虽然可笑，倒也算有几分胆量。我们大发慈悲，决定给你一个正面了断的机会。
如果你不想一辈子当个只会在城里打听八卦的懦夫，那就单枪匹马到斐扬南部的水潭边来。我们在此恭候，让你见识一下什么叫真正的实力。
当然，如果你怕了，大可以继续当你的缩头乌龟！
column2:
Your pathetic attempt at sneaking around is downright painful to watch! What makes a Mouse hiding in the shadows like you think you're worthy of tracking the Z Group?
Your relentless pursuit may be laughable, but at least you've shown a little courage. In our boundless mercy, we've decided to give you a chance to settle this face-to-face.
If you don't want to spend your life as a coward who does nothing but chase rumors around town, come alone to the pond in Southern Payon. We'll be waiting to show you what true power looks like.
Of course, if you're scared, feel free to keep hiding in your shell!

column1: 经过了上次沙漠中的冒险，我们已经建立了非常坚实的信任基础。\n那位美丽的艾昆妮女士告诉我，之后如果有什么需要做的委托，都可以交给你去做，让我随便使唤你。我想了想觉得，如果让你暂时成为我的助手，应该也挺不错的。\n请来喷泉附近找我吧，我有非常紧急的事情想寻求你的帮助。
column2: After our last adventure in the desert, we've built an exceptionally solid foundation of trust.\nThe lovely Miss Aiquni told me that I could send any future requests your way and put you to work however I pleased. The more I thought about it, the more I liked the idea of making you my assistant for a while.\nCome find me near the fountain. I have an extremely urgent matter that requires your help.

column1: 你好，我马上就要修好被那群该死小贼弄坏的仪器了。但在此之前，我需要你的帮助。非常紧急，请立刻，马上，来见我！
column2: Hello. I'm almost finished repairing the equipment those blasted little thieves damaged, but first I need your help. It's extremely urgent, so come see me right now!

Its attributes are randomized upon identification. Tap the ^{1}Equipment Forging Info^{2} button to view the possible attributes for the equipment.

column1: 获得王座凭证的玩家可在新赛季的赛季商店中购买王座限定商品。
column2: Players who obtain a Throne Token can purchase throne-exclusive items from the Season Shop during the new Season.

column1: 于时装商城购买或获得外观道具后使用即可解锁对应外观，解锁后外观将收录至衣橱。
column2: Can be unlocked by using the corresponding appearance item purchased or obtained from the Costume Shop. Once unlocked, the appearance will be added to the Wardrobe.

column1: 通过衣橱点击已解锁的外观即可进行穿戴和切换。
column2: Select an unlocked appearance in the Wardrobe to equip or switch to it.

column1: 每件外观拥有独立时尚值，解锁外观后时尚值将自动累计。
column2: Each cosmetic has its own Fashion Points, which are automatically added to your total when the cosmetic is unlocked.

column1: 点击衣橱中外观名称旁的图标可对外观进行标记，方便在收藏众多时快速找到心仪外观。
column2: Click the icon next to an appearance's name in the Wardrobe to mark it, making it easy to find your favorites in a large collection.

column1: 可将当前穿搭的外观保存至搭配方案中，更加便捷的实现穿搭更换。
column2: Save your current outfit to an outfit preset so you can change looks more easily.

column1: 请确认您将要购买的商品信息和数量。
column2: Please confirm the item information and quantity before purchasing.

column1:
@{1}.只有互为好友关系的玩家才可以互相赠送商城售卖的各类外观。
@{2}.在送礼页面可切换送礼目标玩家。
@{3}.确认送礼后将以礼物形式发送到送礼目标玩家的好友聊天框，送礼目标玩家确认收取后外观将在送礼目标玩家的衣橱解锁。
@{4}.确认送礼后将扣除对应货币，如送礼目标玩家在一定时间内未进行收取，赠礼将过期，送礼时扣除的对应货币将通过邮件进行返还。
column2:
@{1}.Only players who are mutual friends can gift each other Appearance items sold in the Shop.
@{2}.You can Switch the recipient on the gifting screen.
@{3}.After you confirm the gift, it will be Sent to the recipient's Friend Chat. Once the recipient accepts it, the Appearance will be unlocked in their Wardrobe.
@{4}.The corresponding Currency will be deducted once the gift is confirmed. If the recipient does not accept it within the allotted time, the gift will expire and the deducted Currency will be Returned by mail.

column1: @{1}.每个角色拥有@{2}个加点方案，可在方案内自由切换。\n@{3}.你可选择修改方案的名称。\n@{4}.切换加点方案时，选择的推荐加点方案会保留
column2: @{1}.Each character has @{2} stat allocation presets and can freely switch between them.\n@{3}.You can rename each preset.\n@{4}.Keep your selected recommended stat allocation preset when switching presets.

column1: 重置无消耗，重置后，所有的加点全部返还
column2: Resetting is free. After a reset, all allocated points will be refunded.

column1:
公会威望获取规则:
@{1}.^{1}公会威望是公会战斗实力的体现^{2}，不会随赛季清空，每个赛季都会对大服中所有公会按照威望进行排名并永久记录。
@{2}.公会成员参与公会战场玩法：公会领土战（据点战、押镖战、州府战/王城战）时在战场内的击败人数可转化为公会威望。
@{3}.在公会战场玩法内的胜负也会影响结算奖励中的威望数量。
column2:
Guild Prestige Acquisition Rules:
@{1}.^{1}Guild Prestige represents a guild's Battle strength^{2}. It is not Cleared between Seasons. Every Season, all guilds across the server group are ranked by Prestige, and the results are Permanently Recorded.
@{2}.When Guild Members participate in guild battlefield modes—Guild Territory War (Stronghold War, Escort Battle, Regional Capital War/Royal City War)—their Defeats on the battlefield are converted into Guild Prestige.
@{3}.Victory or defeat in guild battlefield modes also affects the amount of Prestige awarded during Settlement.

column1:
公会资金获取规则:
@{1}.公会资金非常重要，将^{1}用于公会领土战玩法中公会物资等重要货币和道具的购买^{2}。
@{2}.参与公会商队玩法时，公会成员提交商队需求道具可以获得公会资金。
@{3}.完成整轮商队需求道具可获得大量公会资金。
column2:
How to Obtain Guild Funds:
@{1}.Guild Funds are extremely important and will be ^{1}used to purchase essential Currency and items, such as Guild Supplies, in Guild Territory War^{2}.
@{2}.During Guild Caravan, Guild Members can earn Guild Funds by submitting requested items.
@{3}.Completing a full round of caravan item requests grants a large amount of Guild Funds.

column1:
公会贡献获取规则:
@{1}.公会贡献可以用来^{1}提升公会建筑等级、公会建筑等级越高解锁的公会权益越多^{2}。
@{2}.公会成员完成公会任务时可以获得公会周活跃度以及公会贡献和个人贡献。
@{3}.个人贡献可以在公会商店中兑换道具，个人贡献在离开公会时不会被清空。
column2:
How to Earn Guild Contribution:
@{1}. Guild Contribution can be used to ^{1}upgrade Guild Buildings. Higher-level Guild Buildings unlock more Guild Benefits^{2}.
@{2}. Guild Members earn Weekly Guild Activity, Guild Contribution, and Personal Contribution by completing Guild Quests.
@{3}. Personal Contribution can be exchanged for items in the Guild Shop and will not be cleared when leaving the guild.

column1:
公会物资获取规则:
@{1}.完成领土战内任务可以获得公会物资。
@{2}.用公会资金和其他公会可以购买公会物资。
公会物资使用规则：
@{3}.公会物资可以用来在公会卖场中购买攻城战内器械、载具。
@{4}.公会战争科技升级、公会限时计策激活都要消耗公会物资。
@{5}.公会物资是领土战玩法内重要货币，请积极获取~
column2:
Guild Supplies Acquisition Rules:
@{1}.Complete Territory War quests to obtain Guild Supplies.
@{2}.Use Guild Funds to purchase Guild Supplies from other guilds.
Guild Supplies Usage Rules:
@{3}.Guild Supplies can be used to purchase siege weapons and vehicles from the Guild Store.
@{4}.Guild War technology Level-ups and limited-time Guild Strategy activations consume Guild Supplies.
@{5}.Guild Supplies are an important Currency in Territory War, so be sure to stock up~

column1: @{1}.有权限的公会管理可向公会全体成员发送通知邮件。\n@{2}.每日可群发邮件^{1}@{3}封^{2}，^{3}每日凌晨@{4}点重置^{4}。\n@{5}.可发送的邮件次数和公会绑定，请公会管理合理规划邮件安排哦~
column2: @{1}.Authorized Guild Management personnel can send Notification Mail to every Guild Member.\n@{2}.Group Mail can be sent ^{1}@{3} times per day^{2}. ^{3}The limit resets daily at @{4} a.m.^{4}.\n@{5}.The number of emails available is tied to the Guild, so Guild Management should plan the mailing schedule wisely~

column1: @{1}.公会战争科技^{1}应用于领土战玩法内^{2}。跟随公会研究所等级提升逐渐解锁更多效果。\n@{2}.战争科技每个赛季均会重置，进入新赛季后，需要消耗公会物资重新进行升级。\n@{3}.据点战、押镖战、攻城战中，公会内所有成员的属性都会受到战争科技的影响。
column2: @{1}.Guild War Technology^{1} applies to Territory War^{2}. More effects gradually unlock with each Guild Institute Level Increased milestone.\n@{2}.War Technology resets every Season. At the start of a new Season, Guild Supplies must be spent on Level-up again.\n@{3}.During Stronghold Battles, Convoy Escort Battles, and Siege Battles, War Technology affects the stats of every Guild Member.

column1:
@{1}.公会限时计策为领土战内更强效限时效果。
@{2}.公会内有权限的管理成员可以消耗公会物资进行计策的激活与刷新。
@{3}.每日凌晨五点会自动刷新一次限时计策，每日可抽取的计策次数也会在凌晨五点重置。
@{4}.限时计策库跟随赛季时间解锁，赛季后期将会解锁品质更高效果更强的计策。
@{5}.当前公会可以激活的计策受点数限制，如果当前已达点数上限，需要卸下计策才可激活其他计策。
@{6}.卸下计策时不会返还激活消耗的公会物资。
@{7}.限时计策从激活就会开始计时，可使用时间变为@{8}时，计策就会从当前效果中清除。
column2:
@{1}.Guild Limited-Time Tactics provide powerful temporary effects in Territory War.
@{2}.Authorized Guild management Members can spend Guild Supplies to activate and refresh Tactics.
@{3}.Limited-Time Tactics automatically refresh once daily at five o'clock in the morning. The number of Tactics that can be drawn each day also resets at that time.
@{4}.The Limited-Time Tactics pool unlocks over the course of the Season. Higher-quality, more powerful Tactics become available later in the Season.
@{5}.The Tactics your Guild can activate are limited by available points. If you have reached the point limit, you must unequip a Tactic before you can activate another.
@{6}.Unequipping a Tactic does not refund the Guild Supplies spent to activate it.
@{7}.A Limited-Time Tactic's duration begins counting down as soon as it is activated. When its remaining duration reaches @{8}, it will be removed from Current Effect.

column1:
@{1}.公会限时计策为^{1}领土战内更强效限时效果^{2}。
@{2}.公会内有权限的管理成员可以消耗公会物资进行计策的激活与刷新。
@{3}.每日凌晨五点会自动刷新一次限时计策，每日可抽取的计策次数也会在凌晨五点重置。
@{4}.^{3}限时计策库跟随赛季时间解锁^{4}，赛季后期将会解锁品质更高效果更强的计策。
@{5}.当前公会可以激活的计策受点数限制，如果当前已达点数上限，需要卸下计策才可激活其他计策。
@{6}.卸下计策时不会返还激活消耗的公会物资。
@{7}.^{5}限时计策从激活就会开始计时^{6}，可使用时间变为@{8}时，计策就会从当前效果中清除。
column2:
@{1}.Guild Limited-Time Tactics provide ^{1}more powerful temporary effects in Territory War^{2}.
@{2}.Authorized management Members can spend Guild Supplies to activate and refresh Tactics.
@{3}.Limited-Time Tactics automatically refresh once each day at 5:00 a.m. The number of Tactics that can be drawn each day also resets at 5:00 a.m.
@{4}.^{3}The Limited-Time Tactics pool unlocks as the Season progresses^{4}. Higher-quality, more powerful Tactics will become available later in the Season.
@{5}.The Tactics your Guild can have active are limited by points. If you have reached the point limit, you must unequip a Tactic before activating another one.
@{6}.Unequipping a Tactic will not refund the Guild Supplies spent to activate it.
@{7}.^{5}A Limited-Time Tactic's timer starts as soon as it is activated^{6}. When its remaining duration reaches @{8}, it will be removed from Current Effect.

column1:
@{1}.没有公会的冒险家可以自己创建公会或者响应、加入任意公会。
@{2}.创建公会后，需要另外两名玩家发起响应后才可创建成功。如果^{1}@{3}小时内^{2}没有足够的玩家发起响应，则公会创建失败。
@{4}.当公会响应人数符合条件，公会立刻创建成功。公会创建成功后，^{3}创建者自动成为公会会长。^{4}
@{5}.如果公会创建失败，创建公会所消耗道具会通过邮件进行返还。
@{6}.加入公会后才可参与公会活动并获得丰富的奖励以及活动拍卖分红。
@{7}.每个冒险家最多可同时向^{5}@{8}个公会发起入会申请^{6}，发出申请后也可以主动撤回。
column2:
@{1}.Adventurers without a guild can Create Guilds or respond to and Join any guild.
@{2}.After initiating guild creation, 2 other players must respond before the guild can be created. If there are not enough Responses within ^{1}@{3} hours^{2}, guild creation will fail.
@{4}.Once the required number of Responses is reached, Guild Creation Successful. After the guild is created, ^{3}the creator automatically becomes the Guild Master.^{4}
@{5}.If guild creation fails, the items consumed to Create Guild will be Returned by mail.
@{6}.You must Join a guild to participate in Guild Activities and earn generous rewards and Event Auction Dividends.
@{7}.Each Adventurer may have membership Requests pending with up to ^{5}@{8} guilds at once^{6} and may withdraw them at any time.

column1:
@{1}.所有冒险家首次退出公会均无惩罚时间，首次退出后可立即加入其他公会。
@{2}.当冒险家的等级小于@{3}级时，后续退出公会惩罚时间为@{4}分钟；当冒险家等级大于@{5}级时，后续退出公会惩罚时间为@{6}小时。
@{7}.如果是被请离公会，则不会有加入公会的惩罚时间，可立即加入其他公会。
@{8}.离开公会后，@{9}周内再回到原公会，公会资金捐献金额以及总贡献仍为您保留。
column2:
@{1}.The first time any Adventurer Leaves Guild, there is no penalty period, and they may Join another guild immediately.
@{2}.If an Adventurer is below Lv. @{3}, the penalty period for subsequently Leaving Guild is @{4} minutes. If an Adventurer is above Lv. @{5}, the penalty period is @{6} hours.
@{7}.Adventurers who are Banished from Guild have no penalty period and may Join another guild immediately.
@{8}.If you Return to your former guild within @{9} weeks of leaving, your Guild Funds Donation amount and Total Contribution will be Kept.

column1:
@{1}.所有冒险家加入公会均为临时成员身份，^{1}@{2}小时后^{2}才会由临时成员自动变更为成员，无法手动操作变更。
@{3}.临时成员无法被任命职位，并且无法参与公会联赛活动。
@{4}.公会内有任命权限的管理成员可以任命或者取消任命比自己职位低的成员。
@{5}.无法直接请离有管理职位的成员，需要将其卸任后才可请离公会。
@{6}.有精英设置权限的成员可以调整公会联赛精英成员任命；有器械管理权限的成员可以调整领土战内器械以及载具的成员任命。
column2:
@{1}.All adventurers who Join a guild are initially Temporary Members and will automatically become Members ^{1}after @{2} hours^{2}. This change cannot be made manually.
@{3}.Temporary Members cannot be assigned positions or participate in the Guild League.
@{4}.A management Member with appointment permission can appoint or dismiss any Member in a lower position.
@{5}.A Member with a management position cannot be directly Banished from Guild. The Member must first be removed from the position.
@{6}.A Member with elite management permission can adjust elite Member assignments for the Guild League. A Member with equipment management permission can adjust Member assignments for equipment and vehicles in Territory War.

column1: @{1}.公会内有召集权限的成员可以对所有公会成员发起公会召集弹窗。\n@{2}.公会成员接受召集后，可立即出现在发起召集成员所在位置。\n@{3}.^{1}公会召集冷却时间为@{4}分钟^{2}，全公会共享公会召集冷却时间。
column2: @{1}.A Member with rally permissions can send a Guild Rally pop-up to every Guild Member.\n@{2}.After accepting the rally, Guild Members will immediately be teleported to the initiating Member's location.\n@{3}.The ^{1}Guild Rally Cooldown is @{4} minutes^{2} and is shared by the entire guild.

column1:
@{1}.公会拍卖开启后，所有公会成员均有参与拍卖的资格。
@{2}.拍卖结束后，符合该活动分红的成员可以获得拍卖分红。
@{3}.每场拍卖的分红将会发送至邮件，请注意查收。
@{4}.如果在公会拍卖未结束时离开公会，则不会获得本场拍卖分红。
column2:
@{1}.Once the Guild Auction begins, all Guild Members are eligible to participate.
@{2}.After the auction ends, Members eligible for a dividend from the event will receive an Auction Dividend.
@{3}.The Auction Dividend from each auction will be sent by mail, so be sure to check your inbox.
@{4}.If you leave the guild before the Guild Auction ends, you will not receive an Auction Dividend from that auction.

column1:
活跃分红：
@{1}.^{1}每周一凌晨五点进行公会活跃分红结算^{2}，结算后可在界面中手动领取分红。
@{2}.如果未领取上周分红直接退出公会，分红将会发送至您的邮件，请注意查收。

拍卖分红：
@{3}.每周一凌晨五点将会对上周已获取的拍卖分红进行结算展示。
column2:
Activity Dividend:
@{1}.^{1}The weekly Guild Activity Dividend Settlement takes place every Monday at 5 AM^{2}. After Settlement, you can manually claim your dividend from the interface.
@{2}.If you select Leave Guild without claiming last week's dividend, it will be sent to you by mail. Please check your inbox.

Auction Dividend:
@{3}.Every Monday at 5 AM, the Auction Dividend Settlement for the previous week will be displayed.

column1:
收到邀请规则：
@{1}.收到合并邀请，表示^{1}对方公会邀请您方公会合并到对方公会中^{2}。
@{2}.同意合并邀请后，需要您调整可以合入的公会人数，保证合入人数小于等于对方可接纳人数。
@{3}.同意合并邀请且调整完可合并人数后，^{3}公会将于第二日凌晨五点正式合并成功^{4}。
@{4}.未进行合并时，您也可在界面中操作[取消合并]，取消合并后公会合并流程立刻终止。
@{5}.如果在合并时，您方公会人数不满足对方可接纳人数，公会合并流程会直接终止，合并失败。
@{6}.合并失败后，双方公会不会有变动也不会受到任何影响。
column2:
Receive an invite Rules:
@{1}.Receiving a merge invite means ^{1}the other guild is inviting your guild to Merge into theirs^{2}.
@{2}.After accepting the merge invite, you must adjust the number of guild members who can Merge into the other guild so that it does not exceed the number of members they can accept.
@{3}.Once you have accepted the merge invite and adjusted the number of members who can merge, ^{3}the Merge Guild process will be completed at 5:00 a.m. the next day^{4}.
@{4}.Before the merge takes place, you can select [Cancel Merge] on the screen. The Merge Guild process will end immediately after it is canceled.
@{5}.If your guild's member count exceeds the number of members the other guild can accept when the merge takes place, the Merge Guild process will end immediately and the merge will fail.
@{6}.If the merge fails, neither guild will be changed or otherwise affected.

column1:
发出邀请规则：
@{1}.发出合并邀请，表示^{1}您方公会邀请对方公会进行合入^{2}。
@{2}.发出合并邀请后，等对方同意并调整合入人数小于等于您方公会可接纳人数后，合并流程开始。
@{3}.并于^{3}第二日凌晨五点正式合并成功^{4}，如果在合并时对方公会的合并人数大于您方公会可接纳人数，合并失败。
@{4}.合并失败后，双方公会不会有变动也不会受到任何影响。
column2:
Send an Invite: Rules
@{1}.Sending a merge invite means ^{1}your guild is inviting the other guild to Merge into your guild^{2}.
@{2}.After you send a merge invite, the merge process will begin once the other guild agrees and adjusts the number of members who will Merge into your guild so that it does not exceed your guild's available capacity.
@{3}.The merge will be officially completed ^{3}at 5:00 AM the following day^{4}. If the other guild has more members to merge than your guild can accept when the merge occurs, the merge will fail.
@{4}.If the merge fails, neither guild will undergo any changes or be affected in any way.

column1:
公会活跃规则：
@{1}.公会内任意成员参与公会活动任务均^{1}可获得公会活跃以及公会贡献和个人贡献奖励^{2}。
@{2}.公会活跃为^{3}全公会成员共享进度，每周一凌晨五点重置^{4}。未领取的活跃宝箱将会直接失效。
@{3}.获取的公会贡献为公会货币，公会贡献可以用来升级建筑；个人贡献为个人货币，可以在公会商店中兑换道具。
column2:
Guild Activity Rules:
@{1}.Any Guild Member who participates in a Guild Event Quest can earn^{1} Guild Activity, Guild Contribution, and Personal Contribution rewards^{2}.
@{2}.Guild Activity progress is shared by^{3} all Guild Members and resets every Monday at 5:00 AM^{4}. Any unclaimed Activity Chests will expire.
@{3}.Guild Contribution is the Guild's Currency and can be used for building Level-ups. Personal Contribution is personal Currency that can be exchanged for items in the Guild Shop.

column1: 公会联赛精英规则：\n@{1}.在该界面可设置公会联赛内场玩法可参与的精英玩家。\n@{2}.一键成团时会向团内所有成员发起组团邀请，创建团队时不会按照精英设置界面的顺序成团，需要团长自行调整。
column2: Guild League Elite Rules:\n@{1}.On this screen, you can designate elite players who may participate in Guild League arena modes.\n@{2}.Quick Team Formation sends a team invitation to each Member. Members will not be added to the team in the order shown on the elite settings screen, so the team leader must adjust the lineup manually.

column1: 攻城战火炮权限规则：\n@{1}.在该界面可以设置攻城战内火炮权限。\n@{2}.设置结果会同步影响攻城战局内玩家权限。
column2: Siege War Cannon Permission Rules:\n@{1}. This screen allows you to configure cannon permissions for Siege War.\n@{2}. These settings also affect player permissions during Siege War.

column1: 攻城战载具权限规则：\n@{1}.在该界面可以设置攻城战内载具权限。\n@{2}.设置结果会同步影响攻城战局内玩家权限。
column2: Siege War Vehicle Permission Rules:\n@{1}.You can set vehicle permissions for Siege War on this screen.\n@{2}.These settings also apply to player permissions during Siege War.

column1:
竞拍资金规则:
@{1}.通过押镖可以将公会物资转化成竞拍资金。
@{2}.据点战、攻城战的资格仅可用竞拍资金通过竞拍获得。
@{3}.竞拍资金在赛季内可无限累计。
@{4}.赛季结束，竞拍资金会被清零，请注意使用时机。
column2:
Bidding Fund Rules:
@{1}.Escort missions convert Guild Supplies into Bidding Funds.
@{2}.Eligibility for Stronghold War and Siege War can only be obtained by bidding with Bidding Funds.
@{3}.Bidding Funds can be accumulated without limit during the Season.
@{4}.Bidding Funds will be reset when the Season ends, so be sure to use them in time.

column1: @{1}.精炼仅针对部位进行，更换装备不影响精炼效果。\n@{2}.不穿戴装备时，仍可对部位进行精炼，但精炼效果只在穿戴装备后生效。\n@{3}.全身部位精炼到指定等级时将激活共鸣属性，同样需要穿戴装备后才可获得对应的效果加成。
column2: @{1}.Refining applies to equipment slots only. Changing Equipment does not affect Refine bonuses.\n@{2}.Slots can still be Refined without Equipment equipped, but Refine bonuses are only Active while Equipment is equipped.\n@{3}.Refining every equipment slot to the specified Refine Level will Activate Resonance stats. Equipment must still be equipped to receive the corresponding bonuses.

column1:
@{1}.装备精炼的每个精炼等级均有固定的成功率。
@{2}.精炼有失败的几率，精炼失败有可能会导致精炼等级回退@{3}级。
@{4}.精炼失败或掉级后会获得一定的幸运值，连续掉级越多，附加的幸运值越多。
@{5}.处于安全精炼等级时，精炼失败不会降低精炼等级，安全精炼等级：@{6}/@{7}/@{8}/@{9}/@{10}，精炼一共@{11}级。
@{12}.使用受祝福的矿石，精炼失败不会掉级；使用传说矿石，可提升精炼成功率，并且精炼失败不会掉级。
column2:
@{1}.Each Equipment Refine Level has a fixed Success Rate.
@{2}.Refining has a Chance to fail, and Refinement Failed may reduce the Refine Level by @{3}.
@{4}.Refinement Failed or a Refine Level reduction grants a certain amount of LUK. The more consecutive level reductions, the more Extra LUK is granted.
@{5}.At safe Refine Levels, Refinement Failed will not reduce the Refine Level. Safe Refine Levels: @{6}/@{7}/@{8}/@{9}/@{10}. There are @{11} Refine Levels in total.
@{12}.When using Blessed Ore, Refinement Failed will not reduce the Refine Level. Legend Ore increases the Refinement Success Rate and also prevents Refine Level reduction upon failure.

column1:
@{1}.强化仅针对部位进行，更换装备不影响强化效果。
@{2}.不穿戴装备时，仍可对部位进行强化，但强化效果只在穿戴装备后生效。
@{3}.强化等级上限为角色当前等级。
@{4}.全身部位强化到指定等级时将激活共鸣属性，同样需要穿戴装备后才可获得对应的效果加成。
column2:
@{1}.Enhance applies only to equipment slots. Changing equipment does not affect Enhance bonuses.
@{2}.You can Enhance an equipment slot even when no equipment is equipped, but the bonuses only take effect once equipment is equipped.
@{3}.The maximum Reinforcement level is equal to the character's Current Level.
@{4}.Enhancing all equipment slots to the specified level activates Resonance attributes. Equipment must be equipped to receive the corresponding bonuses.

column1:
@{1}.邮件分为系统邮件和公会邮件，开启等级不同。
@{2}.系统邮件与公会邮件分别有存储上限，超出上限后的邮件将无法获取，请冒险者及时清理邮件。
@{3}.包含附件的邮件需领取后才可进行删除操作。
@{4}.每封邮件都有有效期，超过有效期的邮件将会自动被删除，请及时阅读和领取。
column2:
@{1}.Mail is divided into System Mail and Guild Mail, which unlock at different levels.
@{2}.System Mail and Guild Mail each have a storage limit. New mail cannot be received once the limit is reached, so please clear out your mail regularly, Adventurer.
@{3}.Mail with attachments cannot be deleted until the attachments have been claimed.
@{4}.Each mail has an expiration date. Expired mail will be deleted automatically, so be sure to read it and claim any attachments in time.

column1:
@{1}.交易行为官方统一的商品购买、出售平台。
@{2}.部分珍贵商品可自由定价，没有定价限制。
@{3}.珍贵商品上架后有一定的公示时间，公示时间结束后才可进行正常交易。
@{4}.商品购买成功和出售成功后，对应获得的商品和收益金额将通过邮件发放，请注意及时查收。
@{5}.商品可进行关注操作，便于实时查看其在售状态。
@{6}.商品上架后有上架持续时间，超过上架持续时间仍未卖出的商品，将自动通过邮件返还给玩家。
@{7}.商品出售成功后，卖家最终获得的货币需要扣除交易税，交易税根据玩家本周的交易金额在不同区间时，适用不同的税率。
column2:
@{1}.Trade is the official marketplace for buying and selling items.
@{2}.Some rare items can be priced freely, with no price restrictions.
@{3}.Rare items have a display period after being listed and cannot be traded normally until that period ends.
@{4}.When an item's status changes to Purchase Successful or Sale Successful, the purchased item or sale proceeds will be sent by mail. Please claim them promptly.
@{5}.You can follow items to easily check their availability in real time.
@{6}.Listed items remain available for a limited time. Any item that does not sell before its listing expires will automatically be returned to the player by mail.
@{7}.After an item is sold, a transaction tax is deducted from the Currency the seller receives. Different tax rates apply based on the player's Trade volume for This Week.

column1: @{1}.每日@{2}:@{3}更新本日税率，更新后当日税率不再发生变化。\n@{4}.交易税的扣除时间以交易发生（成交）时所处的税率作为扣除依据。\n@{5}.税率将按照交易额梯度上涨，每周一重置税率梯度。
column2: @{1}.Today's tax rate is updated daily at @{2}:@{3} and will remain unchanged for the rest of the day.\n@{4}.Trade tax is deducted at the rate in effect when the Trade is completed.\n@{5}.The tax rate increases in tiers based on Trade volume. Tax rate tiers reset every Monday.

column1: @{1}.搜索功能分为模糊搜索和精确搜索两个类型。\n@{2}.处于上架中的商品和处于公示期中的商品不会在同一个搜索池中。\n@{3}.搜索记录按搜索类型，每种最多可保留@{4}条。
column2: @{1}.The search Function supports both fuzzy and exact searches.\n@{2}.Items listed for sale and items in the publication period are kept in separate search pools.\n@{3}.For each search type, Keep up to @{4} search records.

column1: 由于您多次违规，冻结时间已合并到最后一次违规的时间，请以最新时间为准。
column2: Due to multiple violations, your suspension periods have been combined. Please refer to the latest end time.

column1: @{1}.交易记录最多只存储@{2}天或@{3}条；\n@{4}.交易记录在进入新赛季时会被清空
column2: @{1}.Trade records are stored for up to @{2} days or @{3} entries;\n@{4}.Trade records are cleared when a new Season begins

column1:
@{1}.拍卖行中可以在公示期、拍卖期对拍品进行批量预购或竞拍；
@{2}.预购的道具在拍卖正式开启时，会在所有列表中查找当前最低的一批道具发起批量自动竞价；
@{3}.预购物品需要一次性扣除预购价的货币，若中途取消或被顶价，会通过邮件返还；
@{4}.由于预购拍品会在当前寻找价格最低的商品，可能会导致与他人对同一个道具发起自动竞价，敬请注意。
@{1}.针对部分职业，将有不同的职业道具。\n@{2}.符合指定要求后，商人系职业将可使用手推车，骑士系职业将可骑乘大嘴鸟，弓箭手系职业将可携带猎鹰。\n@{3}.不同职业道具将会发挥不同的作用，等待冒险者们去探索和发现哦。
column2: @{1}.Certain classes have unique class items.\n@{2}.After meeting the specified requirements, Merchants can use carts, Knight classes can ride Peco Pecos, and Archer classes can bring Falcons.\n@{3}.Each class item serves a different purpose. Adventurers, go explore and Discover them all!

column1: @{1}.冒险者们可在此购买所需物品。\n@{2}.部分商品可能存在限购数量或次数，请注意刷新时间，及时购买。
column2: @{1}.Adventurers can purchase the items they need here.\n@{2}.Some items may have purchase quantity or frequency limits. Check the Refresh Time and purchase them before they refresh.

column1: @{1}.冒险者们可再次购买所需物品。\n@{2}.部分商品可能存在限购数量或次数，请注意刷新时间，及时购买。
column2: @{1}.Adventurers can repurchase the items they need.\n@{2}.Some items may have purchase quantity or frequency limits. Check the Refresh Time and purchase them before they refresh.

column1:
@{1}.普隆德拉大陆从不缺少冒险者，互相帮助是这片大陆上的最高尚的美德。
@{2}.可通过场景中、聊天频道、排行榜等途径添加其他冒险者为好友。
@{3}.发送好友申请后，需对方同意才可互为好友关系。
@{4}.好友之间组队参与玩法、完成任务等可增加亲密值，从而提升亲密度等级。
@{5}.达到指定亲密度等级后，双方组队将享受效果加成。
@{6}.好友间还可互相赠送礼物，增加互相的亲密值哦。
column2:
@{1}.The continent of Prontera is never short on Adventurers, and helping one another is its noblest virtue.
@{2}.You can add other Adventurers as friends through the game world, chat channels, rankings, and more.
@{3}.After sending a friend request, you must wait for the other player to accept before you become friends.
@{4}.Team up with friends to participate in activities, complete quests, and more to earn Intimacy Points and raise your Intimacy Level.
@{5}.Once you reach the required Intimacy Level, you will receive bonus effects when teaming up together.
@{6}.Friends can also exchange gifts to increase their Intimacy Points.

column1:
@{1}.礼物赠送后，好有双方将增加对应的效果值。
@{2}.人气值：赠送礼物后，被赠礼玩家增加的效果值。
@{3}.爱心值：赠送礼物后，送礼者增加的效果值。
@{4}.亲密度：赠送礼物后，送礼者与收礼者双方增加的效果值。
column2:
@{1}.After a gift is sent, both friends receive the corresponding stat increases.
@{2}.Popularity: The stat gained by the recipient after receiving a gift.
@{3}.Heart Points: The stat gained by the sender after sending a gift.
@{4}.Intimacy: The stat gained by both the sender and recipient after a gift is sent.

column1:
@{1}.只有互为好友关系的玩家才可以赠送礼物。
@{2}.送礼目标玩家需要为在线状态才可以进行送礼操作。
@{3}.在送礼页面可切换送礼目标玩家。
@{4}.不同礼物对应不同的亲密值、爱心值，赠与成功后好有双方将获得对应的加成。
@{5}.只有高级送礼道具才可自定义赠言，同时享受全服炫耀性通知效果哦。
column2:
@{1}.Only players who are mutual friends can send each other gifts.
@{2}.The recipient must be Online to receive a gift.
@{3}.You can switch recipients on the Gift page.
@{4}.Different gifts grant different amounts of Intimacy and Love. Once a gift is successfully sent, both friends will receive the corresponding bonuses.
@{5}.Only premium gift items allow you to add a custom message and trigger a flashy Entire Server Notification.

column1: @{1}.每个玩家拥有跨服好友人数上限为@{2}人。\n@{3}.跨服好友在合服后会自动并入我的好友列表内。\n@{4}.跨服好友可以组队参与部分玩法，但不可执行送礼操作。
column2: @{1}.Each player can have up to @{2} Cross-server Friends.\n@{3}.After a server merge, Cross-server Friends will automatically be added to the My Friends list.\n@{4}.Cross-server Friends can form parties for some content, but cannot send gifts.

column1: @{1}.排行榜信息实时更新。\n@{2}.每个榜单根据各玩法不同标准来排序，部分榜单可点击表头进行自定义升序或降序。\n@{3}.可点击榜单上角色查看其个人主页。
column2: @{1}.Rankings are updated in real time.\n@{2}.Each leaderboard is ranked according to criteria specific to that game mode. Some leaderboards allow you to click a column header to sort in ascending or descending order.\n@{3}.Click a character on the leaderboard to view their profile.

column1: 每周一早@{1}:@{2}截榜，同时根据各位冒险者所处的勇者段位发放名录奖励
column2: Rankings close every Monday at @{1}:@{2} AM, and leaderboard rewards are distributed based on each Adventurer's Hero tier.

column1: 赛季结束时截榜，同时根据各位冒险者所处的勇者段位发放名录奖励
column2: Rankings are finalized at the end of the Season, and Leaderboard Rewards are issued based on each Adventurer's Valor Tier.

column1: @{1}.巅峰十杰信息实时更新，展示当前服务器整体实力最强的十人。\n@{2}.每周一@{3}:@{4}结算并发放十杰奖励。
column2: @{1}.The Pinnacle Top Ten rankings update in real time, displaying the ten strongest adventurers on the current server.\n@{2}.Settlement takes place every Monday at @{3}:@{4}, and Pinnacle Top Ten rewards are distributed.

column1: @{1}.势均力敌信息实时更新，展示当前服务器与我整体实力最接近的十人。\n@{2}.提升整体实力会提升头衔。
column2: @{1}. Evenly Matched rankings are updated in real time and show the ten players on the current server whose overall power is closest to mine.\n@{2}. Increasing overall power will improve your title.

column1:
@{1}. 酒馆房间内畅所欲言的时候，也请记得^{1}遵守《合规提示》^{2}。
@{2}. 酒馆聊天依旧保留较为严格的审查机制和举报机制，请冒险者不要发布任何违规言论。 
@{3}. 在房间内给其他冒险者^{3}赠送酒馆礼物^{4}时，可以^{5}增加房间的热度^{6}，收到礼物的冒险者可以^{7}增加明星值^{8}。
@{4}. 明星值有每周排行榜，每周排行榜前十名的玩家可获得限时称号奖励。
@{5}. 不要吝啬酒馆礼物的赠送，完成每日任务可获得免费的赠礼道具，勇敢的向其他人表示赞美吧！
@{6}. ^{9}热度和房间人数^{10}都会影响房间在酒馆列表的排序。
column2:
@{1}. When speaking freely in a Tavern room, please remember to ^{1}follow the Compliance Guidelines^{2}.
@{2}. Tavern chat will Keep its relatively strict moderation and reporting systems. Adventurers, please do not post any content that violates the rules. 
@{3}. When you ^{3}send Tavern Gifts^{4} to other Adventurers in the room, you can ^{5}increase the room's popularity^{6}, while the Adventurers who receive them can ^{7}gain Star Points^{8}.
@{4}. Star Points have a weekly ranking, and the top ten players each week can earn a limited-time title.
@{5}. Don't hold back on sending Tavern Gifts! Complete daily quests to receive free gift items, and boldly show others your appreciation!
@{6}. Both ^{9}popularity and the number of players in the room^{10} affect the room's position in the Tavern list.

column1: @{1}.房主可以设置房间内成员开麦方式、开麦权限等。并且可以禁言成员或者将成员加入房间黑名单。\n@{2}.请^{1}合理使用权限设置^{2}，创造一个大家分享快乐的酒馆小房间吧！
column2: @{1}. The host can set how Members turn on their mics and who has permission to speak. The host can also mute a Member or add them to the room's Blocks.\n@{2}. Please ^{1}use these permissions responsibly^{2} and make your Tavern room a fun place for everyone!

column1:
@{1}.和其他冒险家成为好友后，可解锁好友之间的亲密度加成。
@{2}.^{1}删除好友、将好友加入黑名单^{2}等操作都会直接^{3}清空亲密度^{4}，请谨慎操作。
@{3}.好友之间的亲密度等级上限为^{5}@{4}级^{6}。
@{5}.解锁其他社交关系后，可解锁更高的亲密度等级。
column2:
@{1}.After befriending other adventurers, Intimacy bonuses between friends can be unlocked.
@{2}.Actions such as ^{1}Unfriend or adding a friend to Blocks^{2} will immediately ^{3}reset Intimacy^{4}. Proceed with caution.
@{3}.The maximum Intimacy level between friends is ^{5}Lv. @{4}^{6}.
@{5}.After unlocking other Connect relationships, higher Intimacy levels can be unlocked.

column1: @{1}.好友赠礼：不同的礼物增加的亲密度均不相同。\n@{2}.和好友一起参与活动玩法可获取亲密度，活动玩法每日获取的亲密度有上限。
column2: @{1}.Gifts to Friends: Different gifts grant different amounts of Affinity.\n@{2}.Participate in activities with friends to gain Affinity. The amount of Affinity you can gain from activities each day is limited.

column1: \r\n@{1}.MVP怪物多条分线公用血量，MVP出现时，所有线路都可以找到MVP进行战斗，所有的战斗贡献都会被计入排名。
column2: \r\n@{1}.MVP monsters share HP across all channels. When an MVP appears, it can be found and fought on any channel, and all battle contributions count toward the rankings.

column1:
@{1}.MVP奖励分为四种：排名奖、参与奖、首刀奖励、尾刀奖励，四种奖励次数彼此独立，不会互相影响，具体内容可点击奖励次数查看。
@{2}.参与奖与排名奖中有概率产生卡片等稀有奖励，团队排名越高获奖概率越高。
@{3}.排名奖以小队的形式发放，排名前@{4}的小队拥有获取奖励次数的成员击杀MVP后可获取排名奖励。
@{5}.率先攻击MVP的角色会获得首刀标记，离线、切图（切分线除外）会清除首刀标记，并在清除后率先攻击MVP的角色标记首刀角色。
column2:
@{1}.There are 4 types of MVP rewards: Ranking Rewards, Participation Rewards, First Strike Rewards, and Final Blow Rewards. Each has an independent Reward Count and does not affect the others. Tap Reward Count for details.
@{2}.Participation Rewards and Ranking Rewards have a Chance to include Rare rewards such as Cards. The higher the team's rank, the greater the Chance.
@{3}.Ranking Rewards are distributed by party. After Killing the MVP, members of the top @{4} parties with Remaining Reward Counts can obtain Ranking Rewards.
@{5}.The first Character to attack the MVP receives the First Strike mark. Going Offline or changing maps, except when switching channels, Clears the First Strike mark. The first Character to attack the MVP afterward receives the First Strike mark.

column1: \r\n@{1}.击败MVP后，会根据全部参与队伍的伤害量、承伤量、治疗量、死亡次数数据进行积分计算，其中死亡次数会少量扣分，根据积分对所有参与队伍进行排名。\r\n@{2}.当队伍中存在没有排名奖励和参与奖励剩余次数的成员时，会对总分进行一定比例的衰减，该类成员越多，衰减比例越高。
column2: \r\n@{1}.After the MVP is Defeated, Points are calculated for all participating parties based on Damage dealt, Damage taken, Healing Volume, and death count Data. Deaths deduct a small number of Points. All participating parties are then ranked by Points.\r\n@{2}.If a party includes Members with no Remaining Ranking Reward or Participation Reward Counts, the total score is Decayed by a certain percentage. The more such Members there are, the greater the Decay.

column1:
@{1}.每日提供@{2}点高倍点数，开启高倍点数时，击杀野外魔物可以掉落大量经验、装备、卡片资源
@{3}每击杀一只野外魔物，消耗@{4}点高倍点数，消耗完后击杀野外魔物掉率降低，只能获得头饰材料等基础掉落
@{5}.玩家可以手动暂停高倍点数，暂停后击杀野怪也不会消耗高倍点数，但是只能获得头饰材料等基础掉落
@{6}.开启高倍点数时，击杀野外魔物掉落的经验、装备奖励掉落仅受世界等级影响，卡片资源会跟随魔物掉落变化，请冒险者合理规划，获取自己心仪的卡片！
column2:
@{1}.You receive @{2} Bonus Points each day. While Bonus Points are active, Kill field monsters to obtain large amounts of EXP, equipment, and cards
@{3}Each field monster you Kill consumes @{4} Bonus Points. Once all Bonus Points are used, the drop rate from field monsters decreases, and only basic drops such as headgear materials can be obtained
@{5}.Players can manually Pause Bonus Points. While paused, Killing field monsters does not consume Bonus Points, but only basic drops such as headgear materials can be obtained
@{6}.While Bonus Points are active, EXP and equipment rewards from Killing field monsters are affected only by World Level, while card drops vary by monster. Adventurer, plan carefully to obtain the cards you want!

column1: @{1}.进入推荐魔物界面，点击魔物信息左上方的收藏按钮，可以添加魔物收藏，最高可收藏@{2}只魔物\n@{3}.通过魔物收藏点击魔物头像，可以打开推荐魔物界面，并快速定位到对应魔物信息
column2: @{1}.On the Recommended Monster screen, click the favorite button in the upper-left corner of a monster's info to add it to your favorites. You can favorite up to @{2} monsters\n@{3}.In your monster favorites, click a monster's Portrait to open the Recommended Monster screen and quickly Locate its info

column1:
@{1}.开启高倍时间后，在野外击杀魔物可以掉落大量经验、装备、卡片资源
@{2}.非高倍时间分为低倍掉落和疲劳掉落
@{3}.低倍掉落状态在野外击杀魔物只能获得少量经验、材料等基础掉落
@{4}.疲劳掉落状态下在野外击杀魔物只能获得少量的铸币和材料
@{5}.击杀野外魔物掉落的经验、装备奖励掉落仅受世界等级影响，卡片资源会跟随魔物掉落变化，请冒险者合理规划，获取自己心仪的卡片！
@{6}.开启高倍挂机后，若十秒内没有进行魔物击杀并获取掉落则自动进入挂起状态，挂起状态下不再扣除高倍时间，直到再次击杀魔物并获取掉落则自动恢复高倍挂机。
@{7}.副本等场景自动关闭高倍挂机并不可开启。
@{8}.当处于挑战野外MVP状态中时，开启高倍挂机后也将进入挂起状态，直至脱离MVP仇恨并击杀魔物获取掉落后恢复高倍挂机状态。
column2:
@{1}.After Enable Bonus Time, Killing Monsters in the Field grants large amounts of EXP, Equipment, Cards, and other Drops.
@{2}.Outside Bonus Time, Drops are divided into reduced Drops and Fatigue Drops.
@{3}.With reduced Drops Active, Killing Monsters in the Field grants only small amounts of EXP, Materials, and other Basic Drops.
@{4}.With Fatigue Drops Active, Killing Monsters in the Field grants only small amounts of Minted Coins and Materials.

@{8}.If you are challenging a Field MVP, enabling Bonus Auto Mode will also suspend it. It will resume after you escape the MVP's aggro, Kill a Monster, and obtain Drops.

column1: @{1}.冒险者可以利用女神赐予的神秘力量进行修炼，无需冒险者真实参与战斗，就可以产生卡片、装备等稀有战斗收益\n@{2}.参与探险远征后会持续累计探险时长，即使冒险者离线，也会计算时长。\n@{3}.探险远征奖励需要冒险者手动领取，领取奖励时，会根据累计探险时长进行奖励发放，累计时长有上限，冒险者要记得及时领取哦~
column2: @{1}.Adventurers can use the mysterious power bestowed by the Goddess to train without actively participating in combat, earning Rare battle rewards such as cards and equipment\n@{2}.After beginning an expedition, exploration time will continue to accumulate even while Adventurers are offline.\n@{3}.Expedition rewards must be claimed manually. column1:
@{1}.获得神术图腾时，会随机属性和神术图腾技能

column2:

column1:

column2:
@{1}.Participating in Survivor Battle grants Rank Points. Your rank automatically receives a Level-up when your points reach the limit.
@{2}.There are @{3} ranks in total: Trainee, Rookie, Warrior, Elite, Moonlit Challenger, Dominator, and Legendary Survivor. To become a Legendary Survivor, you must rank among the top @{4} players on the Entire Server and have at least @{5} points in Dominator.
@{6}.Trainees cannot be demoted. Rookies and above can lose minor ranks, while Dominators and above can lose major ranks.
@{7}.Idling and similar behavior during a match will be penalized. Penalties are applied directly to your Rank Points, so please participate actively.

column1:
@{1}.玩法需要公会成员一同击败BOSS，共分为简单、困难、噩梦@{2}个难度，简单难度仅包含咏律神殿关卡，困难难度包含咏律神殿、云海之上关卡，噩梦难度包含咏律神殿、云海之上、混沌墟庭关卡。
@{3}.每周由会长选择难度并开启挑战。活动期间均可跟随公会当前进度进入副本进行挑战。
@{4}.不同难度下的相同关卡奖励次数共享，领取关卡奖励后当周不再能够领取相同名字关卡奖励，无奖励次数的关卡支持跳过。
@{5}.通关奖励将在每个关卡结算后立即发放，拍卖奖励将不断累计并在活动结束后开启拍卖。
@{6}.活动开启期间，会长可随时调整挑战的难度。
column2:
@{1}.In this mode, Guild Members must work together to Defeat Bosses. It has @{2} Difficulty levels: Easy, Hard, and Nightmare. Easy includes only Temple of Cadence; Hard includes Temple of Cadence and Above the Sea of Clouds; Nightmare includes Temple of Cadence, Above the Sea of Clouds, and Chaos Court.
@{3}.Each week, the Guild Master selects the Difficulty and Initiates the Challenge. During the event, Members may Enter Dungeon at any time to Follow the guild's current progress and participate in the Challenge.
@{4}.Reward Counts are shared between stages with the same name across different Difficulty levels. After Claiming a stage reward, you cannot Claim another reward from a stage with the same name that week. Stages with no Remaining Reward Counts may be skipped.
@{5}.Clear rewards are issued immediately after each stage's Settlement. Auction Rewards continue to accumulate, and the auction begins after the Event Over.
@{6}.While the event is Active, the Guild Master may adjust the Challenge Difficulty at any time.

column1: @{1}.需要通关前一难度模式下所有关卡后解锁。\n@{2}.每周一@{3}:@{4}重置奖励次数并解锁下一难度模式。\n@{5}.每周最多只能解锁一个难度。
column2: @{1}.Unlocks after clearing every stage on the previous difficulty.\n@{2}.The Reward Count resets and the next difficulty unlocks every Monday at @{3}:@{4}.\n@{5}.Only one difficulty can be unlocked each week.

column1: @{1}.登入炮台后，可以立即使用炮台进行攻击\n@{2}.可以通过调整视角向不同的方向开炮\n@{3}.死亡活离线会自动从炮台上登出
column2: @{1}.After mounting the Turret, you can immediately use it to attack.\n@{2}.Adjust the camera to fire the Turret in different directions.\n@{3}.You will automatically dismount the Turret if you die or go offline.

column1: @{1}.公会挑战中通关阶段所获得的拍卖奖励都将在此处预览。\n@{2}.所有拍卖需要等到活动结束后集中前往公会拍卖行竞拍。
column2: @{1}.Auction Rewards earned by clearing stages in the Guild Challenge can be previewed here.\n@{2}.After the event ends, all items will be available for bidding in the Guild Auction.

column1: @{1}.战场正式开启后@{2}秒内，首次阵亡可以获得一次额外的参战机会。\n@{3}.首次阵亡无需其他队友救助，并且可自行选择新的落点位置。\n@{4}.额外的参战机会在选择落点时有时间限制，超出则会在死亡地点自动复活，请注意时间。
column2: @{1}.If you are defeated for the first time within @{2} seconds after the battlefield officially opens, you receive one Extra opportunity to rejoin the battle.\n@{3}.After being defeated for the first time, you do not need another teammate's aid and may choose a new drop point.\n@{4}.There is a time limit for choosing a drop point with this Extra opportunity. If time expires, you will automatically Revive where you were defeated. Keep an eye on the timer.

column1: 队友的身份牌，可使用或前往救护车复活该队友。
column2: A teammate's ID Tag. Use it or take it to an ambulance to Revive that teammate.

column1:
@{1}.盛典邀约开始后，可以选择一名幸运星押注，每次只能押注一名幸运星，押注后不可再修改。
@{2}.押注需要在盛典邀约活动答题正式开始前，若已经进行到答题阶段，则无法继续押注。
@{3}.如果押中的幸运星获得了第一名，则所有押注该幸运星的玩家都可获得一份奖励。
@{4}.奖励将会根据押中幸运星的玩家多少决定，奖励通过邮件发放。
column2:
@{1}.Once the Festival Invitation begins, you may choose one Lucky Star to bet on. You may only bet on one Lucky Star, and your choice cannot be changed afterward.
@{2}.You must place your bet before the Festival Invitation quiz begins. Betting is unavailable once the quiz has started.
@{3}.If your chosen Lucky Star finishes in first place, every player who bet on that Lucky Star receives a reward.
@{4}.The reward is determined by the number of players who correctly chose the winning Lucky Star and will be sent by mail.

column1: @{1}.准备阶段持续@{2}分钟，准备阶段结束后，将不会再允许进入本场景，请尽量不要在准备期间离开场景。\n@{3}.准备阶段结束后，立即进入答题，请留意题目信息。
column2: @{1}.The preparation phase lasts @{2} minutes. Once it ends, you can no longer enter this area, so avoid leaving during the preparation phase.\n@{3}.The quiz begins immediately after the preparation phase. Watch for the question details.

column1: @{1}.新方案首次使用需要重新加点和装配技能 \n@{2}.不同技能方案间相互独立，切换方案时技能加点和技能装配将同步切换 \n@{3}.战斗中不能切换技能方案
column2: @{1}.The first time you use a new Skill Build, you must reallocate skill points and equip skills again. \n@{2}.Each Skill Build is independent. Switching Skill Builds also switches your skill point allocation and equipped skills. \n@{3}.Skill Builds cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换属性方案
column2: Stat Builds cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换装备方案
column2: Equipment Builds cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换卡片方案
column2: Card Presets cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换神术图腾方案
column2: Divine Totem Builds cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换灵魂残响方案
column2: Soul Echo Builds cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 战斗中不能切换宠物方案
column2: Pet Presets cannot be switched during combat.

column1: 基础战力永久有效\n装备、精炼、卡片、宠物、神术图腾可提升基础战力
column2: Base Combat Power is permanent.\nEquipment, refinement, cards, pets, and Divine Totems can increase Base Combat Power.

column1: 赛季战力会随着赛季重置\n赛季突破，赛季精炼，宠物升级，灵魂残响可提升赛季战力
column2: Season Combat Power resets with each Season.\nSeason Breakthrough, Season Refinement, pet Level-up, and Soul Echoes can increase Season Combat Power.

column1: 精灵之塔没有次数限制，可以无限挑战，只能你能打得过。如果打不过可以第二天来试试！
column2: The Spirit Tower has no Attempt Restriction, so you can challenge it as many times as you want—as long as you can handle it! If you cannot clear it, try again tomorrow!

column1: 精灵之塔的宠物阵容独立于大世界的宠物出战阵容，要特别注意哦！
column2: The Spirit Tower's pet lineup is separate from the pet deployment lineup used in the open world, so keep that in mind!

column1:
@{1}. 攻破城门，进入内城。
@{2}. 击败看门人，获取进攻时间并打开道路。
@{3}.占领争夺点，获取前线复活权利。
@{4}.击破水晶，获得胜利！
column2:
@{1}. Break through the castle gate and enter the Inner Area.
@{2}. Defeat the Gatekeeper to gain additional attack time and open the path.
@{3}.Capture the control point to secure the frontline Revive point.
@{4}.Destroy the Crystal to claim victory!

column1:
● 冲车能对城门造成巨大伤害，注意保护
● 圈内的人数比对方多，冲车就会向前移动
● 冲车到达城门后会自行攻击
column2:
● The battering ram deals massive damage to the castle gate, so protect it.
● When your side has more players inside the circle than the enemy, the battering ram moves forward.
● Once the battering ram reaches the castle gate, it attacks automatically.

column1:
● 云梯架设成功后，可登上城墙
● 云梯会自行移动，但仍需要保护
● 登上城墙后，请优先击杀火炮与守卫！
column2:
● Once a siege ladder is deployed, it can be used to scale the wall.
● Siege ladders move automatically, but they still need protection.
● After reaching the wall, prioritize killing the cannons and guards!

column1:
● 拥有火器权利的玩家，可以架设火炮攻击
● 长按开炮键可缩小炮弹落点圈（飞鸦除外）
● 炮弹有限，务必合理利用
column2:
● Players with firearm permission can deploy cannons to attack.
● Hold the Fire button to shrink the shell's impact area, except when using the Flying Crow.
● Ammunition is limited, so use it wisely.

column1:
● 拥有载具权限，可在车间位置驾驶机甲
● 机甲带有恢复光环，在其身边可恢复生命
● 机甲十分强大，能有效帮助己方推进战线
column2:
● Players with vehicle permission can operate a Madogear Pilot at the workshop.
● The Madogear Pilot has a recovery Orbit that restores Life to nearby allies.
● The Madogear Pilot is extremely powerful and can help your side push the battlefront.

column1:
倒计时结束即可获胜。
@{1}. 避免城门被毁。
@{2}. 保护监护人与看门人。
@{3}. 守住争夺点，使水晶保持无敌。
@{4}. 避免水晶被毁！！！
column2:
Survive until the countdown ends to win.
@{1}. Prevent the castle gate from being destroyed.
@{2}. Protect the Warden and Gatekeeper.
@{3}. Hold the control point to keep the Crystal Invincible.
@{4}. Prevent the Crystal from being destroyed!!!

column1:
● 在城墙边缘，可以跃下城墙出城进攻
● 利用同样方式，可以回到城墙上
● 注意尽早摧毁对方的冲车，避免城门被攻破
column2:
● Leap from the edge of the wall to leave the castle and attack.
● Use the same method to return to the wall.
● Destroy the enemy battering ram as soon as possible to prevent the castle gate from being breached.

column1:
● 对方的云梯架设成功，敌人就能登上城墙
● 击毁云梯可以让城墙上的敌人无路可退
● 火炮也可以对云梯造成有效伤害
column2:
● Once the enemy deploys a siege ladder, they can scale the wall.
● Destroying a siege ladder cuts off the retreat of enemies already on the wall.
● Cannons are also effective against siege ladders.

column1:
米德加兹大陆上空出现了裂隙，未知的世界似乎即将降临。初心者教官正在召集冒险者收集魔能晶石，以防御即将到来的世界。
@{1}.活动期间，完成活动日历的第@{2}阶宝箱、挑战MVP、提交猫手商队任务可获得魔能晶石。每日可以挑战MVP@{3}次，猫手商队任务没有次数限制。
@{4}.全服捐赠物资的进度将触发活动进度条阶段奖励。进度条完成后，备战工作完成，即可等待异世界的降临。
@{5}.可将魔能晶石捐赠给初心者教官，兑换贡献者徽章，徽章可以在贡献者商店中兑换奖励。
@{6}.捐赠活动将在X日X时结束；在X日X时之前，玩家可以继续在商店兑换奖品。（无需翻译）
column2:
A rift has appeared above the Midgard Continent, and an unknown world appears poised to descend. The Novice Instructor is recruiting Adventurers to collect Arcane Crystals and defend against the approaching world.
@{1}.During the event, obtain Arcane Crystals by opening the Tier @{2} chest in the Event Calendar, challenging MVPs, and turning in Cat Hand Caravan quests. You may challenge MVPs @{3} times per day. Cat Hand Caravan quests have no Attempt Restriction.
@{4}.The Entire Server's material donation progress unlocks milestone rewards on the event progress bar. Once the bar is full, preparations will be complete, and everyone can await the arrival of the otherworld.
@{5}.Donate Arcane Crystals to the Novice Instructor in exchange for Contributor Badges, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Contributor Shop.
@{6}.The donation event ends on Day X at Hour X. Players may continue exchanging for prizes in the shop until Day X at Hour X.

column1: 公会积分是公会内所有成员个人献积分的总和。个人的贡献积分与贡献的晶石数量成正比。请获得活动日历活跃宝箱，且多多参与MVP、每日活跃、公会募集来提升贡献积分吧。（无需翻译）
column2: Guild Points are the sum of the individual Contribution Points earned by all Members of the Guild. Each player's Contribution Points are proportional to the number of Crystals contributed. Open Activity Chests in the Event Calendar and participate in MVP challenges, Daily Activity, and Guild Recruitment to earn more Contribution Points!

column1:
攻城值(仅限攻方)：对城门、城卫、守护者、华丽金属每造成@{1}伤害加@{2}分
驻守值(仅限守方)：在城门、城卫、守护者、华丽金属一定范围内驻守，每@{3}秒加@{4}分
摧毁器械：摧毁敌方器械的数量
击杀：击倒敌方的次数
助攻：协助我方成员完成击杀的次数
战场评分：达成各项战场指标后获得的评分，综合反应个人战斗贡献
器械伤害：使用器械造成的伤害总值
伤害值：角色造成的伤害总值
承伤：角色受到的伤害总值
治疗：角色提供治疗量总值
column2:
Siege Points (Attackers Only): Gain @{2} points for every @{1} damage dealt to the castle gate, Castle Guards, Protectors, or Emperium.
Defense Points (Defenders Only): Gain @{4} points every @{3} seconds while stationed within a certain range of the castle gate, Castle Guards, Protectors, or Emperium.
Machines Destroyed: Number of enemy machines destroyed.
Kills: Number of times enemies were defeated.
Assists: Number of times you helped allied Members complete a Kill.
Battlefield Rating: Rating earned by meeting battlefield objectives, reflecting your overall individual contribution.
Machine Damage: Total damage dealt using machines.
Damage Dealt: Total damage dealt by the character.
Damage Taken: Total damage taken by the character.
Healing: Total Healing Volume provided by the character.

column1: 王城竞拍结束后，竞拍成功的公会将获得进攻王城权限。在赛季初王城没有归属权的情况下，将会由竞拍获胜的两个公会随机获得进攻与防守权。
column2: After the Royal City auction ends, the successful Guild gains the right to attack the Royal City. If the Royal City has no owner at the start of the Season, the two Guilds that win the auction will be randomly assigned the attacker and defender roles.

column1: 进攻方：最终摧毁防守方的华丽金属即胜利。\n防守方：坚持到时限结束则胜利。
column2: Attackers: Destroy the defenders' Emperium to win.\nDefenders: Hold out until time expires to win.

column1:
战场中公会最多可进入@{1}人，整个玩法会分成四个阶段，准备阶段与三个进攻阶段。
准备阶段：进攻方无法冲出大营，防守方无法出城墙，但相应的器械与机甲可以操作。
战斗阶段P@{2}：双方正式交战，进攻方会拥有@{3}分钟来攻破城门。如成功则获得时间奖励，进攻继续；如在时限内未能攻破城门，则防守方胜利。
战斗阶段P@{4}：进攻方需在时限内击杀守护者才能打开通往城堡的道路，同时击杀城卫与守护者可以获得相应的时间奖励。
战斗阶段P@{5}：城堡前有复活点，进攻方需进入争夺圈夺取才能接触华丽金属的无敌状态，同时获得城堡前的复活点。复活点可以反复争夺，当防守方抢回复活点时，华丽金属会再次进入无敌状态。并且华丽金属在任何情况下脱离战斗@{6}秒后会逐渐恢复血量（但仅限当前阶段血量，华丽金属血量一共分三个阶段）。
column2:
Up to @{1} Guild Members may enter the battlefield. The mode is divided into four phases: one preparation phase and three attack phases.
Preparation Phase: Attackers cannot leave their base, and defenders cannot leave the castle walls, but both sides may operate their respective machines and Madogear Pilots.
Battle Phase P@{2}: The battle officially begins. Attackers have @{3} minutes to breach the castle gate. If they succeed, they receive bonus time and the attack continues. If they fail to breach the gate before time expires, the defenders win.
Battle Phase P@{4}: Attackers must Kill the Protector within the time limit to open the path to the castle. Killing Castle Guards and the Protector grants the corresponding time bonuses.
Battle Phase P@{5}: There is a Revive point in front of the castle. Attackers must enter the control circle and capture it to remove the Emperium's Invincible status and secure the Revive point. The Revive point can change hands repeatedly. If the defenders recapture it, the Emperium becomes Invincible again. Under any circumstances, after the Emperium remains out of combat for @{6} seconds, it gradually recovers HP within its current phase. The Emperium has three HP phases in total.

column1: 在战斗中，双方都可以使用火器与载具。两种器械由公会提供，需要官员给予公会成员权限才可使用。战前请务必商量注意使用权限的赋予。
column2: Both sides can use firearms and vehicles in battle. The Guild provides both types of machines, but an officer must grant Guild Members permission to use them. Be sure to coordinate machine permissions before the battle.

column1:
沉睡着的音乐能量，于寂静中等待唤醒，只为奏响创世的序章……
解开音符谜团，奏响乐章，即可为大陆注入音乐能量。

^{1}音符线索^{2}
活动期间，每天都会有数个^{3}音符线索^{4}散落在某处城市中，获得线索后，即可获得对应的音符谜底，其中一部分线索可在神秘人口中获得。
只有^{5}全部音符都选择正确^{6}时，乐章才能成功被弹奏。去寻找音符线索，获得更多答案吧！
column2:
Dormant musical energy lies silently awaiting its awakening, ready to sound the prelude of creation...
Solve the note puzzles and play the melody to fill the continent with musical energy.

^{1}Note Clues^{2}
During the event, several ^{3}Note Clues^{4} are scattered throughout a certain city each day. Obtain a Clue to reveal the answer to its corresponding note puzzle. Some Clues can be obtained from a mysterious person.
The melody can only be played successfully when ^{5}all notes are selected correctly^{6}. Search for Note Clues to uncover more answers!

column1: 神秘人展示的乐谱中，有几处缺失的音符，只有解开全部音符的谜团，才能成功演奏乐曲。
column2: Several notes are missing from the score shown by the mysterious person. The piece can only be performed successfully after every note puzzle has been solved.

column1: 根据神秘人的提示，可获得@{1}处音符谜团的线索。
column2: Following the mysterious figure's hints will reveal Clues to @{1} missing-note puzzles.

column1: 来到神秘人提示的位置寻找，可找到散落的音符线索，并解开对应谜底。
column2: Search the locations indicated by the mysterious figure to find scattered note Clues and solve the corresponding puzzles.

column1: 未解开的音符谜团，则可点击谜团，手动选择音符。
column2: For unsolved note puzzles, tap the puzzle to select a note manually.

column1: 对全部谜团做出解答后，才能拨动琴弦，尝试演奏，但只有选对所有音符，方可成功奏响乐章。\n每人每天获得的线索有限，尝试和其他人互相询问，或许能有更多答案哦。
column2: After solving every puzzle, you can pluck the strings and attempt to play the piece, but the melody will only sound if every note is correct.\nEach person can obtain only a limited number of Clues per day. Try asking others and sharing information—you might uncover more answers!

column1: ● 上交给公会可换取公会货币奖励。\n● 无法带出界域沙盘，离开时会从身上掉落。● 在橙区死亡时，每次掉落身上总量的的@{1}%。● 在黑区死亡时，每次掉落身上总量的@{2}%。
column2: ● Turn it in to the guild for guild Currency rewards.\n● It cannot be taken out of the Realm Sandbox and will drop from your inventory when you leave.● Upon dying in an Orange Zone, you will drop @{1}% of the total amount you are carrying.● Upon dying in a Black Zone, you will drop @{2}% of the total amount you are carrying.

column1: 安全区：不会受到其他玩家的攻击，但请小心怪物依旧具有攻击性。\n冲突区：通过切换至公会模式/自由模式可攻击其他玩家，请注意！\n激战区：能够自由攻击其他公会成员，也可切换自由模式！
column2: Safe Zone: Other players cannot attack you, but beware—monsters are still hostile.\nConflict Zone: Switch to Guild Mode/Free Mode to attack other players. Stay alert!\nWar Zone: You can freely attack Guild Members and may also switch to Free Mode!

column1: @{1}.摆摊上架时，货币为喵果时，收取@{2}%的摊位费，货币为Zeny时，收取@{3}%的摊位费。\n@{4}.货币为喵果时，最低@{5}喵果，最高@{6}喵果。\n@{7}.货币为Zeny时，最低@{8}zeny，最高@{9}zeny。

column2: This battle consists of ^{1}seven stages^{2}. See the following tabs for detailed instructions on each stage.\nThe progress display has three states: the current stage is yellow, completed stages are green, and stages Yet to start are gray.

column1: 玩家乘坐飞空艇一路前行，终于追上了逃跑的伊尔玛塔，要想击败伊尔玛塔需要先想办法到鲲背上去……\n@{1}、^{1}通过飞空艇上的重炮，我们可以使阿尔玛基亚变得虚弱。^{2}\n@{2}、趁虚弱时可以使用弩炮来固定住阿尔玛基亚，接着^{3}交互绳索移动到阿尔玛基亚的背部进行探索。^{4}
column2: After traveling aboard the airship, the players finally catch up with the fleeing Ilmata. To defeat Ilmata, they must first find a way onto the great beast's back...\n@{1}. ^{1}Use the airship's Heavy Cannon to make Almagia Weak.^{2}\n@{2}. While Almagia is Weak, use the Ballista to secure a rope to it, then ^{3}use Interaction with the rope to reach Almagia's back and explore.^{4}

column1: 器械-重炮：\n驾驶重炮的玩家，可以瞄准阿尔玛基亚的身体部位进行轰击。\n持续轰击后会对阿尔玛基亚造成虚弱状态

column1:
赛季的正式赛段结束之时，将会对全体玩家进行赛季结算奖励的发放。赛季结算系统将根据玩家个人及公会在整个赛季多项内容的表现给与大量的奖励回馈，在赛季中取得的成绩越好的玩家获得的回报就越丰厚；

^{1}结算时间点^{2}：
本赛季最后@{1}个阶段开始之时，就是进行赛季结算的时刻；所有的赛季结算奖励都将在此刻过后发放。

^{3}结算分类^{4}：
赛季结算可以分为两个大类：领土战结算和时空史诗结算。两类结算对应不同的结算内容和奖励形式。

^{5}领土战结算^{6}：
领土战结算将根据公会及个人在领土战中所取得的成绩进行奖励发放。在领土战中获得优异成绩的玩家不但能获得大量奖励回馈，还能获得在赛季商店中购买新赛季限定道具的资格。

^{7}时空史诗结算^{8}：
时空史诗包含了多项史诗任务，覆盖了赛季中的多项内容。完成时空史诗除了获得丰厚奖励外，更能得到极具收藏价值的时空徽记。（无需翻译）
column2:
When the Season's official phase ends, Season Settlement rewards will be distributed to all players. The Season Settlement System grants substantial rewards based on each player's and Guild's performance across various activities throughout the Season. The better a player performs during the Season, the greater the rewards they will receive.

^{1}Settlement Time^{2}:
Season Settlement takes place when the final @{1} phases of the current Season begin. All Season Settlement rewards will be distributed after this point.

^{3}Settlement Categories^{4}:
Season Settlement is divided into two main categories: Territory War Settlement and Spacetime Epic Settlement. Each category covers different content and offers different types of rewards.

^{5}Territory War Settlement^{6}:
Territory War Settlement rewards are based on each Guild's and player's performance in Territory War. Players who achieve outstanding results in Territory War will not only receive substantial rewards, but also become eligible to purchase limited-time items for the new Season from the Season Shop.

^{7}Spacetime Epic Settlement^{8}:
Spacetime Epic features multiple Epic Quests spanning various types of Season content. Completing Spacetime Epic grants generous rewards as well as the highly collectible Spacetime Emblem.

column1:
赛季结算时，将根据公会及个人在领土战中取得的成绩进行奖励结算。
领土战结算可分为@{1}个部分：领土积分榜结算、王城结算和界域功勋结算。

^{1}领土积分榜结算^{2}：
赛季结算时公会在领土积分榜的排名决定了公会成员能否获得王座奖励。
王座奖励是整个赛季最重头的奖励。其获取方式为名额分配制，具体规则为：
@{2}. 积分榜前@{3}名的公会分别获得@{4}、@{5}和@{6}个王座名额。
@{7}. 结算时占领着王城将获得@{8}个王座名额；占领郡城将获得 @{9}*占领郡城数量 的王座名额。
@{10}. 公会获得的王座名额将依照公会内全体成员的“王权战誉”排名从高到低自动发放给公会成员。
@{11}. 积分榜前@{12}名公会的全体官员会自动获得王座奖励，不占用公会的王座名额；
未能获得王座奖励的玩家，将获得桂冠奖励。所在公会的排名越高，桂冠奖励越丰厚。

^{3}王城结算^{4}：
在结算时占领着王城的公会，将获得额外的殊荣：界域星芒。

^{5}界域功勋结算^{6}：
赛季结算时，将结算界域功勋排行榜的奖励。所有排名符合要求的玩家将可获得与名次对应的奖励。（无需翻译）
column2:
At Season Settlement, rewards will be determined based on each guild's and player's performance in the Territory War.
Territory War Settlement consists of @{1} parts: Territory Points Leaderboard Settlement, Royal City Settlement, and Realm Merit Settlement.

^{1}Territory Points Leaderboard Settlement^{2}:
At Season Settlement, a guild's ranking on the Territory Points Leaderboard determines whether its Guild Members are eligible for Throne Rewards.
Throne Rewards are the most prestigious rewards of the entire Season. They are distributed through a quota system according to the following rules:
@{2}. The top @{3} guilds on the Points Leaderboard receive @{4}, @{5}, and @{6} Throne slots, respectively.
@{7}. A guild occupying the Royal City at Settlement receives @{8} Throne slots; a guild occupying County Cities receives @{9}*the number of County Cities occupied Throne slots.
@{10}. A guild's Throne slots are automatically awarded to Guild Members in descending order of their Royal War Prestige ranking within the guild.
@{11}. All officers of the top @{12} guilds on the Points Leaderboard automatically receive Throne Rewards without using their guild's Throne slots;
Players who do not receive Throne Rewards will receive Laurel Rewards instead. The higher their guild ranks, the greater their Laurel Rewards will be.

^{3}Royal City Settlement^{4}:
The guild occupying the Royal City at Settlement will receive an Extra honor: Realm Starlight.

^{5}Realm Merit Settlement^{6}:
At Season Settlement, Realm Merit Leaderboard rewards will be calculated. All eligible ranked players will receive rewards based on their placement.

column1:
每个赛季均包含一系列“时空史诗”任务，会在赛季结算时间点检查玩家的达成情况。
每达成@{1}条时空史诗，都可获得对应的奖励；部分时空史诗会奖励赛季限定收藏品“时空徽记”，可在“个人空间-徽记墙”查看。
在结算时间点过后，未能达成的时空史诗将无法被完成；
赛季结束时尚未领取的时空史诗奖励，系统将会自动补发奖励邮件。（无需翻译）
column2:
Each Season includes a series of “Chronicle of Time and Space” quests. Players' completion status will be checked at the time of Season Settlement.
You will receive the corresponding reward for every @{1} Chronicle of Time and Space quest completed. Some quests reward the Season-exclusive collectible “Space-Time Emblem,” which can be viewed under “Personal Space - Emblem Wall.”
Any Chronicle of Time and Space quests left incomplete after the Settlement deadline can no longer be completed.
When the Season ends, the System will automatically send any unclaimed Chronicle of Time and Space rewards by mail.

column1:
本次活动围绕“领土战”玩法展开，分为两大部分：

在活动期间，公会积极参与领土战达成对应的积分任务，公会成员可获得对应奖励。

column2:
This event centers on Territory War and consists of two main parts:
@{1}. Guild Quests: Rewards
During the event, guilds can participate in Territory War and complete point-based quests, allowing each Guild Member to earn the corresponding rewards.
@{2}. Guild Total Points Ranking Rewards
During the event, the System will rank guilds across the Entire Server based on the Total Points accumulated by their members in Territory War. After the event ends, the highest-ranking guilds will receive tier-based rewards that all alliance members can claim. These rewards will provide vital resources and strategic advantages in future Territory Wars.

Players who reach higher Floors will rank higher.\n@{2}. Players who complete the same number of Floors will be ranked by completion time, with faster players ranking higher.

column2:

column2:

Defeat a player: @{1} Points/player
Assist an ally: @{2} Points/time
Revive an ally: @{3} Points/player

Flag Delivered Successfully (Main Battlefield): @{5} Points/time

column1: 战场评分用于比赛中的个人表现，共分为D、C、B、A、S、SS、SSS七个档位，战场内玩家进行有利于本方公会和队友的行为均可以提升评分和档位。
column2: Battlefield Rating reflects individual performance during a match and is divided into seven tiers: D, C, B, A, S, SS, and SSS. Actions that benefit your guild and teammates increase your Rating and tier.

column1: 联赛段位共分为仙境传说、钻石、翡翠、白金、黄金、白银、黄铜、黑铁等八个段位，每个赛程开始时，系统将根据上个赛程的公会小组排名进行定段，排名靠前的公会将会升段，排名靠后的将会降段。定段后处于相同段位的公会会被分为若干小组，小组内的公会随机进行初赛的匹配对局。
column2: The League has eight tiers: Ragnarok, Diamond, Jade, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Black Iron. At the start of each tournament, the System assigns tiers based on each guild's group ranking from the previous tournament. Higher-ranked guilds are promoted, while lower-ranked guilds are demoted. Guilds in the same tier are then divided into groups and randomly matched within their group for the preliminary round.

column1: 赛程开始时，所有公会将会在周一的@{1}:@{2}进行自动报名，同时系统将根据上个赛程的公会小组内排名确定各个公会的段位并匹配对局（每个赛季首次赛程会根据公会的成员战力确定段位）。赛程中每个公会将会参与初赛、复赛、决赛三场比赛，决赛阶段结束后，系统会根据三场比赛的结果进行小组排名。
column2: At the start of each tournament, all guilds will be automatically registered at @{1}:@{2} on Monday. The System will then assign each guild to a division and match based on its group ranking from the previous tournament. (For the first tournament of each Season, divisions will be determined by the Combat Power of each guild's Members.) Each guild will compete in three matches: the preliminaries, semifinals, and finals. After the finals, the System will determine the group rankings based on the results of all three matches.

column1: 主战场每个公会最多可进入@{1}人，只有精英可以进入主战场。主战场有火、山、水三个点位可供占领，占领点位和持续占点可获得公会积分。点位归属根据点位内双方公会人数多少决定，点位占领后有@{2}秒的保护时间，在此期间无法变更归属。比赛开始进入战斗后，每隔@{3}分钟，中庭位置会出现首领，尾刀首领的玩家可以获得旗帜，将旗帜运送至己方已占领的点位可获得公会积分。
column2: Each guild may send up to @{1} Members into the Main Battlefield, and only Elite Members may Enter. The Main Battlefield has 3 capture points: Fire, Mountain, and Water. Capturing and maintaining control of these points grants Guild Points. Control is determined by which guild has more Members at the point. After a point is captured, it is Fortified for @{2} seconds and cannot change hands. Once the Battle begins, a Boss appears in the courtyard every @{3} minutes. The player who lands the Final Blow on the Boss receives a flag. Delivering the flag to a point controlled by your guild grants Guild Points.

column1: 副战场不限制进入人数，除临时成员外均可以参与比赛。比赛开始进入战斗后，场上立即出现大量守卫，@{1}分钟后出现大量守卫和@{2}个统领，@{3}分钟后出现首领，击败守卫、统领和首领可以获得士气值，击败统领和首领可以增加主战场指挥官技能使用次数。
column2: There is no limit to the number of players who may Enter the Sub-Battlefield. All Members except Temporary Members may participate. Once the Battle begins, large numbers of Guards appear immediately. After @{1} minutes, more Guards and @{2} Commanders appear. After @{3} minutes, a Boss appears. Defeating Guards, Commanders, and the Boss grants Morale. Defeating Commanders and the Boss increases the Uses of Commander skills in the Main Battlefield.

Defeat a player: @{3} Points/player

士气值达到@{1}/@{2}/@{3}则主副战场所有成员获得@{4}%/@{5}%/@{6}%的伤害减免。副战场进行以下行为可以增加士气值：

Defeat a Guard: @{8} Morale each

Defeat a Boss: @{10} Morale each

column1: 击败副战场统领和首领，主战场会长和指挥官可以获得强力指挥官技能（共享限次）。
column2: Defeating Commanders and Bosses on the Sub-Battlefield grants powerful Commander skills with shared limited Uses to the Guild Master and Commanders on the Main Battlefield.
