column2: After the match, a guild with at least @{1} Guild Points and @{2} participants will receive Auction Rewards and Auction Dividends. Players with at least @{3} Personal Points will receive individual Participation Rewards.

@{6}.装载满@{7}/@{8}/@{9}个货物后进行发车，可获得更多额外奖励。
column2:

column1:
@{1}.交易记录保留最近@{2}条购买和出售记录。
@{3}.购买记录展示商品名称、花费金额、订单号和交易时间。
@{4}.出售记录展示商品名称、实际收益、手续费和交易时间。

column1:
公会黑市是公会之间的资源交易平台，公会管理可使用公会资金购买其他公会发布的战备资源。
@{1}.公会管理可在摊位中上架公会战备资源进行出售，上架时需设置单价和数量。
@{2}.单价基于近期成交均价在一定范围内调整，无法自由输入。
@{3}.黑市展示所有公会的在售资源，相同单价的资源会合并展示。
@{4}.购买时系统自动按上架时间先后匹配卖方，商品售出时将按总价收取一定比例的手续费。
@{5}.仅限具有公会管理权限的成员进行黑市操作。
column2:
The Guild Black Market is a resource Trade platform between guilds. Guild Management can use Guild Funds to purchase war supplies listed by other guilds.
@{1}.Guild Management can list guild war supplies for sale at a stall by setting the unit price and quantity.
@{2}.The unit price can only be adjusted within a certain range based on the recent average Trade price and cannot be entered freely.
@{3}.The Black Market displays all resources listed for sale by every guild. Resources with the same unit price are grouped together.
@{4}.When a purchase is made, the System automatically matches sellers based on listing time. When an item is sold, a percentage of the total price is charged as a transaction fee.
@{5}.Only a Member with Guild Management permissions can use the Black Market.

column1: 交易手续费是由黑市收取的费用，根据出售所得收益按照百分比收取，可以在出售记录中查看实际收益。
column2: The Trade fee is charged by the Black Market as a percentage of the sale proceeds. You can view your actual earnings in the sales history.

@{2}.每次入围失败后，将自动按照固定的阶段系数逐步加价，直到高于门槛价。
@{3}.如果所有阶段都没有高于门槛价，自动竞拍将中止并通知公会。
@{4}.竞拍风格代表自动出价的延迟时间。
column2:
@{1}. Auto Bid can be configured during the preparation phase and will automatically place bids once the auction begins.
@{2}. After each failed qualification attempt, the bid will automatically Increase Bid based on the fixed tier multiplier until it exceeds the threshold price.
@{3}. If none of the tiers exceed the threshold price, Auto Bid will stop and send a Notification to the Guild.
@{4}. Bid Style determines the delay before each automatic bid.

column1: 系统会自动按照固定阶梯（@{1}%、@{2}%、@{3}%、@{4}%、@{5}%、@{6}%）逐步加价，如果全部出价用完，则会停止出价。
column2: The System will automatically use Increase Bid in fixed increments (@{1}%, @{2}%, @{3}%, @{4}%, @{5}%, and @{6}%). Once all bids are used, it will stop bidding.

column1:
活动期间，参与特定玩法有概率获得“结晶”。关联玩法与结晶的获取方式包括：
@{1}. MVP每日参与奖励
@{2}. 公会募集累计提交@{3}、@{4}、@{5}、@{6}次奖励
@{7}. 每日活跃最终宝箱奖励
集齐一套结晶即可开启“回忆之匣”（位于活动页面的宝箱），获取丰厚奖励。结晶还可通过向公会成员请求获得。多次开启“回忆之匣”可逐步解锁进度条奖励^{1}未来之匣^{2}，内含为下赛季准备的珍稀资源。
column2:
During the event, participate in specific activities for a Chance to obtain Crystals. Crystals can be obtained from the following activities:
@{1}. Daily MVP participation rewards
@{2}. Rewards for making a total of @{3}, @{4}, @{5}, or @{6} Guild Supply submissions
@{7}. Final Daily Activity Chest reward
Collect a complete set of Crystals to open the Memory Coffer—the chest on the event page—and claim generous rewards. You can also request Crystals from Guild Members. Open the Memory Coffer multiple times to gradually unlock the progress reward, ^{1}Coffer of the Future^{2}, which contains rare resources for the next Season.

column1:
活动期间可通过完成活跃任务获得宝图，并使用藏宝图进行寻宝。宝图分为两种：普通藏宝图与珍奇藏宝图。
@{1}. 使用普通藏宝图情况如下，获得奖励（包含宝图碎片）、触发精英怪或召唤大BOSS，或者挖宝失败。
@{2}. 珍奇藏宝图挖宝成功后将直接获得珍贵奖励，奖品价值高且结果稳定。
珍奇藏宝图可通过宝图碎片合成获得。宝图碎片可在使用普通藏宝图挖宝过程中获得，也可通过交易行购买获取。
建议在活动期间，优先完成【活动玩法界面】中的活跃任务。完成任务可获得一定数量的普通藏宝图，是获取宝图碎片的主要途径之一。
另外，使用普通与珍奇宝图寻宝有概率获得遗失的旅人日志，根据日志的线索在地图上搜索目标地点，可能获得额外惊喜奖励。
column2:
During the event, complete Activity Missions to obtain Treasure Maps, then use them to hunt for treasure. There are two types of Treasure Maps: Normal Treasure Maps and Rare Treasure Maps.
@{1}. Using a Normal Treasure Map may grant rewards (including Treasure Map Fragments), trigger an Elite Monster encounter, summon a powerful Boss, or result in a failed treasure hunt.
@{2}. Successfully hunting for treasure with a Rare Treasure Map will grant valuable rewards with consistently high prize values.
Rare Treasure Maps can be crafted from Treasure Map Fragments. Treasure Map Fragments can be obtained while hunting for treasure with Normal Treasure Maps or purchased through Trade.
During the event, we recommend prioritizing Activity Missions on the Event Gameplay screen. Completing these missions grants a certain number of Normal Treasure Maps and is one of the main ways to obtain Treasure Map Fragments.
Additionally, hunting for treasure with Normal or Rare Treasure Maps has a Chance to grant a Lost Traveler's Journal. Follow the Clues in the journal to search the map for the destination, where you may find an Extra surprise reward.

拍卖消耗：
消耗公会物资，参与获得据点争夺战玩法的资格拍卖。

column2:

Auction Cost:
Guild Supplies are consumed to bid for the right to participate in Stronghold War.

Auction Permissions:
Only certain guild ranks have permission to perform auction-related actions.

Auction Rules:
The corresponding amount of Guild Supplies will be deducted when a bid is successfully placed.
Once a guild places a bid, it cannot withdraw or lower the bid. Bids may only be raised manually.

Stronghold Contest Phases:
The Stronghold Contest cycles through the following phases: Bidding → Preparation → In Progress → Ended.
At the end of the Season, the off-season begins. The contest will resume when the next Season starts.

Bidding:
During this phase, Guild Leaders must spend Guild Supplies to place bids and qualify for the Stronghold Contest.
For each prefecture within the same realm, only the top @{1} bidding guilds can participate in the Stronghold Contest.

Preparation:
During this phase, the bidding results and attack information are displayed so qualifying guilds can discuss their strategies.

In Progress:
The Stronghold Contest officially begins. Keep the information displayed during the Preparation phase and provide qualifying guilds with an entrance to the event.

Ended:
The results of the current Stronghold Contest are displayed. Tap Battle Record in the lower-right corner for more details on the battle's offense and defense.
When this phase ends, a new Stronghold Contest cycle begins with the Bidding phase.

活动开启时，有五分钟的报名时间，报名后进入报名场景。报名时间结束后，依然在报名场景的玩家会等待短暂的匹配时间。
@{2}.胜利条件
有一方率先达到@{3}阵营积分的阵营胜利。或者对局时间结束后积分最多的阵营获胜。
@{4}.阵营积分获取规则
击杀玩家、伤害首领、把首领打至@{5}%血量、击杀首领、击杀小怪均可得分。
@{6}.战场技能
周围会周期性的刷新战场技能，拾取后可以获得强大的技能。
column2:
@{1}. Registration Phase
When the event begins, you have 5 minutes to register. After registering, you will Enter the registration Location. When registration ends, players still in the registration Location will Wait briefly for matchmaking.
@{2}.Victory Conditions
The first Faction to reach @{3} Faction points wins. If neither does, the Faction with the most points when time expires wins.
@{4}.Faction Scoring Rules
Score by killing Players, damaging the Boss, reducing the Boss to @{5}% HP, killing the Boss, or killing minor monsters.
@{6}.Battlefield Skill
Battlefield Skills periodically appear nearby. Pick them up to gain powerful skills.

column2: A Pipe that holds a cigarette. Its built-in filter helps reduce the harm caused by smoking.

column1: 可以用嘴巴叼的特制鱼。散发出一点点的腥味，但是它经过特殊加工，不会烂掉。\n打到魔物的时候，较低的几率来掉落“美味的鱼”。
column2: A specially treated fish that can be held in your mouth. It smells slightly fishy, but never spoils.\nDefeated monsters have a low chance to drop a "Tasty Fish."

column1: 曾经是这片大陆的秩序维护者，现在只要享受游戏就好了。
column2: Once a keeper of Order across this continent, now all that's left to do is enjoy the game.

column1: 当你化身为一只小猫，你就会获得最纯粹最简单的快乐。
column2: When you become a little kitty, you'll discover Happiness in its purest, most Easy form.

column1: 暗夜玫瑰在玄色绸缎上盛放，苍白蕾丝如蛛网缠绕颈间。金属十字架随铁链轻晃，裙撑划出锋利的阴影弧度，每一步都踏着中世纪管风琴的低鸣.
column2: Dark roses bloom across jet-black satin, pale lace coiling around the neck like a spiderweb. A metal cross sways from its chain, and the hoop skirt traces a sharp arc of shadow. Every step echoes the low hum of a medieval pipe organ.

column1: 月光般的银缎礼服倾泻而下，水晶珠链在腰间流淌成星河。鱼尾裙摆绽开万千细褶，随着转身漾起冰蓝色的光晕，宛如将整片夜幕穿在了身上。
column2: A moonlight-silver satin gown cascades downward, with crystal bead strands flowing across the waist like a river of stars. The mermaid hem blooms into delicate pleats, glowing icy blue with every movement, as though the night sky became a dress.

column1: 棉麻混纺的oversize衬衫随意垂落，做旧丹宁与奶油色针织碰撞出慵懒层次。挽起的袖口露出腕间编织手绳，帆布鞋尖沾着阳光的温度。
column2: An oversized linen-cotton shirt drapes over distressed denim and cream knitwear, creating relaxed layers. Rolled-up sleeves reveal a braided bracelet, while canvas shoes add a touch of sunlit warmth.

column1: 藏青格纹西装勾勒挺拔轮廓，金色校徽在驳领间闪烁。\n百褶裙随步伐扬起教科书般的弧度，及膝袜与牛津鞋之间，露出一截恰到好处的青春距离。
column2: A navy plaid suit creates a crisp silhouette, with a Gold academy crest on the lapel.\nThe pleated skirt swings perfectly with every step, paired with knee-high socks and Oxford shoes for a youthful look.

column1: 甜蜜的粉色和清爽的蓝色，翻糖褶裥堆叠出奶油质感。巧克力色缎带点缀上糖霜亮片，裙摆如旋转蛋糕塔，开启一场梦幻的甜蜜巡游。
column2: Sweet pink meets refreshing Blue, while fondant-like pleats build a creamy texture. Chocolate-colored ribbons sparkle with frosting-like sequins, and the skirt spins like a tiered cake, beginning a dreamy parade of sweetness.

column1: 甜蜜的粉蓝黄调蓬蓬裙，翻糖褶裥堆叠出奶油质感。巧克力色缎带点缀上糖霜亮片，当裙摆如蛋糕塔一般旋转开来，一场梦幻的甜蜜巡游就此开启。
column2: A sweet pink, Blue, and yellow puff dress features layers of fondant-like pleats with a creamy texture. Chocolate-colored ribbons sparkle with frosting-like sequins, and as the skirt spins open like a tiered cake, a dreamy parade of sweetness begins.

column1: 金缕流光映画堂，九色清音逐霓裳。缘起敦煌飞天美学，衣袂翩跹如丝带飞旋，融千年丝路神韵与东方灵秀，每一处纹理尽显古典雅致与空灵仙气。
column2: Golden threads shimmer through nine-hued robes, inspired by Dunhuang's flying apsaras. Its sleeves dance like swirling ribbons, blending the spirit of the Silk Road with Eastern grace. Every detail radiates classical elegance and ethereal beauty.

column1: 金红烈焰般的绸缎上，翎羽流泻，璀璨金线勾勒涅槃光华。步履间，似有神鸟低鸣，华贵雍容，气场灼灼生辉。
column2: Feathers cascade over satin like golden-red flames, while brilliant gold thread traces the radiance of rebirth. With every step comes the low call of a divine bird—regal, magnificent, and blazing with presence.

column1: 一个毛茸茸的狐狸尾巴，戴上它会变成真正的狐狸吗？
column2: A fluffy Fox tail. Will wearing it turn you into a real Fox?

column1: 一台非常有年代感的老旧电视机，甚至还能播放。
column2: A very old-fashioned television set that can surprisingly still play programs.

column1: 一个机械方向舵，中心有齿轮构造，在中央炉芯的动力之下会不停地转动。
column2: A mechanical ship's wheel with gears at its center. Powered by the central furnace core, it spins continuously.

column1: 为了那些敢于挑战自我并且坚持不懈的冒险家们特意制作的书包。鲜艳的红色正如他们熊熊燃烧的小宇宙。
column2: A backpack specially made for Adventurers who dare to challenge themselves and never give up. Its vivid red matches the fiery spirit burning within them.

column1: 童话镇的兔子家族，喜欢在阳光正好的下午钻进茶杯里睡午觉。
column2: The rabbit family of Fairy-Tale Town loves curling up inside teacups for afternoon naps whenever the sun is shining.

column1: 银翼圣约·配套主题背饰
一个介于蝴蝶和蜻蜓之间状态的翅膀，搭配裙子看起来像个花间小精灵。
column2: Wings that look like a cross between a butterfly's and a dragonfly's. Pair them with a dress to look like a tiny flower fairy.

column1: 一个时钟形状的特效光轮，上面写着罗马数字，轮盘上的时针和分针都在逆时针转动，仿佛可以操控时间一样。
column2: A clock-shaped halo with Roman numerals. Its hour and minute hands rotate counterclockwise, as though they could control time itself.

column1: 根据死神镰刀模拟制作出来的时装。
column2: A Costume modeled after the Grim Reaper's scythe.

column1: 匹阿漫特为方便攻击和防御而使用的布娃娃？\n我分明看到它动了一下……
column2: A doll Piamette uses to make attacking and defending easier?\nI could have sworn I saw it move...

column1: 疯兔、蓝疯兔、群叶疯兔聚在一起的时装气球。气球大到感觉可以让人飘起来
column2: A Costume balloon featuring Lunatic, Eclipse, and Leaf Lunatic together. It's so huge, it feels like it could carry someone away.

column1: 可爱的巨无霸蝴蝶结围巾。
看上去像是一只小猫的尾巴，戴上它会变成真正的小猫吗？
column2: It looks like a kitten's tail. Will wearing it turn you into a real kitten?

column1: 翼展即焚，翼翼皆不熄之火。\n灼世之羽·主题背饰
column2: Each spread of its wings brings fire, and every feather burns eternally.\nWorldscorch Feather · Theme Backwear

column1: 是波利！是背着大书包的巨大波利！
column2: It's a Poring! A giant Poring carrying a huge backpack!

column1: 扎着紫色蝴蝶结的毛茸茸长毛兔，跑起来的时候非常可爱
column2: A fluffy, long-haired rabbit wearing a purple bow. It's incredibly cute when it runs.

column1: 这是一个看起来有点老旧的小飞机。
column2: This little airplane looks a bit old-fashioned.

column1: 充满哥布灵意志的热气球！但由于制作工艺有问题，没有办法正常起飞。
column2: A hot-air balloon brimming with Goblin spirit! Unfortunately, flaws in its construction keep it from taking off.

column1: 曾用巨螯剪开汹涌的海浪，如今它收起风暴，成为最安稳的坐骑，背着你横行人世的海。
column2: It once cleaved through raging waves with its massive claws. Now it has laid the storm to rest and become the steadiest of mounts, carrying you sideways across the seas of the world.

column1: 努力的小猫推着它的小车……你是这辆车上最有价值却不会被出售的珍宝。
column2: A hardworking little kitty pushes its cart... You are the most valuable treasure aboard, yet you'll never be sold.

column1: 修改了上一次制造热气球无法起飞的错误，能够在空中飞翔的哥布灵最新力作！
column2: The latest Goblin masterpiece! After fixing the flaw that kept the previous hot-air balloon grounded, this one can soar through the sky!

column1: 藏在深海里的一只小鲲，总有一天它会慢慢长大，扶摇直上……
column2: A tiny kun hidden in the deep sea. Someday, it will slowly grow and soar into the heavens...

column1: 玩具工厂最新出品摇摇乐木马，虽然带着不明意味的迷之笑容。
column2: The Toy Factory's latest rocking horse, complete with a mysterious and slightly unsettling smile.

column1: 弱小的蛋壳小鸡，此刻变得非常勇猛，驮着冒险者前行。
column2: The once-frail Super Picky has become incredibly brave, carrying an Adventurer onward.

column1: 一匹泛着流光的神圣独角兽，不管从什么角度看它都非常迷人。
column2: A radiant, sacred unicorn that looks enchanting from every angle.

column1: 这张魔毯曾载过天方夜谭与沙漠星月，如今在你踏上的刹那，铺开一段御风而行的奇迹。
column2: This magic carpet once carried tales from the Arabian Nights beneath the desert moon and stars. The moment you step aboard, it unfurls a miracle that lets you ride the wind.

column1: 这架由古老烈日驯化而成的战车，每一次驰骋，都拖曳着破晓的金晖与黄昏的余烬。
column2: Forged from an ancient, tamed sun, this chariot trails the golden light of dawn and the dying embers of dusk with every charge.

column1: 深海鲸歌托起空谷幽兰，载你行过之地，似乎空中开出了花，水里浮起了星。
column2: The song of a deep-sea whale bears an orchid from a secluded valley. Wherever it carries you, flowers seem to bloom in the sky and stars rise from the water.

column1: 北冥有鱼，其名为鲲，鲲之大，不知其几千里也……需要多少个烧烤架？
column2: In the Northern Deep dwells a fish named Kun. Kun is so enormous that no one knows how many thousands of miles it spans... How many grills would that take?

column1: 这头曾执掌群星轨迹的古老巨龙，如今收敛神威，载着你巡游天际。
column2: This ancient dragon once governed the paths of the stars. Now it restrains its divine might and carries you across the heavens.

column1: 粉红色的头发就好像草莓马卡龙一样甜蜜。

They are also highly effective against Undead and Demon monsters, making them well suited for auto-battle leveling in the field.

column1: 教会的中坚力量，开始承担更多实际职责。赞美流派牧师在掌握了初级治疗魔法后的进阶，拥有了复活友方的能力，并拥有了群体治愈能力和护盾能力。在群体增益方面也得到了全面的强化，成为一名合格的治疗角色。

After mastering basic Divine Light magic, the Praiser Priest gains the ability to Revive allies, use AoE Divine Light, and provide shields. Their AoE buffs are also comprehensively Enhanced, making them a capable healer.

column2: An advanced cleric of the Church with considerable theological knowledge and administrative experience. The Praiser Priest High Priest further improves their Divine Light and party buffs.

column2: An advanced cleric of the Church with considerable theological knowledge and administrative experience. The Exorciser High Priest further improves their damage and Holy-element buffs.

庆历四年春@{1}，滕子京谪守巴陵郡@{2}。越明年@{3}，政通人和@{4}，百废具兴@{5}。乃重修岳阳楼@{6}，增其旧制@{7}，刻唐贤今人诗赋于其上@{8}。属予作文以记之@{9}。
予观夫巴陵胜状@{10}，在洞庭一湖。衔远山@{11}，吞长江@{12}，浩浩汤汤@{13}，横无际涯@{14}；朝晖夕阴，气象万千@{15}。此则岳阳楼之大观也@{16}，前人之述备矣@{17}。然则北通巫峡@{18}，南极潇湘@{19}，迁客骚人@{20}，多会于此@{21}，览物之情，得无异乎@{22}？
若夫淫雨霏霏@{23}，连月不开@{24}，阴风怒号@{25}，浊浪排空@{26}；日星隐曜@{27}，山岳潜形@{28}；商旅不行@{29}，樯倾楫摧@{30}；薄暮冥冥@{31}，虎啸猿啼。登斯楼也，则有去国怀乡@{32}，忧谗畏讥@{33}，满目萧然@{34}，感极而悲者矣@{35}。
至若春和景明@{36}，波澜不惊@{37}，上下天光@{38}，一碧万顷；沙鸥翔集，锦鳞游泳@{39}；岸芷汀兰@{40}，郁郁青青@{41}。而或长烟一空@{42}，皓月千里@{43}，浮光跃金@{44}，静影沉璧@{45}，渔歌互答@{46}，此乐何极@{47}！登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡@{48}，宠辱偕忘@{49}，把酒临风@{50}，其喜洋洋者矣@{51}。
嗟夫@{52}！予尝求古仁人之心@{53}，或异二者之为@{54}。何哉？不以物喜，不以己悲@{55}；居庙堂之高则忧其民@{56}；处江湖之远则忧其君@{57}。是进亦忧，退亦忧。然则何时而乐耶？其必曰：“先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐”乎@{58}。噫！微斯人，吾谁与归@{59}？
时六年九月十五日。 [@{60}]（无需翻译）
column2:
In the spring of the fourth year of the Qingli era@{1}, Teng Zijing was demoted and appointed governor of Baling Prefecture@{2}. By the following year@{3}, the government was efficient, the people were united@{4}, and all neglected endeavors had been revived@{5}. The Yueyang Tower was then renovated@{6} and expanded beyond its former dimensions@{7}, while poems and rhapsodies by eminent Tang poets and contemporary writers were inscribed upon it@{8}. I was asked to write this account in commemoration@{9}.
In my view, the magnificent scenery of Baling@{10} is embodied by Lake Dongting alone. It embraces the distant mountains@{11} and swallows the mighty Yangtze River@{12}, its vast waters surging endlessly@{13} and stretching beyond the horizon@{14}. From morning sunlight to evening shadow, its appearance changes in countless ways@{15}. Such is the grand vista from Yueyang Tower@{16}, which earlier writers have described in full@{17}. Yet with Wu Gorge accessible to the north@{18} and the Xiao and Xiang Rivers extending far to the south@{19}, banished officials and wandering poets@{20} often gather here@{21}. Could their feelings upon viewing this scenery possibly be the same@{22}?
When ceaseless rain falls in dreary sheets@{23} and the sky remains overcast for months on end@{24}, bitter winds howl furiously@{25} and turbid waves surge toward the heavens@{26}. The sun and stars conceal their light@{27}, and the mountains vanish from sight@{28}. Merchants and travelers can go no farther@{29}, while masts topple and oars splinter@{30}. As twilight falls, all is engulfed in darkness@{31}, amid the roars of tigers and cries of apes. Those who ascend the tower then may lament their exile and yearn for home@{32}, fear slander and dread reproach@{33}, and find only desolation wherever they look@{34}, until sorrow overwhelms them@{35}.
But when the spring breeze is gentle and the sunlight bright@{36}, the water lies calm and untroubled@{37}. The radiance of sky and lake meets as one@{38} across a boundless expanse of blue-green. Gulls wheel above the sandbars and come to rest, while shimmering fish swim below@{39}. Angelica grows along the banks and orchids upon the islets@{40}, lush and verdant@{41}. At times, the lingering mist clears completely@{42}, revealing the brilliant moon over a thousand miles@{43}. Its glimmer dances like gold upon the rippling water@{44}, while its still reflection sinks like a jade disc into the depths@{45}. Fishermen's songs echo back and forth@{46}—how could such joy ever end@{47}? Those who ascend the tower then may feel their hearts open and their spirits soar@{48}, forgetting both favor and disgrace@{49}, and raise a cup of wine to the breeze@{50}, filled with boundless delight@{51}.
Alas@{52}! I have often sought to understand the hearts of the benevolent sages of antiquity@{53}, whose sentiments perhaps differed from both of these@{54}. Why was that? They rejoiced not in material things, nor grieved over their own misfortunes@{55}. When serving in the imperial court, they worried for the people@{56}; when living in distant seclusion, they worried for their sovereign@{57}. Thus, whether advancing in office or withdrawing from it, they always had cause for concern. When, then, could they find joy? Surely they would say, "Be the first to worry about the world's troubles and the last to enjoy its pleasures"@{58}. Ah! Without such people, whom could I follow@{59}?
Written on the fifteenth day of the ninth month in the sixth year of the era. [@{60}]

column1: 伊甸信徒为黎明而欢呼，他们的歌声凝成琴弦，信仰化作琴柱。神弹奏这具竖琴时，都险些相信——希望真的存在。
column2: The faithful of Eden cheered for the dawn, their songs becoming strings and their faith the harp's pillar. When God played the harp, even He nearly believed—that hope truly existed.

column1: 当克莱因立方被永恒之地吞没，第一声齿轮咬合——虚空裂出金色的纹路，又顷刻坍缩成黑暗。唯有乐声不息，仍在演奏秩序与混沌的永恒角力。
column2: When the Klein Cube was swallowed by the Eternal Land, the first gears engaged—the void split into golden patterns, only to collapse into darkness in an instant. Yet the music played on, performing the eternal struggle between order and chaos.

column1: 鱼人咏唱时，所有风暴归于寂静。神将把这份寂静锻成刀刃，剖开了七千个世界的抵抗意志。
column2: When the Fishmen chanted, every storm fell silent. God forged that silence into a blade and carved through the will of seven thousand worlds to resist.

column1: 基于对蚂蚁密穴奇异波动的分析
column2: Based on an analysis of the strange fluctuations in the Ant Hell

column1: ……界律之钉绝非自然造物。朱诺古籍记载，上古文明‘优佩雷斯’掌握着将生命情感（思念体） 转化为实体能量的技术。我推测，钉子的激活，需要某种极致的‘信念’作为钥匙。
column2: ...The Nail of Order is by no means a natural creation. Ancient records from Juno state that the ancient civilization of Juperos possessed technology capable of converting Life Emotions (thought forms) into physical energy. I theorize that activating the Nail requires some Ultra form of "conviction" as the key.

column1: 蚂蚁密穴的传说……‘拟态少女的执念’。若传说为真，此地应残留着因强烈‘不甘’而生成的高纯度思念粒子。这是验证理论的绝佳样本。
column2: The Legend of the Ant Hell... "The Mimic Girl's Obsession." If the Legend is true, high-purity thought particles born from an intense "unwillingness to give up" should remain here. This is the perfect sample for testing my theory.

column1: 此行目标：使用改良的‘粒子共鸣器’，捕获并分析此地的游离思念粒子。若其能量频谱能与界律之钉产生共鸣，即证明……人类的信念和强烈的情感，能够驱动界律之钉。
column2: Objective: Use the improved "Particle Resonator" to capture and analyze the free-floating thought particles here. If their energy spectrum resonates with the Nail of Order, it will prove that... human conviction and powerful Emotions can drive the Nail of Order.

column1: 共鸣器反应剧烈，传闻是真的……样本纯度超乎想象！我必须……必须再深入一点……到能量源头去……
column2: The resonator is reacting violently. The rumors were true... The sample's purity is beyond anything I imagined! I must... I must go deeper... to the source of the energy...

column1:
1.攻城战开始后，有2分钟<color=#FA983A>准备时间</color>。准备时间内，防守公会的成员可以提前进入城堡进行布防。准备时间结束后，攻城战正式开始。
2.进攻公会的成员<color=#FA983A>击破华丽金属</color>可占领城堡，变成城堡的防守公会。
3.攻城战持续<color=#FA983A>30分钟</color>，攻城战结束时，保持占领城堡的公会最终获得城堡归属。
4.在城堡中有4个<color=#FA983A>阵地</color>，保持阵地范围内己方公会的人数最多，即可自动占领阵地。占领阵地后，可以获得<color=#FA983A>攻防属性加成</color>，并且<color=#FA983A>战场资源</color>会随时间自动获取。
5.同时占领多个阵地的情况，战场BUFF效果、战场资源获取效率叠加。
6.团长使用<color=#FA983A>团长技能</color>时，需要消耗战场资源，在合适的时机使用团长技能，可以扭转战局。
column2:
1. After War of Emperium begins, there is a 2-minute <color=#FA983A>preparation time</color>. During it, defending guild members can enter the castle early to set up defenses. When it ends, the siege officially begins.
2. Attacking guild members who <color=#FA983A>destroy the Emperium</color> capture the castle and become its defending guild.
3. The siege lasts <color=#FA983A>30 minutes</color>. When it ends, the guild holding the castle takes ownership.
4. The castle has 4 <color=#FA983A>positions</color>. Have the most guild members within a position's area to capture it automatically. Captured positions grant <color=#FA983A>ATK/DEF bonuses</color>, and <color=#FA983A>battlefield resources</color> accumulate over time.
5. Holding multiple positions stacks battlefield buff effects and resource gain rates.
6. Using <color=#FA983A>Leader Skills</color> costs battlefield resources. Used at the right moment, they can turn the tide.

column2:

<color=#FA983A>Group Haste</color>: For a while, all guild members gain 50% Move Speed
<color=#FA983A>Group Empower</color>: For a while, all guild members gain 50% ATK and DEF
<color=#FA983A>Party Rally</color>: Starts a rally that instantly teleports your party members to you
<color=#FA983A>Guild Rally</color>: Starts a rally that instantly teleports guild members to you
2. Leader Skills <color=#FA983A>cost battlefield resources</color>, which accumulate over time after capturing positions
